name: Chicken or turkey with mushroom sauce
description:
Tender chicken or turkey, often pan-seared or roasted, generously coated in a rich, earthy mushroom sauce, a comforting and savory dish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts or turkey cutlets
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 1 lb cremini mushrooms, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1.5 cups chicken broth
- 1/2 cup dry white wine (optional, or more broth)
- 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water (slurry)
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken/turkey dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken/turkey for 5-7 minutes per side (for breasts) or 3-5 minutes per side (for cutlets), until golden brown and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
2. Add chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until tender and browned, about 7-10 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
3. Deglaze the pan with white wine (if using) or a splash of broth, scraping up any browned bits. Stir in remaining chicken broth, Worcestershire sauce, and thyme.
4. Bring to a simmer. Whisk in the cornstarch slurry and cook, stirring, for 5-10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened to your desired consistency.
5. Return the cooked chicken/turkey to the skillet, coating it in the sauce. Heat through gently for 2-3 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning.
6. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.

name: Chicken or turkey with teriyaki
description:
Juicy chicken or turkey, often breast or thigh pieces, marinated in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, then grilled, pan-seared, or baked to perfection.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus marinating time)

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
- For Marinade/Sauce:
- 1/2 cup soy sauce
- 1/4 cup mirin (sweet rice wine)
- 2 tablespoons sake (optional, or more mirin)
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon sesame oil
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water (for thickening, optional)
- Sesame seeds and sliced green onions, for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk together soy sauce, mirin, sake (if using), brown sugar, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil.
2. Reserve 1/4 cup of the marinade for later use as sauce. Add chicken/turkey to the remaining marinade, ensuring it's well coated. Marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
3. Heat a large skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat. Remove chicken/turkey from marinade, discarding excess. Cook chicken/turkey for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and lightly browned.
4. While chicken/turkey cooks, pour the reserved 1/4 cup marinade into a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer and, if desired, whisk in the cornstarch slurry to thicken. Cook for 1-2 minutes until thickened.
5. Serve chicken/turkey immediately, drizzled with the thickened teriyaki sauce and garnished with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice.

name: Barbecue chicken
description:
Tender chicken, often grilled or baked, coated in a sticky, sweet, and smoky barbecue sauce, a beloved classic for cookouts and family meals.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts or 8 chicken thighs
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1.5 cups barbecue sauce (your favorite)

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken dry and season with garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 5-7 minutes per side (for breasts) or 7-9 minutes per side (for thighs), until golden brown and almost cooked through.
3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour barbecue sauce over the chicken, ensuring each piece is coated. Simmer, turning chicken occasionally, for 5-10 minutes, or until chicken is fully cooked (internal temp 165°F/74°C) and sauce is caramelized.
4. Alternatively, after searing, transfer chicken to a baking dish, coat with sauce, and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes.
5. Serve hot, perhaps with coleslaw or corn on the cob.

name: Sweet and sour chicken or turkey
description:
Crispy fried chicken or turkey pieces tossed in a vibrant, tangy, and sweet sauce with bell peppers, onions, and pineapple, a popular Asian-inspired dish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken or turkey breast, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1/2 cup cornstarch
- 1 large egg, beaten
- Vegetable oil, for frying
- 1 onion, cut into wedges
- 1 red bell pepper, cut into chunks
- 1 green bell pepper, cut into chunks
- 1 (8 ounce) can pineapple chunks, drained (reserve juice)
- For Sauce:
- 1/4 cup rice vinegar
- 1/4 cup ketchup
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1/2 cup reserved pineapple juice (or water)
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken/turkey cubes dry. Toss poultry with 1/2 cup cornstarch, then dip in beaten egg, ensuring each piece is coated.
2. Heat about 2 inches of vegetable oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
3. Fry poultry in batches for 4-6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together all sauce ingredients until smooth.
5. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of the frying oil (or fresh oil) over medium-high heat. Add onion and bell peppers and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until slightly tender-crisp.
6. Add drained pineapple chunks to the skillet. Pour the sweet and sour sauce over the vegetables. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
7. Add the fried poultry to the skillet and toss to coat evenly with the sauce. Serve immediately over steamed rice.

name: Sweet and sour chicken or turkey, without vegetables
description:
Crispy fried chicken or turkey pieces coated in a vibrant, tangy, and sweet sauce, offering a simpler version of the classic without added vegetables.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken or turkey breast, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1/2 cup cornstarch
- 1 large egg, beaten
- Vegetable oil, for frying
- For Sauce:
- 1/4 cup rice vinegar
- 1/4 cup ketchup
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1/2 cup water or chicken broth
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken/turkey cubes dry. Toss poultry with 1/2 cup cornstarch, then dip in beaten egg, ensuring each piece is coated.
2. Heat about 2 inches of vegetable oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
3. Fry poultry in batches for 4-6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together all sauce ingredients until smooth.
5. In a large skillet or wok, pour the sweet and sour sauce. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
6. Add the fried poultry to the skillet and toss to coat evenly with the sauce. Serve immediately over steamed rice.

name: Chicken curry
description:
A rich and aromatic dish, chicken curry features tender pieces of chicken slow-cooked in a fragrant sauce with a blend of spices, coconut milk, and often vegetables.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces
- 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch fresh ginger, grated
- 2 tablespoons curry powder
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin
- 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
- 1 (13.5 ounce) can full-fat coconut milk
- 1 cup chicken broth
- 1 large potato, peeled and cubed (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh cilantro, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Brown chicken pieces on all sides; remove and set aside.
2. Add chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Stir in curry powder, cumin, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
4. Return chicken to the pot. Stir in coconut milk and chicken broth. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes.
5. If using, add cubed potato and continue to simmer, covered, for another 15-20 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and tender and potatoes are soft. The sauce should have thickened.
6. Taste and adjust seasoning. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.

name: Chicken curry with rice
description:
A complete and satisfying meal, chicken curry with rice combines tender, aromatic chicken curry with fluffy steamed rice, allowing the rice to soak up the rich, spiced sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Chicken Curry:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces
- 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch fresh ginger, grated
- 2 tablespoons curry powder
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin
- 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
- 1 (13.5 ounce) can full-fat coconut milk
- 1 cup chicken broth
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- For Rice:
- 2 cups basmati or jasmine rice
- 4 cups water
- 1/2 teaspoon salt

Instructions:
1. Prepare Chicken Curry: Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Brown chicken pieces on all sides; remove and set aside.
2. Add chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Stir in curry powder, cumin, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Return chicken to the pot. Stir in coconut milk and chicken broth. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and tender. The sauce should have thickened. Taste and adjust seasoning.
5. Prepare Rice: While curry simmers, rinse rice thoroughly under cold water until water runs clear. In a medium saucepan, combine rinsed rice, water, and salt. Bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until all water is absorbed and rice is tender. Let stand, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
7. Serve chicken curry hot over fluffy steamed rice.

name: Chicken with mole sauce
description:
A rich and complex Mexican dish, chicken with mole sauce features tender chicken pieces smothered in a dark, savory, and subtly sweet sauce made from chilies, spices, nuts, and often a hint of chocolate.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs or breasts
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 (12 ounce) jar or can mole paste (store-bought for simplicity)
- 2 cups chicken broth
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar (optional, to balance bitterness)
- Salt to taste
- Sesame seeds and fresh cilantro, for garnish
- Warm tortillas or rice, for serving

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken dry and season with salt. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Brown chicken pieces on all sides; remove and set aside.
2. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add mole paste to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, for 3-5 minutes until fragrant and slightly darkened.
3. Gradually whisk in chicken broth until smooth, ensuring no lumps. Stir in brown sugar (if using).
4. Return chicken to the pot, ensuring it's submerged in the sauce. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 30-40 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and tender.
5. Taste and adjust seasoning. If sauce is too thick, add a little more broth. If too thin, simmer uncovered for a few minutes.
6. Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds and cilantro, with warm tortillas or rice.

name: Chicken or turkey with cheese sauce
description:
Tender chicken or turkey pieces, often pan-seared or baked, smothered in a creamy, savory cheese sauce, creating a comforting and indulgent meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts or turkey cutlets
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 2 cups milk (whole or 2%)
- 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese (or a blend like Monterey Jack)
- 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh chives or parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken/turkey dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken/turkey for 5-7 minutes per side (for breasts) or 3-5 minutes per side (for cutlets), until golden brown and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
2. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, to create a roux.
3. Gradually whisk in milk until smooth. Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens.
4. Remove from heat. Stir in shredded cheese and garlic powder until cheese is melted and smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
5. Return chicken/turkey to the skillet, coating it in the cheese sauce. Heat through gently for 2-3 minutes. Do not boil after adding cheese.
6. Garnish with fresh chives or parsley and serve immediately.

name: Chicken or turkey cordon bleu
description:
A gourmet classic, Chicken or Turkey Cordon Bleu features tender poultry cutlets pounded thin, wrapped around ham and Swiss cheese, then breaded and pan-fried or baked until golden and melted.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts or turkey cutlets (about 6-8 oz each), pounded very thin
- 4 slices cooked ham
- 4 slices Swiss cheese
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 large egg, beaten with 1 tablespoon water
- 1 cup breadcrumbs (Panko preferred)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Vegetable oil, for frying or baking

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) if baking. Lightly grease a baking sheet.
2. Lay each pounded poultry cutlet flat. Place one slice of ham and one slice of Swiss cheese on one half of each cutlet. Fold the other half of the poultry over the ham and cheese, pressing edges to seal, or roll up tightly. Secure with toothpicks if needed.
3. Set up a breading station: one dish with seasoned flour, one with egg wash, one with seasoned breadcrumbs.
4. Dredge each poultry roll in flour, then egg wash, then breadcrumb mixture, pressing to adhere.
5. For frying: Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry poultry rolls for 5-7 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove and drain on paper towels.
6. For baking: Place breaded poultry rolls on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle lightly with oil. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through (internal temp 165°F/74°C).
7. Remove toothpicks before serving. Serve hot.

name: Chicken or turkey parmigiana
description:
Crispy, breaded chicken or turkey cutlets, pan-fried or baked, then topped with rich tomato sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese, baked until bubbly and golden.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts or turkey cutlets, pounded thin
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 large egg, beaten with 1 tablespoon water
- 1 cup breadcrumbs (Panko preferred)
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese, divided
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Vegetable oil, for frying
- 2 cups marinara sauce
- 8 oz fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced or shredded
- Fresh basil, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Pat chicken/turkey dry. Set up a breading station: one dish with seasoned flour, one with egg wash, one with breadcrumbs mixed with 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper.
3. Dredge each cutlet in flour, then egg wash, then breadcrumb mixture, pressing to adhere.
4. Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry cutlets in batches for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
5. Spread a thin layer of marinara sauce in the bottom of a baking dish. Place fried cutlets over the sauce. Top each cutlet with more marinara sauce, then slices or shredded mozzarella, and a sprinkle of remaining Parmesan.
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly and sauce is heated through. Broil for 1-2 minutes at the end for extra browning, if desired.
7. Garnish with fresh basil and serve hot.

name: Orange chicken
description:
Crispy fried chicken pieces tossed in a vibrant, sweet, and tangy orange sauce, a popular Chinese-American dish with a delightful citrus kick.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1/2 cup cornstarch
- 1 large egg, beaten
- Vegetable oil, for frying
- For Sauce:
- 1/2 cup orange juice
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon orange zest
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water
- Sesame seeds and sliced green onions, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken cubes dry. Toss chicken with 1/2 cup cornstarch, then dip in beaten egg, ensuring each piece is coated.
2. Heat about 2 inches of vegetable oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
3. Fry chicken in batches for 4-6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together all sauce ingredients (except the cornstarch slurry).
5. In a large skillet or wok, pour the sauce mixture. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Whisk in the cornstarch slurry and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
6. Add the fried chicken to the skillet and toss to coat evenly with the sauce. Serve immediately over steamed rice, garnished with sesame seeds and green onions.

name: Sesame chicken
description:
Crispy fried chicken pieces coated in a sweet and savory sauce, generously garnished with toasted sesame seeds, a beloved Chinese-American classic.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1/2 cup cornstarch
- 1 large egg, beaten
- Vegetable oil, for frying
- For Sauce:
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon sesame oil
- 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water
- 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds, plus more for garnish
- Sliced green onions, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat chicken cubes dry. Toss chicken with 1/2 cup cornstarch, then dip in beaten egg, ensuring each piece is coated.
2. Heat about 2 inches of vegetable oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
3. Fry chicken in batches for 4-6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together all sauce ingredients (except the cornstarch slurry and sesame seeds).
5. In a large skillet or wok, pour the sauce mixture. Bring to a simmer over medium heat. Whisk in the cornstarch slurry and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
6. Stir in 2 tablespoons of toasted sesame seeds. Add the fried chicken to the skillet and toss to coat evenly with the sauce. Serve immediately over steamed rice, garnished with more sesame seeds and green onions.

name: Chicken kiev
description:
A classic Eastern European dish, Chicken Kiev features a pounded chicken breast rolled around a generous knob of herb butter, then breaded and deep-fried or baked until golden and the butter melts into a luscious sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus chilling time)

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 6-8 oz each), pounded very thin
- 4 tablespoons cold butter, divided into 4 logs
- 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 large egg, beaten with 1 tablespoon water
- 1 cup breadcrumbs (Panko preferred)
- Vegetable oil, for frying or baking

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, combine cold butter logs with chopped parsley, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Roll each butter log in plastic wrap and chill until firm.
2. Lay each pounded chicken breast flat. Place one chilled herb butter log in the center. Fold the sides of the chicken over the butter, then roll up tightly to completely enclose the butter. Ensure there are no gaps.
3. Set up a breading station: one dish with seasoned flour, one with egg wash, one with seasoned breadcrumbs.
4. Dredge each chicken roll in flour, then egg wash, then breadcrumb mixture, pressing to adhere. For best results, double-coat by repeating the egg wash and breadcrumb steps. Chill for 30 minutes to firm up the coating.
5. For frying: Heat about 2 inches of vegetable oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or deep fryer to 350°F (175°C). Fry chicken rolls for 6-8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through (internal temp 165°F/74°C).
6. For baking: Place breaded chicken rolls on a lightly greased baking sheet. Drizzle lightly with oil. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through.
7. Serve immediately, being cautious of the hot, melted butter inside.

name: Stuffed chicken, drumstick or breast, Puerto Rican style
description:
Flavorful chicken drumsticks or breasts, often deboned, generously filled with a savory mixture of seasoned ground meat, sofrito, and olives, then baked or braised to perfection.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts or deboned chicken drumsticks
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- For Stuffing:
- 1/2 lb ground pork or beef
- 1/4 cup sofrito
- 2 tablespoons tomato sauce
- 1/4 cup pitted green olives, chopped
- 1 tablespoon capers, rinsed and chopped
- 1/4 teaspoon dried oregano
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- For Sauce (optional):
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 1/4 cup tomato sauce

Instructions:
1. Prepare stuffing: In a skillet, brown ground pork/beef over medium heat. Drain excess fat. Stir in sofrito, 2 tablespoons tomato sauce, olives, capers, oregano, salt, and pepper. Cook for 5-7 minutes until heated through and flavors meld. Let cool slightly.
2. Prepare chicken: Lay each chicken breast/drumstick flat. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Place a generous amount of stuffing in the center of each. Roll up or fold the chicken to enclose the stuffing, securing with toothpicks if necessary.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in an oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear stuffed chicken on all sides until golden brown. Remove and set aside.
4. If making sauce: In the same skillet, add 1/2 cup chicken broth and 1/4 cup tomato sauce. Bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits.
5. Return stuffed chicken to the skillet. Cover and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25-35 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through (internal temp 165°F/74°C) and stuffing is hot.
6. Remove toothpicks before serving. Serve hot, with sauce if desired.

name: Fish with cream or white sauce, not tuna or lobster
description:
Delicate white fish fillets, such as cod or sole, gently cooked and served with a luxurious, creamy white sauce, enhancing its mild flavor and tender texture.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 (6 oz) white fish fillets (cod, haddock, sole, or tilapia)
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 1.5 cups milk (whole or 2%)
- 1/2 cup dry white wine (optional, or more milk)
- 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
- Salt and white pepper to taste
- 2 tablespoons fresh parsley or dill, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat fish fillets dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook fish for 3-5 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until opaque and flaky. Remove fish and set aside, keeping warm.
2. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, to create a roux.
3. Gradually whisk in milk and white wine (if using) until smooth. Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Stir in nutmeg.
4. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and white pepper.
5. Return fish fillets to the skillet, coating them gently in the sauce. Heat through for 1-2 minutes. Do not boil after adding fish.
6. Garnish with fresh parsley or dill and serve immediately.

name: Fish timbale or mousse
description:
A delicate and elegant dish, fish timbale or mousse is a light, airy preparation of pureed fish, often bound with cream and eggs, then baked or steamed until set, served hot or cold.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb white fish fillets (cod, sole, or salmon), skinless and boneless
- 1 cup heavy cream, chilled
- 2 large egg whites, chilled
- 1/4 cup fresh dill or chives, chopped
- 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
- Salt and white pepper to taste
- Butter, for greasing ramekins
- Lemon wedges, for serving

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly butter 4-6 individual ramekins or a small soufflé dish. Place them in a larger baking pan.
2. Cut fish into chunks. In a food processor, pulse fish until finely minced. Add egg whites, salt, white pepper, and nutmeg. Process until smooth.
3. With the food processor running, slowly pour in the chilled heavy cream until the mixture is light and fluffy. Stir in chopped dill or chives.
4. Spoon the fish mousse mixture into the prepared ramekins, filling them about two-thirds full. Smooth the tops.
5. Pour hot water into the larger baking pan, reaching halfway up the sides of the ramekins (this creates a bain-marie).
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes for individual ramekins, or 30-40 minutes for a larger dish, until the mousse is set and lightly golden. A knife inserted into the center should come out clean.
7. Carefully remove from the oven. Let cool slightly before unmolding (if desired) or serve directly from ramekins with lemon wedges.

name: Shrimp cocktail
description:
A classic appetizer, shrimp cocktail features chilled, cooked shrimp typically served with a tangy, spicy cocktail sauce, often garnished with lemon.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 10 minutes (plus chilling time for shrimp)

Ingredients:
- 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and cooked (steamed or boiled)
- For Cocktail Sauce:
- 1/2 cup ketchup
- 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish (or more, to taste)
- 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
- 1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce
- Pinch of cayenne pepper (optional)
- Salt to taste
- Lemon wedges, for serving

Instructions:
1. Ensure cooked shrimp are thoroughly chilled. If cooking fresh shrimp, steam or boil them until pink and opaque, then immediately plunge into an ice bath to stop cooking and chill quickly.
2. Prepare cocktail sauce: In a small bowl, whisk together ketchup, horseradish, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, cayenne pepper (if using), and salt until well combined. Taste and adjust seasonings to your preference.
3. Arrange chilled shrimp around the rim of a chilled serving glass or bowl, with the tails hooked over the edge. Place the cocktail sauce in the center.
4. Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

name: Tuna with cream or white sauce
description:
Flaky tuna, often canned, combined with a rich, creamy white sauce, creating a comforting and easy meal, frequently served over noodles or toast.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 (5 ounce) cans tuna in water or oil, drained
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 2 cups milk (whole or 2%)
- 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
- Salt and white pepper to taste
- 1/4 cup frozen peas (optional)
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish (optional)
- Cooked egg noodles or toast, for serving

Instructions:
1. In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, to create a roux.
2. Gradually whisk in milk until smooth. Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Stir in garlic powder.
3. Remove from heat. Gently fold in drained tuna and frozen peas (if using). Heat through gently for 2-3 minutes. Do not boil after adding tuna.
4. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and white pepper.
5. Serve hot over cooked egg noodles or toast, garnished with parsley if desired.

name: Seafood thermidor
description:
A luxurious French dish, Seafood Thermidor features a rich, creamy sauce made with cooked seafood (often lobster, crab, or shrimp), brandy, and cheese, served in a gratin dish or shell and baked until golden.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tablespoon butter
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1/4 cup finely chopped shallots
- 8 oz mixed cooked seafood (lobster, crab, shrimp), chopped
- 2 tablespoons brandy or dry white wine
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 1.5 cups milk (whole or 2%)
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1/4 teaspoon Dijon mustard
- Pinch of cayenne pepper
- Salt and white pepper to taste
- 1/2 cup grated Gruyere or Parmesan cheese, divided
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish
- 4 individual gratin dishes or scallop shells

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. In a medium saucepan, melt butter with olive oil over medium heat. Add shallots and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Add chopped seafood and cook for 2 minutes.
3. Pour in brandy or white wine and cook for 1 minute, allowing alcohol to evaporate.
4. Sprinkle flour over the seafood mixture and stir for 1 minute to create a roux.
5. Gradually whisk in milk and heavy cream until smooth. Bring to a simmer, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Stir in Dijon mustard, cayenne pepper, salt, and white pepper.
6. Remove from heat. Stir in half of the grated cheese until melted and smooth.
7. Divide the seafood mixture among the gratin dishes or shells. Sprinkle remaining cheese over the top.
8. Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until bubbly and golden brown. Broil for 1-2 minutes at the end for extra browning, if desired.
9. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

name: Seafood sauce
description: A versatile condiment or base sauce designed to complement various seafood dishes, often creamy, tangy, or spicy, enhancing the natural flavors of fish and shellfish.

name: Spaghetti sauce with seafood
description:
A flavorful spaghetti sauce featuring a medley of seafood, such as shrimp, scallops, and mussels, simmered in a rich tomato-based sauce with garlic and herbs, perfect for pasta.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (28 ounce) can crushed tomatoes
- 1/2 cup dry white wine (optional, or fish broth)
- 1/2 cup fish or vegetable broth
- 1 teaspoon dried oregano
- 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 lb mixed seafood (shrimp, scallops, mussels, calamari), cleaned
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
2. Stir in crushed tomatoes, white wine (if using), fish/vegetable broth, oregano, red pepper flakes (if using), salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
3. Add mixed seafood to the sauce. Increase heat to medium and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until shrimp are pink and opaque, scallops are firm, and mussels have opened (discard any unopened mussels).
4. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot over cooked spaghetti, garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Spaghetti sauce with seafood and added vegetables
description:
A robust and nutritious spaghetti sauce featuring a medley of seafood and a colorful array of vegetables, simmered in a rich tomato-based sauce with garlic and herbs, perfect for a wholesome pasta meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 carrot, finely diced
- 1 celery stalk, finely diced
- 1 bell pepper (any color), diced
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (28 ounce) can crushed tomatoes
- 1/2 cup dry white wine (optional, or fish broth)
- 1/2 cup fish or vegetable broth
- 1 teaspoon dried oregano
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 lb mixed seafood (shrimp, scallops, mussels, calamari), cleaned
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add chopped onion, carrot, celery, and bell pepper. Cook until softened, about 7-10 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
2. Stir in crushed tomatoes, white wine (if using), fish/vegetable broth, oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
3. Add mixed seafood to the sauce. Increase heat to medium and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until shrimp are pink and opaque, scallops are firm, and mussels have opened (discard any unopened mussels).
4. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot over cooked spaghetti, garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Shrimp with lobster sauce
description:
Succulent shrimp bathed in a rich, savory, and often slightly thickened sauce, traditionally made with fermented black beans, garlic, and ginger, mimicking the luxurious flavor of lobster sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch fresh ginger, grated
- 1/4 cup fermented black beans, rinsed and chopped (optional, for authentic flavor)
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 teaspoon rice vinegar
- 1 teaspoon sugar
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water
- 1 large egg, beaten
- Sliced green onions, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add chopped black beans (if using) and stir-fry for 1 minute.
2. Add shrimp to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until pink and almost cooked through. Remove shrimp and set aside.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together chicken broth, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar. Pour into the skillet and bring to a simmer.
4. Whisk in the cornstarch slurry and cook, stirring, for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens.
5. Reduce heat to low. Slowly pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring gently, creating delicate egg ribbons in the sauce. Cook for 1 minute until egg is set.
6. Return shrimp to the skillet and toss to coat in the sauce. Heat through gently for 1 minute. Serve immediately over steamed rice, garnished with green onions.

name: Sweet and sour shrimp
description:
Crispy fried shrimp tossed in a vibrant, tangy, and sweet sauce with bell peppers, onions, and pineapple, a delightful and popular Asian-inspired dish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1/2 cup cornstarch
- 1 large egg, beaten
- Vegetable oil, for frying
- 1 onion, cut into wedges
- 1 red bell pepper, cut into chunks
- 1 green bell pepper, cut into chunks
- 1 (8 ounce) can pineapple chunks, drained (reserve juice)
- For Sauce:
- 1/4 cup rice vinegar
- 1/4 cup ketchup
- 2 tablespoons brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1/2 cup reserved pineapple juice (or water)
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch

Instructions:
1. Pat shrimp dry. Toss shrimp with 1/2 cup cornstarch, then dip in beaten egg, ensuring each piece is coated.
2. Heat about 2 inches of vegetable oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot or deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
3. Fry shrimp in batches for 2-3 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together all sauce ingredients until smooth.
5. In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of the frying oil (or fresh oil) over medium-high heat. Add onion and bell peppers and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until slightly tender-crisp.
6. Add drained pineapple chunks to the skillet. Pour the sweet and sour sauce over the vegetables. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring, for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
7. Add the fried shrimp to the skillet and toss to coat evenly with the sauce. Serve immediately over steamed rice.

name: Fish sauce
description: A pungent, savory condiment made from fermented fish, widely used in Southeast Asian cuisine to add a deep umami flavor to dishes.

name: Shrimp scampi
description:
A classic Italian-American dish, Shrimp Scampi features succulent shrimp sautéed in a rich, garlicky butter sauce with white wine and lemon, often served over pasta.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 4 tablespoons butter
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 cup dry white wine (such as Pinot Grigio or Chardonnay)
- 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
- 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
- Cooked linguine or spaghetti, for serving

Instructions:
1. Pat shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
2. In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes (if using) and cook for 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn the garlic.
3. Add shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and opaque.
4. Pour in white wine and lemon juice. Bring to a simmer and cook for 1-2 minutes, allowing the sauce to reduce slightly.
5. Stir in fresh parsley. Taste and adjust seasoning.
6. Serve immediately over hot cooked linguine or spaghetti, with extra sauce spooned over.

name: Fish with tomato-based sauce
description:
A delightful and savory dish featuring tender fish fillets simmered in a rich, tangy tomato-based sauce, often infused with herbs and aromatics.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs white fish fillets (cod, tilapia, snapper)
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
- 1/2 cup vegetable broth
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat fish fillets dry and season with salt and pepper.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
3. Stir in crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
4. Gently place fish fillets into the sauce. Cover and cook for 8-12 minutes, or until fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
5. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.

name: Fish curry
description:
An aromatic and flavorful dish where tender pieces of fish are cooked in a vibrant, spiced gravy, often featuring coconut milk and a blend of traditional curry spices.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs firm white fish (cod, halibut), cut into chunks
- 1 tbsp coconut oil or vegetable oil
- 1 onion, finely chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated
- 1 tbsp curry powder
- 1 tsp turmeric
- 1/2 tsp red chili powder (optional)
- 1 (14 oz) can coconut milk
- 1/2 cup fish or vegetable broth
- 1 tomato, diced
- Salt to taste
- Fresh cilantro, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in a large pot or deep skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until translucent, about 5-7 minutes.
2. Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Stir in curry powder, turmeric, and chili powder (if using). Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Pour in coconut milk and broth, add diced tomato and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer.
5. Add fish chunks to the simmering sauce. Cook gently for 5-8 minutes, or until fish is cooked through and flakes easily. Do not overcook.
6. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot, ideally with rice.

name: Fish curry with rice
description:
A comforting and complete meal featuring aromatic fish curry, rich with spices and often coconut milk, served alongside fluffy steamed rice.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs firm white fish (cod, halibut), cut into chunks
- 1 tbsp coconut oil or vegetable oil
- 1 onion, finely chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated
- 1 tbsp curry powder
- 1 tsp turmeric
- 1/2 tsp red chili powder (optional)
- 1 (14 oz) can coconut milk
- 1/2 cup fish or vegetable broth
- 1 tomato, diced
- Salt to taste
- Fresh cilantro, chopped, for garnish
- 2 cups white rice
- 4 cups water

Instructions:
1. First, prepare the rice: Rinse rice thoroughly. Combine rice and water in a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until water is absorbed and rice is tender. Let stand for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
2. While rice cooks, prepare the curry: Heat oil in a large pot or deep skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until translucent, about 5-7 minutes.
3. Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
4. Stir in curry powder, turmeric, and chili powder (if using). Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
5. Pour in coconut milk and broth, add diced tomato and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer.
6. Add fish chunks to the simmering sauce. Cook gently for 5-8 minutes, or until fish is cooked through and flakes easily. Do not overcook.
7. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve the fish curry hot over the prepared rice.

name: Shrimp teriyaki
description:
Succulent shrimp glazed in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, offering a delightful balance of umami and a hint of ginger and garlic.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp mirin (sweet rice wine)
- 1 tbsp sake (or dry sherry)
- 1 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- Sesame seeds and chopped green onions for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, mirin, sake, brown sugar, ginger, and garlic to make the teriyaki sauce.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
3. Add shrimp to the hot skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes per side, until pink and opaque.
4. Pour the teriyaki sauce over the shrimp. Bring to a simmer and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens slightly and coats the shrimp.
5. Remove from heat, garnish with sesame seeds and green onions, and serve immediately, often with rice.

name: Ceviche
description:
A refreshing and vibrant Latin American dish where fresh raw fish or seafood is cured in citrus juices, typically lime or lemon, and mixed with various seasonings like chili, onion, and cilantro.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus 30-60 minutes chilling)

Ingredients:
- 1 lb fresh firm white fish (e.g., snapper, cod, mahi-mahi), cut into 1/2-inch cubes
- 1 cup fresh lime juice (about 8-10 limes)
- 1/2 red onion, thinly sliced
- 1-2 jalapeños or serrano peppers, seeded and minced (adjust to taste)
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro
- 1/2 red bell pepper, finely diced (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Tortilla chips or tostadas for serving

Instructions:
1. Place fish cubes in a non-reactive bowl (glass or ceramic). Pour lime juice over the fish, ensuring it is fully submerged. Stir gently.
2. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour, or until the fish turns opaque and firm (the 'cooking' process). The exact time depends on the thickness of the fish pieces.
3. Once the fish is 'cooked', drain about half of the lime juice from the bowl.
4. Add the sliced red onion, minced jalapeño, chopped cilantro, and diced red bell pepper (if using) to the fish. Stir gently to combine.
5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Let it sit for another 10-15 minutes in the refrigerator for flavors to meld.
6. Serve immediately with tortilla chips or tostadas.

name: Crabs in tomato-based sauce, Puerto Rican style
description:
A flavorful Puerto Rican delicacy featuring succulent crab meat simmered in a rich, aromatic tomato-based sauce, often seasoned with sofrito, olives, and capers.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb crab meat (fresh or frozen, thawed)
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1/4 cup sofrito (homemade or store-bought)
- 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce
- 1/2 cup water or fish broth
- 1/4 cup pimiento-stuffed green olives, sliced
- 1 tbsp capers, drained
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh cilantro or recao, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. If using fresh crab, clean and crack. If using canned, drain well.
2. Heat olive oil in a medium pot or deep skillet over medium heat. Add sofrito and cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, water/broth, olives, capers, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
4. Add crab meat to the sauce. Gently stir to combine. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-15 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with fresh cilantro or recao and serve hot, often with white rice or tostones.

name: Shrimp in garlic sauce, Puerto Rican style
description:
A classic Puerto Rican dish featuring plump shrimp sautéed in a fragrant garlic-infused sauce, often brightened with a touch of lime or white wine.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- 6-8 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/4 cup dry white wine or chicken broth
- 2 tbsp fresh lime juice
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro or parsley
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Pat shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
3. Add shrimp to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes per side, until they turn pink and opaque.
4. Pour in white wine (or broth) and lime juice. Bring to a quick simmer and cook for another 1-2 minutes, allowing the sauce to reduce slightly.
5. Remove from heat, stir in fresh cilantro or parsley. Serve immediately, often with rice or crusty bread.

name: Stew, fish
description:
A hearty and comforting stew featuring tender pieces of fish and vegetables simmered in a flavorful broth, perfect for a warming meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs firm white fish (cod, snapper), cut into 1-inch chunks
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 carrots, peeled and sliced
- 2 celery stalks, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes, undrained
- 4 cups fish or vegetable broth
- 1 bay leaf
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme
- 2 potatoes, peeled and diced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery. Cook until softened, about 8-10 minutes.
2. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Stir in diced tomatoes, broth, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Add diced potatoes to the stew. Continue to simmer, covered, for another 10-15 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
5. Gently add fish chunks to the stew. Cook for 5-8 minutes, or until fish is cooked through and flakes easily. Do not overcook.
6. Remove bay leaf. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.

name: Meatballs, NS as to type of meat, with sauce
description:
Classic comfort food featuring savory meatballs, often a blend of ground meats, simmered in a rich and flavorful sauce, perfect for a hearty meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground meat (beef, pork, or a mix)
- 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
- 1/4 cup milk
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese (optional)
- 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 (24 oz) jar marinara sauce

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine ground meat, breadcrumbs, milk, egg, Parmesan (if using), parsley, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix gently until just combined; do not overmix.
2. Form the mixture into 1-inch meatballs.
3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the meatballs on all sides. You may need to do this in batches.
4. Once browned, drain any excess fat. Pour the marinara sauce over the meatballs. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until meatballs are cooked through.
5. Serve hot, often with pasta or crusty bread.

name: Meat loaf, Puerto Rican style
description:
A flavorful twist on classic meatloaf, Puerto Rican style often incorporates sofrito, olives, and other Caribbean seasonings for a vibrant and savory profile.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs ground beef (or a mix of beef and pork)
- 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
- 1/4 cup milk
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1/4 cup sofrito (homemade or store-bought)
- 1/4 cup pimiento-stuffed green olives, chopped
- 1 tbsp capers, drained and chopped
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- For topping: 1/4 cup ketchup or tomato sauce

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease a loaf pan.
2. In a large bowl, combine ground meat, breadcrumbs, milk, egg, sofrito, olives, capers, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix gently until just combined; do not overmix.
3. Press the meat mixture evenly into the prepared loaf pan.
4. Spread ketchup or tomato sauce over the top of the meatloaf.
5. Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, or until an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) is reached. Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Meat with tomato-based sauce
description:
A versatile and comforting dish featuring tender cuts of meat, often beef or pork, slow-cooked or simmered in a rich, savory tomato-based sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs stewing beef or pork, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
- 1 cup beef broth
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1 bay leaf
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat meat cubes dry and season with salt and pepper.
2. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Brown the meat in batches on all sides. Remove meat and set aside.
3. Add onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
4. Return meat to the pot. Stir in crushed tomatoes, beef broth, oregano, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
5. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, or until meat is very tender. Stir occasionally.
6. Remove bay leaf. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot, often with pasta, rice, or polenta.

name: Spaghetti sauce with meat
description:
A classic, hearty Italian-American sauce featuring ground meat (typically beef or a mix) simmered in a rich tomato base with herbs and spices, perfect for pasta.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb ground beef (or Italian sausage, or a mix)
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
- 1 (15 oz) can tomato sauce
- 1/2 cup water or beef broth
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp dried basil
- 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh basil or parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add ground meat and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Drain excess fat.
2. Add onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
3. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, water/broth, oregano, basil, red pepper flakes (if using), salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
4. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours, stirring occasionally, to allow flavors to meld. The longer it simmers, the richer the flavor.
5. Taste and adjust seasonings. Serve hot over cooked spaghetti, garnished with fresh basil or parsley.

name: Spaghetti sauce with meat and added vegetables
description:
A wholesome and flavorful spaghetti sauce, enriched with ground meat and a medley of vegetables, simmered in a rich tomato base for a hearty and nutritious meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb ground beef (or Italian sausage, or a mix)
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 carrots, finely diced
- 2 celery stalks, finely diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
- 1 (15 oz) can tomato sauce
- 1/2 cup water or beef broth
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp dried basil
- 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh basil or parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add ground meat and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Drain excess fat.
2. Add onion, carrots, and celery to the pot. Cook until softened, about 8-10 minutes.
3. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
4. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, water/broth, oregano, basil, red pepper flakes (if using), salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
5. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 45 minutes, or up to 2 hours, stirring occasionally, to allow flavors to meld and vegetables to soften. The longer it simmers, the richer the flavor.
6. Taste and adjust seasonings. Serve hot over cooked spaghetti, garnished with fresh basil or parsley.

name: Stewed, seasoned, ground beef and pork, Mexican style
description:
A savory and aromatic Mexican-style stew featuring a blend of seasoned ground beef and pork, often simmered with tomatoes, chilies, and traditional spices for a rich, comforting flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1/2 lb ground beef
- 1/2 lb ground pork
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes, undrained
- 1 (4 oz) can diced green chilies, undrained
- 1/2 cup beef broth
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1/2 tsp chili powder
- 1/4 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh cilantro, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and pork and cook, breaking up the meat, until browned. Drain excess fat.
2. Add onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
3. Stir in diced tomatoes, green chilies, beef broth, cumin, chili powder, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
4. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-30 minutes, allowing flavors to meld. Stir occasionally.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot, often with tortillas or rice.

name: Meat with gravy, NS as to type of meat,
description:
A comforting and classic dish featuring tender meat, often slow-cooked or roasted, served generously with a rich, savory gravy.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs beef chuck roast, cut into 2-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cups beef broth
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- 1 bay leaf
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour (for gravy)
- 1/4 cup cold water (for gravy)

Instructions:
1. Pat meat cubes dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Brown the meat in batches on all sides. Remove meat and set aside.
3. Add onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Deglaze the pot with a splash of beef broth, scraping up any browned bits.
4. Return meat to the pot. Add remaining beef broth, thyme, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
5. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2-2.5 hours, or until meat is very tender. Remove bay leaf.
6. To make gravy: In a small bowl, whisk together flour and cold water until smooth. Slowly whisk this slurry into the simmering liquid in the pot. Cook, stirring constantly, until the gravy thickens to your desired consistency.
7. Taste and adjust seasonings. Serve hot.

name: Beef and potatoes, no sauce
description:
A simple and satisfying dish featuring tender pieces of beef and hearty potatoes, often roasted or pan-fried together, seasoned to perfection without a heavy sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs beef sirloin or round steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1.5 lbs potatoes (Yukon Gold or red), cut into 1-inch cubes
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp onion powder
- 1/2 tsp dried rosemary (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. In a large bowl, combine beef cubes and potato cubes. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat.
3. Sprinkle with garlic powder, onion powder, rosemary (if using), salt, and pepper. Toss again to ensure everything is evenly seasoned.
4. Spread the beef and potatoes in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
5. Roast for 25-35 minutes, stirring halfway through, until beef is cooked to your desired doneness and potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
6. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

name: Beef and potatoes with cream sauce, white sauce or mushroom sauce
description:
A comforting dish featuring tender beef and hearty potatoes, enveloped in a rich and creamy sauce, often a classic white sauce or a savory mushroom cream sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin or round steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cups diced potatoes
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1.5 cups milk (for white sauce) OR 1.5 cups beef broth + 1/2 cup heavy cream (for cream sauce)
- 1 cup sliced mushrooms (for mushroom sauce, optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown beef cubes on all sides. Remove beef and set aside.
2. Add onion and potatoes to the skillet. Cook until onion softens and potatoes begin to brown, about 8-10 minutes.
3. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute to create a roux.
4. Gradually whisk in milk (or broth/cream mixture). If making mushroom sauce, add mushrooms now. Cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.
5. Return beef to the skillet with the sauce and vegetables. Season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until beef is tender and potatoes are cooked through.
6. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.

name: Beef, roast, hash
description:
A savory and satisfying hash made with leftover roast beef, diced potatoes, and onions, pan-fried until crispy and golden brown.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups cooked roast beef, diced
- 3 cups cooked potatoes, diced (leftover roasted or boiled potatoes work well)
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Optional: 1/2 tsp paprika, chopped fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add diced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown and crisp up, about 8-10 minutes.
4. Stir in diced roast beef. Season with salt, pepper, and paprika (if using). Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the beef is heated through and some pieces are slightly crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
5. Serve hot, often topped with a fried egg, and garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Corned beef hash
description:
A classic breakfast or brunch dish featuring savory corned beef, diced potatoes, and onions, pan-fried until crispy and golden brown, often served with eggs.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cups cooked potatoes, diced (leftover boiled or roasted potatoes work well)
- 1 (12 oz) can corned beef, diced or shredded
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Optional: 1/2 tsp paprika, chopped fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add diced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown and crisp up, about 8-10 minutes.
4. Stir in diced or shredded corned beef. Season with salt, pepper, and paprika (if using). Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the corned beef is heated through and slightly crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
5. Serve hot, often topped with a fried or poached egg, and garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Beef and potatoes with cheese sauce
description:
A comforting and indulgent dish combining tender beef and hearty potatoes, all smothered in a rich, creamy, and savory cheese sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin or round steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 2 cups diced potatoes
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1.5 cups milk
- 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese (or your favorite cheese)
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh chives or parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown beef cubes on all sides. Remove beef and set aside.
2. Add diced potatoes to the skillet. Cook until tender, about 10-15 minutes. Remove potatoes and set aside.
3. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute to create a roux.
4. Gradually whisk in milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Reduce heat to low.
5. Stir in shredded cheese and garlic powder until the cheese is melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
6. Return beef and potatoes to the skillet with the cheese sauce. Stir to coat everything evenly. Heat through gently.
7. Garnish with fresh chives or parsley and serve hot.

name: Stewed, seasoned, ground beef with potatoes, Mexican style
description:
A hearty and flavorful Mexican-inspired stew featuring seasoned ground beef and tender potatoes, simmered in a rich, often tomato-based sauce with traditional spices.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 medium potatoes, peeled and diced into 1/2-inch cubes
- 1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes, undrained
- 1/2 cup beef broth
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1/2 tsp chili powder
- 1/4 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh cilantro, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Drain excess fat.
2. Add onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
3. Stir in diced potatoes, diced tomatoes, beef broth, cumin, chili powder, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
4. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Stir occasionally.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot, often with tortillas or rice.

name: Beef and noodles, no sauce
description:
A simple and satisfying dish featuring tender beef strips and al dente noodles, often stir-fried or pan-fried together with minimal seasoning for a clean, savory taste.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
- 8 oz egg noodles or wide pasta
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, thinly sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley or chives, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
2. While noodles cook, pat beef slices dry and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
3. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add beef in batches and stir-fry quickly until browned and cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per batch. Remove beef and set aside.
4. Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the skillet. Add sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
5. Return beef to the skillet. Add cooked noodles and toss everything together to combine and heat through. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed.
6. Garnish with fresh parsley or chives and serve immediately.

name: Beef and macaroni with cheese sauce
description:
A comforting and classic casserole-style dish featuring seasoned ground beef and macaroni pasta, all baked or simmered in a rich, creamy cheese sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 8 oz elbow macaroni
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups milk
- 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Optional: 1/2 cup frozen peas or corn

Instructions:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
2. While macaroni cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Drain excess fat.
3. Add onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
4. In a separate pot or the same skillet (after removing beef), melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute to create a roux.
5. Gradually whisk in milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Reduce heat to low.
6. Stir in shredded cheese and garlic powder until the cheese is melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
7. Add cooked macaroni, ground beef, and optional peas/corn to the cheese sauce. Stir to combine and heat through.
8. Serve hot.

name: Beef and noodles with tomato-based sauce
description:
A hearty and satisfying dish combining tender beef and al dente noodles, all coated in a rich, savory tomato-based sauce, reminiscent of a comforting goulash.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes, undrained
- 1 cup beef broth
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1 bay leaf
- 8 oz egg noodles or wide pasta
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat beef cubes dry and season with salt and pepper.
2. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in batches on all sides. Remove beef and set aside.
3. Add onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
4. Return beef to the pot. Stir in diced tomatoes, beef broth, oregano, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
5. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, or until beef is very tender. Remove bay leaf.
6. Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain.
7. Add cooked noodles to the beef and sauce. Stir to combine and heat through. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed.
8. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.

name: Chili with macaroni
description:
A comforting and hearty one-pot meal, combining savory chili (often with ground beef and beans) with tender elbow macaroni, creating a satisfying and flavorful dish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (15 oz) can tomato sauce
- 1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes, undrained
- 1 (15 oz) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
- 1 cup beef broth
- 2 tbsp chili powder
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 8 oz elbow macaroni
- Optional toppings: shredded cheese, sour cream, chopped green onions

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Drain excess fat.
2. Add onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, kidney beans, beef broth, chili powder, cumin, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
4. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
5. Stir in elbow macaroni. Increase heat to medium-low, cover, and continue to cook for 15-20 minutes, or until macaroni is tender, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Add a little more broth or water if the chili becomes too thick.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot with your favorite toppings.

name: Beef and noodles with gravy
description:
A classic comfort food featuring tender beef and al dente noodles generously coated in a rich, savory gravy, perfect for a hearty and warming meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cups beef broth
- 1 tsp dried thyme
- 1 bay leaf
- 8 oz egg noodles or wide pasta
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour (for gravy)
- 1/4 cup cold water (for gravy)
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat beef cubes dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in batches on all sides. Remove beef and set aside.
3. Add onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Deglaze the pot with a splash of beef broth, scraping up any browned bits.
4. Return beef to the pot. Add remaining beef broth, thyme, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
5. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, or until beef is very tender. Remove bay leaf.
6. Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain.
7. To make gravy: In a small bowl, whisk together flour and cold water until smooth. Slowly whisk this slurry into the simmering beef and liquid. Cook, stirring constantly, until the gravy thickens to your desired consistency.
8. Add cooked noodles to the pot and stir to coat everything in the gravy. Heat through gently. Taste and adjust seasonings.
9. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.

name: Beef and noodles with cream or white sauce
description:
A comforting and creamy dish featuring tender beef and al dente noodles, all enveloped in a rich, smooth white or cream sauce, offering a delightful texture and flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin or round steak, thinly sliced or cubed
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 8 oz egg noodles or wide pasta
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups milk or half-and-half
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh chives or parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
2. While noodles cook, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add beef and cook until browned and cooked through. Remove beef and set aside.
3. Add onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute to create a roux.
5. Gradually whisk in milk or half-and-half. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Stir in garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
6. Return beef to the skillet. Add cooked noodles and toss everything together to combine and coat in the sauce. Heat through gently.
7. Garnish with fresh chives or parsley and serve immediately.

name: Beef stroganoff with noodles
description:
A classic Russian-inspired dish featuring tender strips of beef and mushrooms in a rich, creamy sour cream sauce, traditionally served over egg noodles.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin or tenderloin, thinly sliced
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 8 oz sliced mushrooms
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1.5 cups beef broth
- 1 tbsp Dijon mustard
- 1/2 cup sour cream
- 8 oz egg noodles
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
2. While noodles cook, pat beef slices dry and season with salt and pepper.
3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add beef in batches and cook quickly until browned. Remove beef and set aside.
4. Add onion and mushrooms to the skillet. Cook until softened and mushrooms are browned, about 5-7 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
5. Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and stir for 1 minute.
6. Gradually whisk in beef broth and Dijon mustard. Bring to a simmer, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
7. Reduce heat to low. Stir in sour cream until well combined (do not boil after adding sour cream).
8. Return beef to the skillet. Stir to combine and heat through gently. Taste and adjust seasonings.
9. Serve hot over cooked egg noodles, garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Beef and noodles with mushroom sauce
description:
A savory and comforting dish featuring tender beef and al dente noodles, all coated in a rich, earthy mushroom sauce, perfect for a hearty meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin or round steak, thinly sliced or cubed
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 8 oz sliced mushrooms
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups beef broth
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme
- 8 oz egg noodles or wide pasta
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
2. While noodles cook, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add beef and cook until browned and cooked through. Remove beef and set aside.
3. Add onion and mushrooms to the skillet. Cook until softened and mushrooms are browned, about 5-7 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
4. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute to create a roux.
5. Gradually whisk in beef broth and thyme. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens.
6. Return beef to the skillet. Add cooked noodles and toss everything together to combine and coat in the sauce. Heat through gently. Season with salt and pepper.
7. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

name: Beef and noodles with soy-based sauce
description:
A flavorful Asian-inspired dish featuring tender beef strips and al dente noodles, stir-fried and coated in a savory soy-based sauce, often with a hint of ginger and garlic.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
- 8 oz egg noodles or ramen noodles
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, thinly sliced
- 1 red bell pepper, thinly sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
- For the sauce: 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp oyster sauce (optional), 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
- Sesame seeds and chopped green onions for garnish

Instructions:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), rice vinegar, brown sugar, and cornstarch slurry to make the sauce.
3. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add beef in batches and stir-fry quickly until browned. Remove beef and set aside.
4. Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the skillet. Add onion and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until slightly tender-crisp. Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute more.
5. Return beef to the skillet. Add cooked noodles and pour the sauce over everything. Toss to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce thickens and coats the noodles and beef.
6. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions and serve immediately.

name: Beef and rice, no sauce
description:
A simple and wholesome dish featuring tender pieces of beef and fluffy rice, often stir-fried or pan-cooked together with minimal seasoning for a clean, savory taste.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb beef sirloin or round steak, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
- 2 cups cooked white rice
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh cilantro or green onions, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Pat beef cubes dry and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
2. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add beef in batches and cook quickly until browned and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per batch. Remove beef and set aside.
3. Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the skillet. Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
4. Add cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps.
5. Return beef to the skillet. Toss everything together to combine and heat through. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed.
6. Garnish with fresh cilantro or green onions and serve immediately.

name: Biryani with meat
description:
A fragrant and elaborate South Asian rice dish, where basmati rice is layered with marinated meat (often chicken, lamb, or beef), aromatic spices, and sometimes vegetables, then slow-cooked to perfection.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus marinating time)

Ingredients:
- 1 lb boneless meat (chicken, lamb, or beef), cut into 1-inch pieces
- 1 cup basmati rice
