2. In a separate bowl, whisk together all sauce ingredients (beef broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, cornstarch slurry). Set aside.
3. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat. Add beef in batches and stir-fry quickly until browned. Remove and set aside.
4. Add remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the wok. Add bell pepper, broccoli, carrots, and onion. Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
5. Add minced garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
6. Return beef to the wok. Pour the sauce over everything. Toss constantly for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats all ingredients. Serve immediately, often with rice.

name: Beef and vegetables including carrots, broccoli, and/or dark-green leafy; no potatoes, gravy
description:
A hearty and comforting meal featuring tender beef and a vibrant mix of nutrient-rich vegetables like carrots, broccoli, or dark-green leafy greens, all served with a rich, savory gravy without potatoes.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 2 carrots, sliced
- 1 cup broccoli florets
- 1 cup chopped kale or spinach
- For the Gravy:
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups beef broth
- 1/2 cup red wine (optional)
- 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 tsp dried thyme

Instructions:
1. Season beef cubes with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven or pot over medium-high heat. Brown beef in batches, then remove and set aside.
2. Add onion to the pot and sauté until softened. Stir in thyme. Return beef to the pot. Pour in beef broth and red wine (if using). Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 1.5 hours, or until beef is nearly tender.
3. In a small bowl, melt butter. Whisk in flour to make a roux. Slowly whisk the roux into the simmering beef mixture until gravy thickens. Stir in Worcestershire sauce.
4. Add carrots, broccoli, and kale/spinach. Continue to cook, covered, for another 15-20 minutes, or until all vegetables are tender and beef is cooked through. Adjust seasoning as needed. Serve warm.

name: Beef and vegetables excluding carrots, broccoli, and dark-green leafy; no potatoes, gravy
description:
A hearty and comforting meal featuring tender beef and a selection of non-cruciferous, non-dark leafy vegetables, all served with a rich, savory gravy without potatoes.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 1 cup green beans, trimmed
- 1 cup peas (fresh or frozen)
- 1 cup sliced mushrooms
- For the Gravy:
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups beef broth
- 1/2 cup red wine (optional)
- 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 tsp dried rosemary

Instructions:
1. Season beef cubes with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven or pot over medium-high heat. Brown beef in batches, then remove and set aside.
2. Add onion to the pot and sauté until softened. Stir in rosemary. Return beef to the pot. Pour in beef broth and red wine (if using). Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 1.5 hours, or until beef is nearly tender.
3. In a small bowl, melt butter. Whisk in flour to make a roux. Slowly whisk the roux into the simmering beef mixture until gravy thickens. Stir in Worcestershire sauce.
4. Add green beans, peas, and sliced mushrooms. Continue to cook, covered, for another 15-20 minutes, or until all vegetables are tender and beef is cooked through. Adjust seasoning as needed. Serve warm.

name: Beef steak with onions, Puerto Rican style
description:
A classic Puerto Rican dish, Bistec Encebollado features thin, tender beef steaks marinated and then pan-fried or braised with a generous amount of caramelized onions, creating a savory and aromatic meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus marinating time)

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs beef round steak or sirloin, thinly sliced (about 4-6 pieces)
- 2 large onions, thinly sliced
- 1/4 cup white vinegar
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp cumin
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh cilantro, chopped (for garnish)

Instructions:
1. Season beef steaks generously with salt, pepper, oregano, cumin, and minced garlic. Place sliced onions over the steaks and pour white vinegar over everything. Marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or cast-iron pan over medium-high heat. Remove steaks from marinade (reserving onions and marinade). Sear steaks for 2-3 minutes per side until browned.
3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add the reserved sliced onions and marinade to the skillet. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until beef is tender and onions are caramelized. If desired, add a splash of water or beef broth if the sauce gets too thick.
4. Adjust seasoning as needed. Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, often with rice and beans.

name: Cabbage with ham hocks
description:
A soulful and comforting Southern classic, cabbage with ham hocks features tender, slow-cooked cabbage infused with the smoky, savory flavor of ham hocks, creating a deeply satisfying side or main dish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus ham hock cooking time)

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs green cabbage, cored and chopped
- 1-2 smoked ham hocks
- 6 cups water or chicken broth
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes (optional)
- 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a large Dutch oven or pot, combine ham hocks and water/broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, or until ham hocks are very tender.
2. Remove ham hocks from the pot. Let cool slightly, then shred the meat from the bones and discard bones and skin. Set shredded ham aside.
3. Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and red pepper flakes (if using) to the pot with the broth. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
4. Add chopped cabbage to the pot. It may seem like a lot, but it will cook down. Stir to combine. Cover and cook for 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender.
5. Stir in the shredded ham hock meat and apple cider vinegar. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

name: Ham or pork salad
description:
A versatile and flavorful salad, ham or pork salad features diced cooked ham or pork mixed with creamy mayonnaise, crisp celery, and often other seasonings, perfect for sandwiches or as a light meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups cooked ham or pork, finely diced
- 1/2 cup mayonnaise
- 1/4 cup finely chopped celery
- 2 tbsp finely chopped red onion (optional)
- 1 tbsp Dijon mustard (optional)
- 1 tbsp sweet pickle relish (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Lettuce leaves or bread (for serving)

Instructions:
1. In a medium bowl, combine diced ham or pork, mayonnaise, chopped celery, and red onion (if using).
2. Add Dijon mustard and sweet pickle relish (if using). Stir gently until all ingredients are well combined.
3. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Chill for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
4. Serve cold on lettuce leaves, crackers, or as a sandwich filling.

name: Frankfurters or hot dogs and sauerkraut
description:
A classic and comforting combination, frankfurters or hot dogs are typically simmered or grilled and served alongside tangy, fermented sauerkraut, offering a simple yet satisfying meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 10-15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4-6 frankfurters or hot dogs
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil (for grilling/pan-frying, optional)
- 1 can (14.5 oz) sauerkraut, drained and rinsed (optional)
- 1/2 cup chopped onion (optional)
- 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (optional, for simmering sauerkraut)
- Hot dog buns (for serving)
- Mustard or other condiments (for serving)

Instructions:
1. For the hot dogs: Grill, pan-fry, or boil frankfurters/hot dogs until heated through and lightly browned, according to preference.
2. For the sauerkraut (optional, but classic): In a saucepan, heat a small amount of oil (if desired). Add chopped onion and sauté until softened. Add drained sauerkraut and chicken/vegetable broth. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until heated through and flavors meld.
3. Serve hot dogs in buns, topped generously with warm sauerkraut and your favorite condiments like mustard.

name: Pork and vegetables including carrots, broccoli, and/or dark-green leafy; no potatoes, no sauce
description:
A lean and flavorful meal featuring tender pork and a vibrant mix of nutrient-rich vegetables like carrots, broccoli, or dark-green leafy greens, prepared simply without potatoes or any added sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork loin or tenderloin, thinly sliced
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 2 carrots, julienned or thinly sliced
- 1 cup broccoli florets
- 1 cup chopped kale or spinach
- 1 large onion, thinly sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme

Instructions:
1. Season pork slices with salt, pepper, and thyme.
2. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add pork in batches and stir-fry quickly until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
3. Add remaining 1 tbsp olive oil to the skillet. Add julienned carrots, broccoli florets, and sliced onion. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
4. Add minced garlic and chopped kale/spinach. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until greens are wilted. Return pork to the skillet and toss everything together to heat through.
5. Adjust seasoning as needed. Serve immediately.

name: Greens with ham or pork
description:
A comforting Southern-inspired dish featuring tender, slow-cooked leafy greens infused with the savory, smoky flavor of ham or pork.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs collard greens (or mustard/turnip greens), washed and chopped
- 1 lb smoked ham hock or pork neck bones
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 4 cups chicken or vegetable broth
- 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar
- 1 tsp red pepper flakes (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a large pot or Dutch oven, combine the ham hock/pork neck bones, chopped onion, minced garlic, broth, and red pepper flakes.
2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1 hour to tenderize the meat and build flavor.
3. Add the chopped greens to the pot, stirring to submerge them in the liquid. They will wilt down.
4. Cover and continue to simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the greens are very tender.
5. Remove the ham hock/pork neck bones, pull off any meat, shred it, and return to the pot. Discard bones.
6. Stir in the apple cider vinegar and season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve hot, often with a splash of hot sauce.

name: Pork, tofu, and vegetables including carrots, broccoli, and/or dark-green leafy; no potatoes, soy-base sauce
description:
A wholesome and flavorful stir-fry combining tender pork, soft tofu, and a vibrant medley of fresh vegetables, all coated in a savory soy-based sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork loin or tenderloin, thinly sliced
- 1 block (14 oz) firm tofu, pressed and cubed
- 1 cup broccoli florets
- 1 cup sliced carrots
- 1 cup chopped dark-green leafy vegetables (e.g., bok choy, spinach)
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp oyster sauce (optional)
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tbsp cornstarch
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), rice vinegar, sesame oil, cornstarch, and chicken broth to create the sauce.
2. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add tofu cubes and cook until golden brown on all sides. Remove and set aside.
3. Add the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the skillet. Add sliced pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
4. Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
5. Add broccoli and carrots, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until slightly tender-crisp.
6. Add the dark-green leafy vegetables and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until wilted.
7. Return the cooked pork and tofu to the skillet.
8. Pour the prepared sauce over the ingredients, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
9. Serve immediately.

name: Pork and vegetables, Hawaiian style
description:
A tropical and savory dish featuring tender pork and a colorful array of vegetables, often with a sweet and tangy pineapple-infused sauce, reminiscent of Hawaiian flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 bell pepper (any color), chopped
- 1 cup pineapple chunks (fresh or canned, drained)
- 1/2 cup pineapple juice
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Season pork cubes with salt and pepper.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the pork cubes on all sides. Remove pork and set aside.
3. Add chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. In a bowl, whisk together pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar.
5. Return pork to the skillet. Pour the sauce over the pork and vegetables. Bring to a simmer.
6. Reduce heat, cover, and cook for 45-60 minutes, or until pork is tender.
7. Stir in the pineapple chunks and the cornstarch slurry. Cook, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
8. Serve hot, often over rice.

name: Pork and watercress with soy-based sauce
description:
A light and refreshing stir-fry combining tender slices of pork with the peppery bite of fresh watercress, all brought together by a savory soy-based sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork loin or tenderloin, thinly sliced
- 2 bunches watercress, tough stems removed, washed
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp rice wine or dry sherry
- 1 tsp sugar
- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 1/4 cup chicken broth
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, cornstarch, and chicken broth to make the sauce.
2. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add sliced pork and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
3. Add the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the skillet. Add minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
4. Add the watercress to the skillet and stir-fry quickly for 1-2 minutes until just wilted but still vibrant.
5. Return the cooked pork to the skillet.
6. Pour the prepared sauce over the pork and watercress, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
7. Serve immediately.

name: Kung Pao pork
description:
A fiery and flavorful Szechuan dish featuring tender cubes of pork, peanuts, and chili peppers, all tossed in a sweet, sour, and spicy sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork loin or shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp rice wine or dry sherry
- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1/2 cup roasted peanuts
- 6-8 dried red chilies, whole or cut in half
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated
- 2 green onions, sliced (white and green parts separated)
- For the sauce:
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp black vinegar or rice vinegar
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 1/4 cup chicken broth

Instructions:
1. Marinate pork cubes with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice wine, and 1 tsp cornstarch for 15 minutes.
2. Whisk together all sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
3. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add marinated pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
4. Add remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the wok. Add dried red chilies and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant (be careful not to burn).
5. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and white parts of green onions. Stir-fry for 30 seconds.
6. Return pork to the wok. Add peanuts.
7. Pour the prepared sauce over the ingredients, stirring quickly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
8. Stir in the green parts of the green onions.
9. Serve immediately.

name: Moo Shu pork, without Chinese pancake
description:
A savory and aromatic stir-fry featuring shredded pork, scrambled eggs, and a medley of vegetables like cabbage and mushrooms, typically served without the traditional pancakes.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork loin or shoulder, thinly sliced or shredded
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp rice wine or dry sherry
- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 2 eggs, beaten
- 4 cups shredded cabbage
- 1 cup sliced shiitake mushrooms
- 1/2 cup sliced bamboo shoots
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated
- 2 green onions, sliced
- For the sauce:
- 2 tbsp hoisin sauce
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp sugar
- 1/4 cup chicken broth

Instructions:
1. Marinate pork with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice wine, and 1 tsp cornstarch for 15 minutes.
2. Whisk together all sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
3. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Pour in beaten eggs and scramble until cooked. Remove and chop into small pieces. Set aside.
4. Add remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the wok over medium-high heat. Add marinated pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
5. Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the wok and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
6. Add shredded cabbage, mushrooms, and bamboo shoots. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
7. Return pork and scrambled eggs to the wok. Add green onions.
8. Pour the prepared sauce over the ingredients, stirring quickly until everything is well coated.
9. Serve immediately.

name: Pork and onions with soy-based sauce
description:
A simple yet satisfying stir-fry where tender slices of pork are cooked with sweet, caramelized onions and coated in a savory soy-based sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork loin or shoulder, thinly sliced
- 2 large onions, thinly sliced
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp rice wine or dry sherry
- 1 tsp sugar
- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 1/4 cup chicken broth
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, rice wine, sugar, cornstarch, and chicken broth to make the sauce.
2. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add sliced pork and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
3. Add the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the skillet. Add sliced onions and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized, about 8-10 minutes.
4. Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
5. Return the cooked pork to the skillet with the onions.
6. Pour the prepared sauce over the ingredients, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
7. Serve immediately, often over rice.

name: Pork hash
description:
A hearty and flavorful dish, typically featuring diced or ground pork mixed with potatoes and onions, often pan-fried until crispy and served as a comforting meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground pork or finely diced pork shoulder
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 bell pepper, chopped (optional)
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1/4 cup chicken or beef broth
- Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground or diced pork and cook, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through. Drain excess fat if necessary. Remove pork and set aside.
2. Add chopped onion and bell pepper (if using) to the skillet. Cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
3. Add minced garlic, smoked paprika, and thyme. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
4. Return the cooked pork to the skillet. Stir to combine.
5. Pour in the broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Simmer for a few minutes until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
7. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley. Can be served with a fried egg on top.

name: Ham and vegetables including carrots broccoli, and/or dark- green leafy; no potatoes, no sauce
description:
A simple and wholesome meal combining savory ham with a vibrant mix of fresh vegetables like carrots, broccoli, and leafy greens, cooked without a heavy sauce to let the natural flavors shine.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb cooked ham, diced
- 1 cup broccoli florets
- 1 cup sliced carrots
- 2 cups chopped dark-green leafy vegetables (e.g., kale, spinach)
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add diced ham and cook for 3-5 minutes until lightly browned and heated through. Remove and set aside.
3. Add chopped onion and sliced carrots to the skillet. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until slightly softened.
4. Add broccoli florets and minced garlic. Continue to cook for 3-4 minutes until broccoli is tender-crisp.
5. Add the dark-green leafy vegetables and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
6. Return the ham to the skillet. Stir to combine all ingredients.
7. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. No additional sauce is needed, allowing the natural flavors to come through.
8. Serve immediately.

name: Ham and vegetables excluding carrots, broccoli, and dark-green leafy; no potatoes, no sauce
description:
A straightforward dish featuring savory ham paired with a selection of non-starchy vegetables, cooked simply without a sauce to highlight their natural tastes.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb cooked ham, diced
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 bell pepper (any color), chopped
- 1 cup sliced zucchini or yellow squash
- 1 cup sliced mushrooms
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add diced ham and cook for 3-5 minutes until lightly browned and heated through. Remove and set aside.
3. Add chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until softened.
4. Add sliced zucchini/squash, mushrooms, and minced garlic. Continue to cook for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
5. Return the ham to the skillet. Stir to combine all ingredients.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

name: Pork and vegetables excluding carrots, broccoli, and dark-green leafy; no potatoes, no sauce
description:
A clean and simple preparation of tender pork combined with a variety of non-starchy vegetables, cooked without a sauce to emphasize their inherent flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 lb pork loin or tenderloin, thinly sliced
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 bell pepper (any color), chopped
- 1 cup sliced zucchini or yellow squash
- 1 cup sliced mushrooms
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add sliced pork and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
3. Add chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until softened.
4. Add sliced zucchini/squash, mushrooms, and minced garlic. Continue to cook for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
5. Return the pork to the skillet. Stir to combine all ingredients.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

name: Pork, tofu, and vegetables, excluding carrots, broccoli, and dark-green leafy; no potatoes, soy-based sauce
description:
A savory stir-fry featuring tender pork, soft tofu, and a colorful mix of non-starchy vegetables, all coated in a rich, umami-packed soy-based sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork loin or tenderloin, thinly sliced
- 1 block (14 oz) firm tofu, pressed and cubed
- 1 cup sliced bell peppers (various colors)
- 1 cup sliced zucchini or yellow squash
- 1 cup sliced mushrooms
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tbsp cornstarch
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, cornstarch, and chicken broth to create the sauce.
2. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add tofu cubes and cook until golden brown on all sides. Remove and set aside.
3. Add the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the skillet. Add sliced pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
4. Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
5. Add bell peppers, zucchini/squash, and mushrooms. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
6. Return the cooked pork and tofu to the skillet.
7. Pour the prepared sauce over the ingredients, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
8. Serve immediately.

name: Pork chow mein or chop suey, no noodles
description:
A flavorful Chinese-American stir-fry featuring tender pork and a medley of crisp vegetables, all tossed in a savory sauce, served without the traditional noodles.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pork loin or shoulder, thinly sliced
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp rice wine or dry sherry
- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 4 cups mixed stir-fry vegetables (e.g., cabbage, celery, bean sprouts, bell peppers, mushrooms)
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated
- For the sauce:
- 1/4 cup chicken broth
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp oyster sauce (optional)
- 1 tsp sugar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tbsp cornstarch

Instructions:
1. Marinate pork with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice wine, and 1 tsp cornstarch for 15 minutes.
2. Whisk together all sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
3. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add marinated pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
4. Add remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the wok. Add minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
5. Add mixed stir-fry vegetables and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp.
6. Return pork to the wok.
7. Pour the prepared sauce over the ingredients, stirring quickly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
8. Serve immediately.

name: Pork and vegetables including carrots, broccoli, and/or dark-green leafy; no potatoes, tomato-based sauce
description:
A hearty and wholesome dish featuring tender pork and a colorful assortment of fresh vegetables like carrots, broccoli, and leafy greens, all simmered in a rich, savory tomato-based sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb pork shoulder or loin, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes, undrained
- 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth
- 1 tbsp tomato paste
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp dried basil
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 cup broccoli florets
- 1 cup sliced carrots
- 2 cups chopped dark-green leafy vegetables (e.g., spinach, kale)

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add pork cubes and brown on all sides. Remove pork and set aside.
2. Add chopped onion to the pot and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
4. Stir in diced tomatoes, broth, tomato paste, oregano, and basil. Bring to a simmer.

- 1 tbsp oyster sauce (optional)
- 1 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1 tbsp cornstarch
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 inch ginger, grated

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), rice vinegar, sesame oil, cornstarch, and chicken broth to create the sauce.
2. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add sliced pork and stir-fry until browned and cooked through. Remove and set aside.

4. Add broccoli and carrots, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until slightly tender-crisp.
5. Add the dark-green leafy vegetables and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until wilted.
6. Return the cooked pork to the skillet.
7. Pour the prepared sauce over the ingredients, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens and coats everything.
8. Serve immediately.

name: Pork shish kabob with vegetables, excluding potatoes
description:
Flavorful skewers of marinated pork cubes grilled to perfection alongside a colorful assortment of crisp vegetables, offering a delightful smoky taste.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus marinating time)

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs pork loin or shoulder, cut into 1.5-inch cubes
- 1/4 cup olive oil
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 large bell pepper (any color), cut into 1.5-inch pieces
- 1 large onion, cut into 1.5-inch pieces
- 1 cup cherry tomatoes
- 1 cup zucchini or mushroom chunks
- Wooden or metal skewers

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper. Add pork cubes and toss to coat. Marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours in the refrigerator.
2. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
3. Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
4. Thread the marinated pork and vegetables alternately onto the skewers.
5. Grill the kabobs for 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until pork is cooked through and vegetables are tender-crisp and lightly charred. Internal temperature of pork should reach 145°F (63°C).
6. Serve hot.

name: Chicken or turkey and vegetables including carrots, broccoli, and/or dark-green leafy; no potatoes, cheese sauce
description:
A comforting and savory dish featuring tender chicken or turkey and a vibrant mix of carrots, broccoli, and leafy greens, all smothered in a rich, creamy cheese sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken or turkey breast, cut into 1-inch pieces
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 cup broccoli florets
- 1 cup sliced carrots
- 2 cups chopped dark-green leafy vegetables (e.g., spinach, kale)
- For the cheese sauce:
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups milk (whole or 2%)
- 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
- 1/4 tsp nutmeg (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken or turkey pieces and cook until browned and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
2. Add chopped onion and sliced carrots to the skillet. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until slightly softened.
3. Add broccoli florets and minced garlic. Continue to cook for 3-4 minutes until broccoli is tender-crisp.
4. Add the dark-green leafy vegetables and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Remove all vegetables and set aside with the chicken/turkey.
5. To make the cheese sauce: In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to form a roux.
6. Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly to prevent lumps. Bring to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5-7 minutes.
7. Remove from heat. Stir in shredded cheddar cheese, nutmeg (if using), salt, and pepper until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.
8. Return the cooked chicken/turkey and vegetables to the skillet with the cheese sauce. Stir to coat everything.
9. Serve hot.

name: Fish, tofu, and vegetables, tempura
description:

Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb firm white fish fillets (e.g., cod, snapper), cut into 2-inch pieces
- 1 block (14 oz) firm tofu, pressed and cut into 1-inch slices
- Assorted vegetables (e.g., bell pepper strips, zucchini slices, mushroom caps, green beans)
- Vegetable oil for deep frying
- For the tempura batter:
- 1 cup ice-cold water
- 1 large egg yolk
- 1 cup all-purpose flour (or tempura flour)

Instructions:
1. Prepare the batter: In a medium bowl, whisk together ice-cold water and egg yolk. Gently fold in the flour until just combined; a few lumps are fine. Do not overmix.

3. Dip fish, tofu, and vegetables one by one into the tempura batter, allowing excess to drip off.
4. Carefully place battered items into the hot oil, frying in small batches to avoid overcrowding. Fry for 2-4 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy.
5. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a wire rack lined with paper towels.
6. Serve immediately with dipping sauce (e.g., soy sauce, ponzu, or tempura dipping sauce).

- 1 cup cooked mixed seafood (e.g., shrimp, crab, calamari), chopped
- 1/2 cup sliced cucumber
- 1/4 cup sliced red onion
- 1/4 cup sliced bell pepper (any color)
- 1/4 cup sliced radishes
- 1/4 cup chopped celery

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine mixed salad greens, chopped mixed seafood, sliced cucumber, red onion, bell pepper, radishes, and celery.
2. Toss gently to combine all ingredients.
3. Serve immediately, without dressing, allowing guests to add their preferred dressing if desired.

name: Seafood garden salad with seafood, lettuce, tomato and/or carrots, other vegetables, no dressing
description:
A vibrant and refreshing garden salad featuring a delightful mix of seafood, crisp lettuce, juicy tomatoes, crisp carrots, and a medley of other fresh vegetables, served undressed.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups mixed salad greens (e.g., romaine, spring mix)
- 1 cup cooked mixed seafood (e.g., shrimp, crab, calamari), chopped
- 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
- 1/2 cup shredded carrots
- 1/2 cup sliced cucumber
- 1/4 cup sliced red onion
- 1/4 cup sliced bell pepper (any color)

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine mixed salad greens, chopped mixed seafood, cherry tomatoes, shredded carrots, sliced cucumber, red onion, and bell pepper.
2. Toss gently to combine all ingredients.
3. Serve immediately, without dressing, allowing guests to add their preferred dressing if desired.

name: Seafood garden salad with seafood, lettuce, eggs, vegetables excluding tomato and carrots, no dressing
description:
A protein-rich and refreshing garden salad featuring a delightful mix of seafood, crisp lettuce, hard-boiled eggs, and a variety of fresh vegetables (excluding tomatoes and carrots), served undressed.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups mixed salad greens (e.g., romaine, spring mix)
- 1 cup cooked mixed seafood (e.g., shrimp, crab, calamari), chopped
- 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced or quartered
- 1/2 cup sliced cucumber
- 1/4 cup sliced red onion
- 1/4 cup sliced bell pepper (any color)
- 1/4 cup sliced radishes

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine mixed salad greens, chopped mixed seafood, hard-boiled eggs, sliced cucumber, red onion, bell pepper, and radishes.
2. Toss gently to combine all ingredients.
3. Serve immediately, without dressing, allowing guests to add their preferred dressing if desired.

name: Seafood garden salad with seafood, lettuce, eggs, tomato and/or carrots, other vegetables, no dressing
description:
A hearty and vibrant garden salad featuring a delightful mix of seafood, crisp lettuce, hard-boiled eggs, juicy tomatoes, crisp carrots, and a medley of other fresh vegetables, served undressed.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups mixed salad greens (e.g., romaine, spring mix)
- 1 cup cooked mixed seafood (e.g., shrimp, crab, calamari), chopped
