name: Muffin, cheese
description:
Savory and satisfying, cheese muffins are infused with sharp cheddar or other cheeses, offering a delightful salty tang and a wonderfully moist crumb, perfect with soups or as a snack.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12 muffins
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
- 1 large egg
- 1 cup milk
- 1/4 cup melted unsalted butter

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners or grease well.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper.
3. Stir in the shredded cheese.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, milk, and melted butter.
5. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Fill muffin cups about 2/3 full.
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and cheese is bubbly.
8. Let cool in the tin for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

name: Muffin, pumpkin
description:
Warmly spiced and incredibly moist, pumpkin muffins are a seasonal delight, infused with pumpkin puree and aromatic spices like cinnamon and nutmeg, perfect for autumn.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12 muffins
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tbsp pumpkin pie spice
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1 cup pumpkin puree
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners or grease well.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugars, pumpkin pie spice, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, pumpkin puree, milk, and vegetable oil.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
5. Fill muffin cups about 2/3 full.
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the tin for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

name: Muffin, zucchini
description:
Surprisingly moist and subtly sweet, zucchini muffins are a delicious way to enjoy this versatile vegetable, often spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg, and sometimes studded with nuts.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12 muffins
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- 1 1/2 cups grated zucchini (squeezed dry)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners or grease well.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugars, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, milk, and vegetable oil.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in the grated zucchini. Do not overmix.
5. Fill muffin cups about 2/3 full.
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the tin for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

name: Muffin, carrot
description:
Sweet and wholesome, carrot muffins are packed with grated carrots, warm spices, and often nuts or raisins, offering a moist, flavorful, and nutritious treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12 muffins
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- 1 1/2 cups grated carrots

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners or grease well.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugars, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, milk, and vegetable oil.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in the grated carrots. Do not overmix.
5. Fill muffin cups about 2/3 full.
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the tin for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

name: Popover
description:
Light, airy, and dramatically puffed, popovers are a delightful baked good with a crisp golden crust and a hollow, steamy interior, perfect for soaking up gravies or butter.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-12 popovers
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 large eggs
- 1 cup milk
- 1 tbsp melted butter (plus more for greasing)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Generously grease a 6-cup popover pan or a 12-cup muffin tin.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined.
4. Gradually pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, whisking constantly until the batter is smooth and free of lumps. Do not overmix.
5. Fill each popover cup about 2/3 full.
6. Bake for 20 minutes at 450°F (230°C), then reduce oven temperature to 350°F (175°C) and bake for another 15-20 minutes, or until deeply golden brown and puffed. Do NOT open the oven door during baking.
7. Remove from oven and immediately remove popovers from the pan to prevent them from getting soggy. Serve warm.

name: Bread, Boston Brown
description:
A dense, moist, and subtly sweet bread, Boston Brown Bread is traditionally steamed in a can, featuring a blend of flours, molasses, and often raisins, offering a unique texture and flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10 slices
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup rye flour
- 1/2 cup cornmeal
- 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup molasses
- 1 cup buttermilk
- 1/2 cup raisins (optional)

Instructions:
1. Generously grease a 1-pound coffee can or a 2-quart heatproof mold. Line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together rye flour, cornmeal, whole wheat flour, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together molasses and buttermilk.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Stir in raisins if using.
5. Pour the batter into the prepared can, filling it no more than 2/3 full.
6. Cover the top of the can tightly with aluminum foil.
7. Place the can on a rack in a large pot with a tight-fitting lid. Pour boiling water into the pot until it comes halfway up the sides of the can.
8. Bring the water to a simmer, cover the pot, and steam for 3 hours, replenishing water as needed.
9. Carefully remove the can from the pot. Let cool for 10 minutes before inverting the bread onto a wire rack. Slice and serve warm.

name: Bread, nut
description:
A delightful quick bread, nut bread is moist, slightly sweet, and generously studded with chopped nuts like walnuts or pecans, offering a satisfying crunch and earthy flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1 cup buttermilk
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- 1 cup chopped walnuts or pecans

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, buttermilk, and vegetable oil.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in the chopped nuts. Do not overmix.
5. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan.
6. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice and serve.

name: Bread, pumpkin
description:
A quintessential autumn treat, pumpkin bread is a moist, warmly spiced quick bread, infused with pumpkin puree and aromatic spices, often studded with nuts or chocolate chips.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tbsp pumpkin pie spice
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 large eggs
- 1 cup pumpkin puree
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugars, pumpkin pie spice, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, pumpkin puree, and vegetable oil.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
5. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan.
6. Bake for 55-65 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice and serve.

name: Bread, fruit
description:
A delightful quick bread, fruit bread is moist and tender, packed with dried or fresh fruits like cranberries, raisins, or apples, offering bursts of sweetness and texture.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1 cup buttermilk
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- 1 cup mixed dried fruit (e.g., raisins, cranberries, chopped apricots)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, buttermilk, and vegetable oil.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in the dried fruit. Do not overmix.
5. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan.
6. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice and serve.

name: Bread, zucchini
description:
A wonderfully moist and flavorful quick bread, zucchini bread is a popular way to use garden zucchini, often spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg, and sometimes includes nuts.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 large eggs
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 1 1/2 cups grated zucchini (squeezed dry)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugars, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and vegetable oil.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in the grated zucchini. Do not overmix.
5. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan.
6. Bake for 55-65 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice and serve.

name: Bread, Irish soda
description:
A rustic and hearty quick bread, Irish soda bread is characterized by its dense crumb, slightly tangy flavor from buttermilk, and a signature cross cut on top, traditionally made with just four ingredients.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10 slices
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 3/4 cups buttermilk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly flour a baking sheet.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
3. Make a well in the center and pour in the buttermilk. Mix with your hands or a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms. Do not overmix.
4. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently knead for 1-2 minutes until it just comes together into a round loaf. Do not overwork the dough.
5. Place the loaf on the prepared baking sheet. Using a sharp knife, cut a deep 'X' into the top of the loaf, extending almost to the edges.
6. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the bottom sounds hollow when tapped.
7. Let cool on a wire rack before slicing and serving. Best served warm with butter.

name: Cake or cupcake, NFS
description:
A delightful baked dessert, cakes and cupcakes come in endless varieties, from light and airy to rich and dense, often adorned with frosting and decorations, perfect for celebrations or a sweet treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the milk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
7. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost as desired.

name: Cake, angel food
description:
A heavenly light and airy cake, angel food cake is made primarily from egg whites, sugar, and flour, resulting in a delicate, cloud-like texture and a subtle sweetness.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 slices
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar, divided
- 1 cup cake flour, sifted
- 1 1/2 cups egg whites (from 10-12 large eggs), at room temperature
- 1 1/2 tsp cream of tartar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Do NOT grease a 10-inch tube pan (angel food cake pan).
2. In a small bowl, combine 3/4 cup of the granulated sugar with the sifted cake flour. Set aside.
3. In a large bowl, beat egg whites with an electric mixer on medium speed until foamy. Add cream of tartar and salt; continue beating until soft peaks form.
4. Gradually add the remaining 3/4 cup granulated sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating on high speed until stiff, glossy peaks form.
5. Gently fold in the vanilla extract.
6. Sift about 1/4 of the flour mixture over the egg whites and gently fold in. Repeat with remaining flour mixture in 3 additions, folding until just combined.
7. Pour batter into the ungreased tube pan and gently smooth the top.
8. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until the top springs back when lightly touched and is golden brown.
9. Immediately invert the pan onto its feet (or over a bottle neck) and let cool completely (at least 1.5-2 hours) before removing from the pan. Run a thin knife around the edges to release.

name: Cake or cupcake, apple
description:
Moist and fragrant, apple cake or cupcakes are infused with the sweet-tart flavor of fresh apples, often spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg, creating a comforting and delicious treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 large eggs
- 1/2 cup buttermilk
- 2 cups finely diced or grated apples (e.g., Granny Smith, Honeycrisp)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and eggs until light and fluffy.
4. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the buttermilk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined.
5. Gently fold in the diced apples. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
7. Bake cake for 35-40 minutes, or cupcakes for 20-25 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost as desired.

name: Cake or cupcake, banana
description:
Incredibly moist and naturally sweet, banana cake or cupcakes are a delightful way to use ripe bananas, offering a comforting flavor and tender crumb, often topped with cream cheese frosting.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon (optional)
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup mashed ripe bananas (about 2-3 medium)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon (if using).
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract and mashed bananas.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
7. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost with cream cheese frosting if desired.

name: Cake or cupcake, Black Forest
description:
A decadent German classic, Black Forest cake or cupcakes feature layers of rich chocolate cake, whipped cream, and cherries, often with a hint of kirsch (cherry brandy).

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Chocolate Cake:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup hot water
- For Filling & Frosting:
- 2 cups heavy cream, chilled
- 1/4 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 (15 oz) can pitted dark sweet cherries, drained (reserve 2 tbsp juice)
- 2 tbsp kirsch (optional)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans.
2. For Cake: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
3. Add egg, milk, oil, and vanilla; beat until smooth. Stir in hot water until combined.
4. Divide batter between pans. Bake 25-30 minutes, or until a wooden skewer comes out clean. Cool completely.
5. For Filling & Frosting: In a chilled bowl, beat heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla until stiff peaks form.
6. If using kirsch, mix with reserved cherry juice and brush lightly over cooled cake layers.
7. Assemble: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread with a layer of whipped cream, then scatter half the drained cherries. Top with the second cake layer. Cover the entire cake with remaining whipped cream and decorate with remaining cherries.

name: Cake, Boston cream pie
description:
Despite its name, Boston Cream Pie is a cake, featuring two layers of golden sponge cake filled with a rich vanilla pastry cream and topped with a glossy chocolate glaze.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10 slices
Prep Time: 45 minutes (plus chilling time)

Ingredients:
- For Sponge Cake:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup milk
- For Pastry Cream:
- 1 1/2 cups milk
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 3 large egg yolks
- 1/4 cup cornstarch
- 2 tbsp unsalted butter
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- For Chocolate Glaze:
- 1/2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
- 2 tbsp heavy cream
- 1 tbsp unsalted butter

Instructions:
1. For Cake: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans. Prepare cake batter as per 'Cake or cupcake, NFS' recipe instructions. Divide batter between pans and bake for 25-30 minutes. Cool completely.
2. For Pastry Cream: In a saucepan, heat milk until simmering. In a bowl, whisk sugar, egg yolks, and cornstarch. Gradually whisk hot milk into egg mixture. Return to saucepan, cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Remove from heat, stir in butter and vanilla. Cover with plastic wrap directly on surface and chill.
3. For Glaze: In a small saucepan, combine chocolate chips, cream, and butter. Heat over low heat, stirring until melted and smooth.
4. Assemble: Level cooled cake layers if needed. Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread chilled pastry cream evenly over it. Top with the second cake layer. Pour warm chocolate glaze over the top, letting it drip down the sides. Chill until glaze is set.

name: Cake or cupcake, carrot
description:
A beloved classic, carrot cake or cupcakes are wonderfully moist and flavorful, packed with grated carrots, warm spices, and often nuts or raisins, typically topped with a rich cream cheese frosting.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 servings
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tbsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/2 tsp ground ginger
- 1 1/4 cups vegetable oil
- 4 large eggs
- 2 cups grated carrots
- 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or pecans (optional)
- For Cream Cheese Frosting:
- 8 oz cream cheese, softened
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 3-4 cups powdered sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together vegetable oil and eggs.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Fold in grated carrots and nuts (if using). Do not overmix.
5. Pour batter into prepared pans or muffin cups. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 20-25 minutes, or until a wooden skewer comes out clean. Cool completely.
6. For Frosting: Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Gradually add powdered sugar, then vanilla, beating until light and fluffy.
7. Frost cooled cake or cupcakes.

name: Cake or cupcake, coconut
description:
Exotically sweet and wonderfully moist, coconut cake or cupcakes are infused with coconut flavor, often featuring shredded coconut in the batter and a rich coconut frosting.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 servings
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup full-fat coconut milk
- 1 cup shredded sweetened coconut
- For Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting:
- 8 oz cream cheese, softened
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 3-4 cups powdered sugar
- 1/2 tsp coconut extract (optional)
- 1/2 cup shredded sweetened coconut, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the coconut milk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in shredded coconut.
6. Pour batter into prepared pans or muffin cups. Bake cake for 25-30 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer comes out clean. Cool completely.
7. For Frosting: Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Gradually add powdered sugar, then coconut extract (if using), beating until light and fluffy. Frost cooled cake or cupcakes and sprinkle with extra shredded coconut.

name: Cheesecake, plain
description:
A classic dessert, plain cheesecake is rich, creamy, and smooth, with a dense, tangy cream cheese filling baked on a buttery graham cracker crust.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 slices
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Crust:
- 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted
- For Filling:
- 3 (8 oz) packages cream cheese, softened
- 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 4 large eggs
- 1/2 cup sour cream

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Wrap the outside of a 9-inch springform pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil (to prevent water bath leaks).
2. For Crust: Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter. Press firmly into the bottom of the prepared springform pan. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove and let cool.
3. For Filling: In a large bowl, beat softened cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar, then flour, vanilla, and salt.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, mixing until just combined after each addition. Stir in sour cream. Do not overmix once eggs are added.
5. Pour filling over the cooled crust.
6. Place the springform pan in a larger roasting pan. Pour hot water into the roasting pan until it comes halfway up the sides of the springform pan (water bath).
7. Bake for 60-75 minutes, or until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly. Turn off oven, crack door, and let cheesecake cool in oven for 1 hour.
8. Remove from water bath, remove foil, and cool completely on a wire rack. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, before serving.

name: Cheesecake, fruit
description:
A luscious and refreshing dessert, fruit cheesecake features a creamy, tangy filling on a crisp crust, topped with a vibrant layer of fresh or cooked fruit, adding sweetness and brightness.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 slices
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus chilling time)

Ingredients:
- For Crust:
- 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted
- For Filling:
- 3 (8 oz) packages cream cheese, softened
- 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 4 large eggs
- 1/2 cup sour cream
- For Topping:
- 2 cups fresh berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries) or sliced fruit
- 2 tbsp granulated sugar (optional, for macerating fruit)

Instructions:
1. Prepare and bake crust as per 'Cheesecake, plain' recipe. Cool.
2. Prepare cheesecake filling as per 'Cheesecake, plain' recipe. Pour over cooled crust. Bake in a water bath, cool, and chill as directed.
3. For Topping: If using fresh berries, gently toss with 2 tbsp sugar (if desired) and let sit for 15-20 minutes to release juices. Arrange fruit over the chilled cheesecake just before serving.

name: Cheesecake, chocolate
description:
Indulgently rich and decadent, chocolate cheesecake combines the creamy tang of cheesecake with the deep, luxurious flavor of chocolate, often on a chocolate cookie crust.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 slices
Prep Time: 35 minutes (plus chilling time)

Ingredients:
- For Crust:
- 1 1/2 cups chocolate cookie crumbs (e.g., Oreos, crushed)
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted
- For Filling:
- 3 (8 oz) packages cream cheese, softened
- 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 4 large eggs
- 1/2 cup sour cream
- 4 oz semi-sweet chocolate, melted and cooled

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Wrap the outside of a 9-inch springform pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil.
2. For Crust: Combine cookie crumbs, sugar, and melted butter. Press firmly into the bottom of the prepared springform pan. Bake for 10 minutes. Remove and let cool.
3. For Filling: In a large bowl, beat softened cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar, cocoa powder, flour, vanilla, and salt.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, mixing until just combined after each addition. Stir in sour cream and cooled melted chocolate. Do not overmix.
5. Pour filling over the cooled crust. Place the springform pan in a larger roasting pan. Pour hot water into the roasting pan until it comes halfway up the sides of the springform pan (water bath).
6. Bake for 60-75 minutes, or until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly. Turn off oven, crack door, and let cheesecake cool in oven for 1 hour.
7. Remove from water bath, remove foil, and cool completely on a wire rack. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, before serving.

name: Cake or cupcake, chocolate with white icing, bakery
description: A classic bakery treat, this chocolate cake or cupcake features a rich, moist chocolate base generously topped with a smooth, sweet white icing, offering a delightful contrast in flavor and texture.

name: Cake or cupcake, chocolate with white icing, from mix
description: Conveniently prepared from a mix, this chocolate cake or cupcake offers a quick and easy way to enjoy a moist chocolate base topped with a sweet white icing.

name: Cake or cupcake, chocolate with chocolate icing, bakery
description: A double dose of decadence, this bakery chocolate cake or cupcake boasts a rich, moist chocolate base crowned with a luscious, creamy chocolate icing, perfect for true chocolate lovers.

name: Cake or cupcake, chocolate with chocolate icing, from mix
description: A simple and satisfying treat, this chocolate cake or cupcake, made from a mix, features a moist chocolate base and a sweet chocolate icing, offering a quick chocolate fix.

name: Cake or cupcake, chocolate, no icing
description:
A pure and simple pleasure, this chocolate cake or cupcake offers a rich, moist, and deeply flavored chocolate experience, perfect for those who prefer their cake unadorned.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 servings
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 3/4 cups granulated sugar
- 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 large eggs
- 1 cup milk
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup boiling water

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
3. Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla extract to the dry ingredients. Beat on medium speed until well combined.
4. Carefully stir in the boiling water (batter will be thin).
5. Pour batter into prepared pans or muffin cups. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
6. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cake or cupcake, German chocolate
description:
A distinctive and beloved dessert, German chocolate cake or cupcakes feature rich chocolate layers, a unique coconut-pecan frosting, and often a chocolate ganache drizzle.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 40 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Chocolate Cake:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 3/4 cups granulated sugar
- 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp salt
- 2 large eggs
- 1 cup milk
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup boiling water
- For Coconut-Pecan Frosting:
- 1 cup evaporated milk
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 3 large egg yolks, beaten
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/3 cups shredded sweetened coconut
- 1 cup chopped pecans

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans. Prepare chocolate cake batter as per 'Cake or cupcake, chocolate, no icing' recipe. Divide batter between pans and bake for 30-35 minutes. Cool completely.
2. For Frosting: In a saucepan, combine evaporated milk, sugar, butter, and egg yolks. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened (about 12-15 minutes). Remove from heat, stir in vanilla, coconut, and pecans. Let cool completely.
3. Assemble: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread half of the frosting over it. Top with the second cake layer and spread with remaining frosting.

name: Cake or cupcake, gluten free
description:
Specially crafted for those with gluten sensitivities, gluten-free cake or cupcakes offer a delicious and satisfying dessert experience, using alternative flours to achieve a tender crumb.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cups gluten-free all-purpose flour blend (with xanthan gum)
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together gluten-free flour blend, baking powder, and salt.
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the milk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
7. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost as desired.

name: Cake, chocolate, flourless
description:
Intensely rich and fudgy, flourless chocolate cake is a decadent dessert with a dense, almost brownie-like texture, offering a pure and concentrated chocolate flavor, often naturally gluten-free.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10 slices
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 8 oz bittersweet or semi-sweet chocolate, chopped
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 4 large eggs

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease an 8-inch round cake pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. In a heatproof bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water (or microwave), melt chocolate and butter together, stirring until smooth. Remove from heat.
3. Whisk in sugar, cocoa powder, and salt until combined.
4. Whisk in eggs one at a time until the batter is smooth and glossy.
5. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
6. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly soft. A wooden skewer inserted into the center should come out with moist crumbs.
7. Let cool completely in the pan on a wire rack. The cake will sink slightly in the center as it cools. Dust with powdered sugar or serve with berries.

name: Cake, cream
description:
A wonderfully moist and tender cake, cream cake is characterized by the use of heavy cream in the batter, resulting in a rich, delicate crumb and a luxurious texture.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 slices
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 4 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup heavy cream

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 10-inch Bundt pan or two 9-inch round cake pans.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the heavy cream, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared pan(s).
7. Bake Bundt cake for 50-60 minutes, or round cakes for 30-35 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes before inverting onto a wire rack to cool completely. Dust with powdered sugar or glaze as desired.

name: Snack cake, chocolate
description: A convenient and individually portioned treat, chocolate snack cakes are typically moist, sweet, and often topped with a simple frosting or glaze, perfect for a quick indulgence.

name: Snack cake, white
description: A simple and sweet individually portioned treat, white snack cakes are typically light, fluffy, and often topped with a sweet frosting or cream filling, ideal for a quick dessert.

name: Cake, fruit cake
description:
A traditional holiday cake, fruitcake is a dense, rich cake packed with candied or dried fruits, nuts, and often soaked in spirits, known for its long shelf life and complex flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 slices
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup brown sugar
- 4 large eggs
- 1/2 cup molasses
- 1/2 cup orange juice (or brandy/rum)
- 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/2 tsp ground cloves
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 3 cups mixed candied fruit (e.g., cherries, pineapple, citron)
- 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C). Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan or a 9-inch tube pan.
2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in molasses and orange juice (or spirits).
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and salt.
5. Toss the candied fruit and nuts with 1/4 cup of the flour mixture to prevent them from sinking.
6. Gradually add the remaining dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the floured fruit and nuts.
7. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
8. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours (loaf pan) or 2 1/2 to 3 hours (tube pan), or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
9. Let cool completely in the pan. For best flavor, wrap tightly and let age for a few days or weeks, optionally brushing with more spirits periodically.

name: Cake or cupcake, gingerbread
description:
Warmly spiced and deeply flavorful, gingerbread cake or cupcakes are a comforting treat, rich with molasses, ginger, cinnamon, and cloves, perfect for cooler weather.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 9-12 servings
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tbsp ground ginger
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground cloves
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup molasses
- 1/2 cup hot water

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, brown sugar, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, cream together softened butter and egg until light. Stir in molasses.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gradually stir in the hot water until the batter is smooth.
5. Pour batter into the prepared pan or muffin cups.
6. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Serve plain or with a lemon glaze.

name: Ice cream cake
description:
A delightful frozen dessert, ice cream cake typically features layers of cake, ice cream, and often cookies or candies, creating a refreshing and celebratory treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus freezing time)

Ingredients:
- 1 (8-inch) round chocolate cake, baked and cooled (store-bought or homemade)
- 1.5 quarts vanilla ice cream, slightly softened
- 1.5 quarts chocolate ice cream, slightly softened
- 1 cup hot fudge sauce, cooled
- 1 cup crushed chocolate cookies (e.g., Oreos)
- Whipped cream for topping (optional)

Instructions:
1. Line an 8-inch springform pan with parchment paper on the bottom and sides.
2. Slice the cooled chocolate cake horizontally into two equal layers.
3. Place one cake layer in the bottom of the prepared springform pan.
4. Spread the softened vanilla ice cream evenly over the cake layer. Drizzle with half of the hot fudge sauce and sprinkle with half of the crushed cookies. Freeze for 30 minutes.
5. Place the second cake layer on top of the vanilla ice cream layer.
6. Spread the softened chocolate ice cream evenly over the second cake layer. Drizzle with the remaining hot fudge sauce and sprinkle with the remaining crushed cookies.
7. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, until firm.
8. To serve, remove the springform pan sides. Decorate with whipped cream if desired. Slice with a hot knife.

name: Cake, jelly roll
description:
A classic rolled cake, jelly roll (or Swiss roll) features a thin, tender sponge cake baked in a sheet pan, then spread with jam or cream and carefully rolled into a spiral.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10 slices
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 3 large eggs, separated
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar, divided
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup fruit jam or preserves
- Powdered sugar for dusting

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan and line with parchment paper, then grease the parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, beat egg yolks with 1/4 cup granulated sugar and vanilla until thick and pale.
3. In a separate clean bowl, beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 1/4 cup granulated sugar, beating until stiff, glossy peaks form.
4. Gently fold the egg whites into the egg yolk mixture.
5. In a small bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt. Sift the dry ingredients over the egg mixture and gently fold until just combined.
6. Spread batter evenly into the prepared jelly roll pan.
7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown and the cake springs back when lightly touched.
8. While the cake is baking, lay a clean kitchen towel on a flat surface and dust generously with powdered sugar.
9. Immediately invert the hot cake onto the prepared towel. Carefully peel off the parchment paper.
10. Starting from a short end, carefully roll the cake and towel together. Let cool completely in the rolled position on a wire rack.
11. Once cooled, unroll the cake, spread evenly with jam, and re-roll. Dust with more powdered sugar before serving.

name: Cake or cupcake, lemon
description:
Bright and zesty, lemon cake or cupcakes are infused with the refreshing flavor of fresh lemon, offering a light, moist crumb and a delightful tangy sweetness, often topped with a lemon glaze.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup milk
- 2 tbsp lemon zest
- 2 tbsp fresh lemon juice
- For Lemon Glaze (optional):
- 1 cup powdered sugar
- 2-3 tbsp fresh lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the milk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
7. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
9. For Glaze: Whisk powdered sugar and lemon juice until smooth. Drizzle over cooled cake or cupcakes.

name: Cake or cupcake, marble
description:
Visually appealing and delicious, marble cake or cupcakes feature a beautiful swirl of two contrasting batters, typically vanilla and chocolate, offering a delightful blend of flavors in every bite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup milk
- 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 tbsp milk (extra, for chocolate batter)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. Prepare a basic vanilla cake batter as per 'Cake or cupcake, NFS' recipe instructions, stopping before pouring into the pan.
3. Divide the batter in half into two separate bowls.
4. To one half, add the cocoa powder and the extra 1 tbsp milk. Mix until just combined, creating the chocolate batter.
5. Spoon alternating dollops of vanilla and chocolate batter into the prepared pan or muffin cups.
6. Using a knife or skewer, gently swirl the batters together 1-2 times to create a marble effect. Do not overmix.
7. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost as desired.

name: Cake or cupcake, peanut butter
description:
Rich and nutty, peanut butter cake or cupcakes are a dream for peanut butter lovers, featuring a moist crumb infused with creamy peanut butter, often topped with a complementary frosting.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, peanut butter, and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the milk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
7. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost with peanut butter or chocolate frosting if desired.

name: Cake, pound
description:
A classic for its simplicity and rich flavor, pound cake is a dense, buttery cake traditionally made with a pound each of butter, sugar, eggs, and flour, resulting in a fine, moist crumb.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 4 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup milk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan or a 10-inch Bundt pan.
2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
3. Beat in eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in vanilla extract.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the milk to the wet ingredients, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
7. Bake loaf cake for 60-70 minutes, or Bundt cake for 70-80 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes before inverting onto a wire rack to cool completely. Serve plain or with berries.

name: Cake or cupcake, pumpkin
description:
A seasonal favorite, pumpkin cake or cupcakes are wonderfully moist and warmly spiced with cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger, infused with pumpkin puree for a comforting autumn treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 servings
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tbsp pumpkin pie spice
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 large eggs
- 1 cup pumpkin puree
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugars, pumpkin pie spice, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, pumpkin puree, and vegetable oil.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
5. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
6. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost with cream cheese frosting if desired.

name: Cake or cupcake, red velvet
description:
A visually striking and deliciously moist cake, red velvet cake or cupcakes boast a subtle cocoa flavor with a hint of tang from buttermilk, famously colored red and often paired with cream cheese frosting.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 servings
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 cup buttermilk, at room temperature
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 large eggs, at room temperature
- 1 tbsp red food coloring
- 1 tsp white vinegar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- For Cream Cheese Frosting:
- 8 oz cream cheese, softened
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 3-4 cups powdered sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, cream together softened butter and eggs until light and fluffy. Stir in buttermilk, red food coloring, vinegar, and vanilla extract.
4. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
5. Pour batter into prepared pans or muffin cups. Bake cake for 25-30 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer comes out clean. Cool completely.
6. For Frosting: Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Gradually add powdered sugar, then vanilla, beating until light and fluffy.
7. Frost cooled cake or cupcakes.

name: Cake or cupcake, spice
description:
Warm and aromatic, spice cake or cupcakes are a comforting treat, rich with a blend of cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and sometimes ginger, offering a fragrant and moist crumb.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/4 tsp ground cloves
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup buttermilk

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugars, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, baking soda, and salt.
3. In a separate bowl, cream together softened butter and eggs until light and fluffy. Stir in vanilla extract.
4. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the buttermilk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
5. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
6. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
7. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost with cream cheese frosting if desired.

name: Cake, sponge
description:
Light, airy, and delicate, sponge cake is a classic cake made primarily from eggs, sugar, and flour, known for its soft, open texture that readily absorbs syrups or creams.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10 slices
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 large eggs, separated
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar, divided
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour, sifted
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan.
2. In a large bowl, beat egg yolks with 1/4 cup granulated sugar and vanilla until thick and pale.
3. In a separate clean bowl, beat egg whites with salt until soft peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 1/4 cup granulated sugar, beating until stiff, glossy peaks form.
4. Gently fold about one-third of the egg whites into the egg yolk mixture to lighten it, then fold in the remaining egg whites until just combined.
5. Sift the flour over the egg mixture in two additions, gently folding after each addition until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared pan and gently smooth the top.
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and the cake springs back when lightly touched.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before inverting onto a wire rack to cool completely. Serve plain or with fruit and cream.

name: Cake or cupcake, strawberry
description:
Sweet and vibrant, strawberry cake or cupcakes are infused with the fresh flavor of strawberries, often featuring pureed berries in the batter and a delightful pink hue, perfect for spring and summer.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12 servings
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 1/4 cups granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 cup fresh strawberry puree (about 1 cup chopped strawberries, blended)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan or line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients alternately with the milk and strawberry puree, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix.
6. Pour batter into the prepared cake pan or fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
7. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
8. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost with strawberry or vanilla buttercream.

name: Cake, torte
description:
A rich and often multi-layered cake, a torte is typically denser and more elaborate than a standard cake, often featuring nuts, fruit purees, or chocolate, with minimal flour.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 slices
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Chocolate Hazelnut Torte:
- 6 large eggs, separated
- 1 cup granulated sugar, divided
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup finely ground hazelnuts (or almond flour)
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For Ganache (optional):
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 4 oz bittersweet chocolate, chopped

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease an 8-inch round cake pan and line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, beat egg yolks with 1/2 cup granulated sugar and vanilla until thick and pale.
3. In a separate clean bowl, beat egg whites with salt until stiff peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 1/2 cup granulated sugar, beating until glossy.
4. Gently fold the ground hazelnuts and cocoa powder into the egg yolk mixture.
5. Fold about one-third of the egg whites into the hazelnut mixture to lighten it, then gently fold in the remaining egg whites until just combined.
6. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
7. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly soft. A wooden skewer inserted should come out with moist crumbs.
8. Let cool completely in the pan on a wire rack. The torte will be dense.
9. For Ganache: Heat heavy cream until simmering. Pour over chopped chocolate, let sit for 5 minutes, then whisk until smooth. Let cool slightly until thickened.
10. Spread ganache over the cooled torte. Serve at room temperature.

name: Cake, tres leche
description:
A decadent and incredibly moist sponge cake soaked in a luscious blend of three milks (evaporated, condensed, and heavy cream), often topped with whipped cream and fresh fruit. This Latin American delight is celebrated for its rich, creamy texture and sweet flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus baking and chilling time)

Ingredients:
- 1 box yellow cake mix (plus ingredients per box instructions)
- 1 (12 oz) can evaporated milk
- 1 (14 oz) can sweetened condensed milk
- 1/2 cup heavy cream (for soaking)
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup heavy cream (for topping)
- 2 tbsp powdered sugar
- Fresh berries for garnish (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Prepare and bake the yellow cake mix according to package directions in a 9x13 inch pan. Let cool completely.
2. 2. Once cool, poke holes all over the top of the cake with a fork.
3. 3. In a bowl, whisk together evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, 1/2 cup heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
4. 4. Slowly pour the milk mixture evenly over the entire cake, ensuring it soaks into the holes.
5. 5. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the cake to absorb the milk.
6. 6. Before serving, whip 1 cup heavy cream with powdered sugar until soft peaks form. Spread over the chilled cake.
7. 7. Garnish with fresh berries if desired. Slice and serve cold.

name: Cake, pineapple, upside down
description:
A charming retro dessert featuring caramelized pineapple rings and maraschino cherries baked into the bottom of the pan, which become the beautiful, sticky-sweet topping when the cake is inverted. It's a delightful balance of sweet and tangy.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter
- 1 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 (20 oz) can pineapple rings (drained)
- 10-12 maraschino cherries
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened)
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup milk

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. 2. In a 9-inch round cake pan, melt 1/2 cup butter. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly over the melted butter.
3. 3. Arrange pineapple rings over the brown sugar. Place a maraschino cherry in the center of each pineapple ring and scatter remaining cherries in between.
4. 4. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
5. 5. In a large bowl, cream 1/2 cup softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla.
6. 6. Gradually add dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with milk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.
7. 7. Carefully spoon the cake batter over the pineapple and cherries, spreading evenly.
8. 8. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
9. 9. Let cool in the pan for 5-10 minutes. Place a serving plate upside down over the cake pan and carefully invert the cake onto the plate. Scrape any remaining caramel from the pan onto the cake. Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Cake or cupcake, white with white icing, bakery
description:
A timeless classic, this bakery-style white cake or cupcake boasts a tender, fluffy crumb and is generously crowned with a smooth, sweet white icing. It's a simple yet elegant treat perfect for any celebration.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 (cake) or 12 (cupcakes)
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cake: 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened)
- 1 cup milk
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 4 large egg whites
- For the Icing: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened)
- 4 cups powdered sugar
- 1/4 cup milk or heavy cream
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans or line a muffin tin with cupcake liners.
2. 2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. 3. Add softened butter, milk, and vanilla extract to the dry ingredients. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed until just combined, then increase to medium and beat for 2 minutes.
4. 4. In a separate clean bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the egg whites into the cake batter until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
5. 5. Divide batter evenly between prepared pans or cupcake liners. Bake cakes for 25-30 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let cool in pans for 10 minutes, then invert onto a wire rack to cool completely.
6. 6. For the icing: In a large bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, alternating with milk/cream, beating until smooth and fluffy. Stir in vanilla extract and salt.
7. 7. Once cakes/cupcakes are completely cool, frost as desired.

name: Cake or cupcake, white with white icing, from mix
description:
A convenient and delightful treat, this white cake or cupcake is made from a mix, offering a consistently light and fluffy texture. It's typically adorned with a sweet, creamy white icing, making it a simple pleasure for any occasion.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 (cake) or 12 (cupcakes)
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 1 box white cake mix (plus ingredients per box instructions)
- For the Icing: 1 cup unsalted butter (softened)
- 4 cups powdered sugar
- 1/4 cup milk or heavy cream
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven and prepare cake pans or cupcake liners according to cake mix package directions.
2. 2. Prepare the cake batter following the instructions on the cake mix box. Pour into prepared pans/liners.
3. 3. Bake according to package directions until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
4. 4. For the icing: In a large bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, alternating with milk/cream, beating until smooth and fluffy. Stir in vanilla extract and salt.
5. 5. Once cakes/cupcakes are completely cool, frost as desired.

name: Cake or cupcake, white with chocolate icing, bakery
description:
A beloved bakery classic, this white cake or cupcake features a tender, airy crumb perfectly complemented by a rich, smooth chocolate icing. The contrast of the light cake and decadent chocolate creates a harmonious and satisfying dessert.

Servings: 12-16 (cake) or 12 (cupcakes)

- 1/2 tsp salt

- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- Pinch of salt

6. 6. For the icing: In a large bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Sift in cocoa powder and beat until combined. Gradually add powdered sugar, alternating with milk/cream, beating until smooth and fluffy. Stir in vanilla extract and salt.

name: Cake or cupcake, white with chocolate icing, from mix
description:
An easy-to-make yet satisfying dessert, this white cake or cupcake, prepared from a mix, offers a light and airy base. It's beautifully contrasted with a generous layer of rich, sweet chocolate icing, making it a crowd-pleaser.

Servings: 12-16 (cake) or 12 (cupcakes)

name: Cake or cupcake, white, no icing
description:
A simple yet elegant white cake or cupcake, celebrated for its light, tender, and airy crumb. Without icing, its delicate vanilla flavor shines through, making it a versatile base for various toppings or a delightful treat on its own.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 (cake) or 12 (cupcakes)
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened)
- 1 cup milk
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 4 large egg whites

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans or line a muffin tin with cupcake liners.
2. 2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. 3. Add softened butter, milk, and vanilla extract to the dry ingredients. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed until just combined, then increase to medium and beat for 2 minutes.
4. 4. In a separate clean bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Gently fold the egg whites into the cake batter until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
5. 5. Divide batter evenly between prepared pans or cupcake liners. Bake cakes for 25-30 minutes, or cupcakes for 18-22 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let cool in pans for 10 minutes, then invert onto a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cake, strawberry shortcake
description:
A quintessential summer dessert, strawberry shortcake features tender, slightly sweet biscuits or sponge cake layered with fresh, macerated strawberries and generous dollops of whipped cream. It's a light, refreshing, and utterly delightful treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus baking and macerating time)

Ingredients:
- For the Shortcakes: 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 3/4 cup milk
- 1 large egg (for egg wash, optional)
- For the Strawberries: 1 lb fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- For the Whipped Cream: 1 1/2 cups cold heavy cream
- 1/4 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Shortcakes: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Cut in cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
2. 2. Add milk and mix until just combined (do not overmix). Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently pat to 3/4-inch thickness. Cut out 6-8 rounds using a biscuit cutter. Place on a baking sheet. Brush tops with egg wash if desired.
3. 3. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool on a wire rack.
4. 4. For the Strawberries: In a medium bowl, combine sliced strawberries and sugar. Gently toss and let sit for at least 15 minutes to macerate and release juices.
5. 5. For the Whipped Cream: In a cold bowl with cold beaters, beat heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract on high speed until stiff peaks form.
6. 6. To assemble: Split cooled shortcakes in half. Spoon strawberries and their juices over the bottom half, top with a generous dollop of whipped cream, then place the top half of the shortcake. Add more strawberries and whipped cream on top if desired. Serve immediately.

name: Cake or cupcake, zucchini
description:
A wonderfully moist and flavorful cake or cupcake that cleverly incorporates grated zucchini, making it incredibly tender. Often spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg, it's a delightful way to enjoy vegetables in a sweet treat, sometimes topped with cream cheese frosting.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 (cake) or 12 (cupcakes)
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 2 cups grated zucchini (about 2 medium zucchini, squeezed of excess moisture)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x13 inch baking pan or line a muffin tin with cupcake liners.
2. 2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
3. 3. In a separate medium bowl, whisk together vegetable oil, eggs, and vanilla extract.
4. 4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Fold in the grated zucchini.
5. 5. Pour batter into the prepared pan or divide among cupcake liners. Bake cake for 30-35 minutes, or cupcakes for 20-25 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
6. 6. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost with cream cheese frosting if desired.

name: Cookie, batter or dough, raw
description: The irresistible, unbaked mixture of flour, sugar, butter, and flavorings destined to become cookies. Often enjoyed illicitly straight from the bowl, it's a nostalgic treat with a sweet, rich, and slightly gritty texture.

name: Cookie, NFS
description:
A general term for a small, sweet, baked treat, typically made with flour, sugar, and fat. Cookies come in countless varieties, from crisp to chewy, plain to elaborately decorated, offering a delightful bite-sized indulgence.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-36 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
4. 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined and a soft dough forms.
5. 5. Cover the dough and chill for at least 30 minutes (or up to 2 hours).
6. 6. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
7. 7. Roll out the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes using cookie cutters.
8. 8. Place cookies on prepared baking sheets. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, almond
description:
A delicate and often crisp cookie, rich with the distinct, nutty flavor of almonds. These can range from chewy amaretti to buttery shortbreads, often featuring sliced or ground almonds for texture and taste.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 36 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp almond extract
- 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup sliced almonds (for topping, optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in the egg, then stir in the almond extract.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
4. 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined and a soft dough forms.
5. 5. Cover the dough and chill for at least 30 minutes.
6. 6. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
7. 7. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place on prepared baking sheets. Flatten slightly with the palm of your hand or a fork. If desired, press a few sliced almonds onto the top of each cookie.
8. 8. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, applesauce
description:
A soft, chewy, and subtly sweet cookie, often spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg, where applesauce provides moisture and a delicate fruit flavor. These cookies are a comforting treat, sometimes studded with raisins or nuts.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup unsweetened applesauce
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup raisins (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract, then stir in the applesauce.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in raisins if using.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden and centers are set. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, biscotti
description:
A traditional Italian almond biscuit, known for its distinctive oblong shape and crunchy texture. Biscotti are twice-baked, making them perfect for dipping into coffee, tea, or dessert wine, offering a delightful crispness.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 biscotti
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 tsp almond extract
- 1/2 cup whole almonds, roughly chopped

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. 3. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
4. 4. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract and almond extract.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the chopped almonds.
6. 6. Divide the dough in half. On the prepared baking sheet, shape each half into a log about 10-12 inches long and 2 inches wide. Leave space between logs.
7. 7. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until lightly golden and firm to the touch.
8. 8. Remove from oven and reduce oven temperature to 300°F (150°C). Let logs cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes.
9. 9. Carefully transfer logs to a cutting board. Using a serrated knife, slice each log diagonally into 1/2-inch thick pieces.
10. 10. Place the sliced biscotti cut-side down back on the baking sheet. Bake for another 10-15 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crisp and golden. Let cool completely on a wire rack.

name: Cookie, brownie, NS as to icing
description:
A delightful hybrid, combining the rich, fudgy texture of a brownie with the convenience of a cookie. These chewy, chocolatey treats offer a dense, satisfying bite, often with a slightly crackled top, and may or may not be topped with icing.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup chocolate chips (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a medium saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in sugar until combined.
3. 3. Whisk in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
4. 4. Sift in cocoa powder, flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix until just combined. Fold in chocolate chips if using.
5. 5. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
6. 6. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are still slightly soft. Do not overbake. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, brownie, without icing
description:
A rich, fudgy, and intensely chocolatey cookie that delivers all the dense chewiness of a classic brownie in a convenient, un-iced form. Its crackled top and deep cocoa flavor make it a satisfying treat for chocolate lovers.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:

- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup chocolate chips (optional)
