4. 4. Sift in cocoa powder, flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix until just combined. Fold in chocolate chips if using.
5. 5. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
6. 6. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are still slightly soft. Do not overbake. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, brownie, with icing or filling
description:
A decadent brownie-cookie hybrid, featuring a rich, fudgy, and intensely chocolatey base. This indulgent treat is elevated with a layer of sweet icing or a creamy filling, adding an extra dimension of flavor and texture.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Icing: 1/4 cup (1/2 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tbsp milk
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. For the Cookies: In a medium saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in sugar until combined.

4. 4. Sift in cocoa powder, flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix until just combined.
5. 5. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
6. 6. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are still slightly soft. Do not overbake. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
7. 7. For the Icing: In a small bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract, beating until smooth and fluffy.
8. 8. Once cookies are completely cool, spread a thin layer of icing on top of each cookie.

description:
A lighter version of the classic brownie cookie, offering a rich chocolate flavor and fudgy texture with reduced fat content. This satisfying treat provides a guilt-free indulgence, whether plain or with a simple topping.

- 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt

6. 6. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are still slightly soft. Do not overbake. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, butterscotch, brownie
description:
A delightful twist on the classic brownie, this cookie features the rich, caramelized sweetness of butterscotch. It boasts a chewy, dense texture with a golden-brown hue, offering a comforting and indulgent treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted
- 1 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 cup butterscotch chips

Instructions:

6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are still slightly soft. Do not overbake. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, bar, with chocolate
description:
A convenient and satisfying baked treat, typically a rectangular slice from a larger pan, featuring a rich, often chewy base studded or topped with chocolate. These bars offer a delightful combination of textures and a comforting chocolate flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 16 bars
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 cup chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour an 8x8 inch baking pan.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in chocolate chips.
6. 6. Press the dough evenly into the prepared baking pan.
7. 7. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until edges are golden brown and a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out with moist crumbs. Do not overbake.
8. 8. Let cool completely in the pan before cutting into bars.

name: Cookie, chocolate chip

The quintessential American cookie, featuring a golden-brown, often chewy or crisp exterior with a soft, gooey center, generously studded with melted chocolate chips. Its comforting blend of sweet, buttery, and chocolatey flavors makes it universally loved.

name: Cookie, chocolate chip, made from home recipe or purchased at a bakery
description:
A premium chocolate chip cookie, boasting a rich, buttery flavor and a perfect balance of crisp edges and a soft, chewy center. Whether lovingly made from a cherished home recipe or expertly crafted by a bakery, it's a superior indulgence with generous chocolate chunks.

description:
A lighter take on the beloved chocolate chip cookie, offering the same comforting flavors and satisfying chewiness but with less fat. It's a guilt-free way to enjoy the classic combination of sweet dough and melty chocolate.

Servings: 24 cookies

name: Cookie, chocolate chip sandwich
description:
A delightful twist on the classic, featuring two soft, chewy chocolate chip cookies embracing a creamy, sweet filling. This sandwich cookie offers a double dose of comfort and indulgence in every bite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 sandwich cookies
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 cup mini chocolate chips
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 2 tbsp milk
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Cookies: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet, mixing until just combined. Fold in mini chocolate chips.
4. 4. Drop small, rounded teaspoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 1 inch apart. Bake for 7-9 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
5. 5. For the Filling: In a medium bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract, beating until smooth and fluffy.
6. 6. To assemble: Spread a small amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, chocolate, made with rice cereal
description:
A fun and crunchy no-bake cookie, combining the crisp texture of rice cereal with a rich, sweet chocolate coating. These easy-to-make treats are a delightful blend of chewy and crispy, perfect for a quick indulgence.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup peanut butter
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 6 cups crispy rice cereal

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large saucepan, combine butter, milk, cocoa powder, and sugar. Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute.
2. 2. Remove from heat and immediately stir in peanut butter and vanilla extract until smooth.
3. 3. Add the crispy rice cereal and mix quickly until all cereal is coated.
4. 4. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto parchment-lined baking sheets. Work quickly as the mixture sets fast.
5. 5. Let cool completely at room temperature or refrigerate for faster setting, until firm.

name: Cookie, chocolate, made with oatmeal and coconut, no bake
description:
A wonderfully chewy and rich no-bake cookie, blending the hearty texture of oatmeal with the tropical sweetness of coconut, all bound together by a luscious chocolate base. These quick treats are a delightful mix of flavors and textures.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup peanut butter
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 3 cups quick-cooking oats
- 1 cup shredded coconut

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large saucepan, combine butter, milk, cocoa powder, and sugar. Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute.
2. 2. Remove from heat and immediately stir in peanut butter and vanilla extract until smooth.
3. 3. Add the quick-cooking oats and shredded coconut, mixing quickly until all ingredients are well coated.
4. 4. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto parchment-lined baking sheets. Work quickly as the mixture sets fast.
5. 5. Let cool completely at room temperature or refrigerate for faster setting, until firm.

name: Cookie, chocolate or fudge
description:
A rich and indulgent cookie, bursting with deep chocolate flavor. These can range from chewy and fudgy to crisp and delicate, often featuring cocoa powder and sometimes chocolate chips for an extra cocoa punch.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup chocolate chips (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cocoa powder, flour, baking soda, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in chocolate chips if using.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are still slightly soft. Do not overbake. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, marshmallow, chocolate-covered
description:
A delightful confection featuring a soft, fluffy marshmallow center enrobed in a smooth, crisp layer of chocolate. This sweet treat offers a satisfying contrast of textures and a comforting blend of flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 12 large marshmallows
- 1 cup chocolate chips (milk or semi-sweet)
- 1 tbsp coconut oil or shortening (optional, for smoother chocolate)

Instructions:
1. 1. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. 2. Place chocolate chips and coconut oil (if using) in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring after each, until chocolate is melted and smooth.
3. 3. Insert a toothpick or fork into each marshmallow. Dip one marshmallow at a time into the melted chocolate, turning to coat completely. Allow excess chocolate to drip off.
4. 4. Place the chocolate-covered marshmallow on the prepared baking sheet. Carefully remove the toothpick/fork.
5. 5. Repeat with remaining marshmallows. Refrigerate for 15-30 minutes, or until chocolate is set.

name: Cookie, marshmallow pie, chocolate covered
description:
A classic treat featuring a soft, sweet marshmallow filling sandwiched between two delicate graham cracker-like cookies, all enrobed in a smooth, rich chocolate coating. It's a delightful combination of textures and flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 12 graham cracker squares, halved
- 12 large marshmallows
- 1 cup chocolate chips (milk or semi-sweet)
- 1 tbsp coconut oil or shortening (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. 2. Place a marshmallow on one half of each graham cracker square. Place on a microwave-safe plate.
3. 3. Microwave for 10-15 seconds, or until marshmallows are slightly puffed and soft. Immediately top with the other graham cracker half, gently pressing to create a sandwich. Let cool completely.
4. 4. In a microwave-safe bowl, combine chocolate chips and coconut oil (if using). Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring after each, until melted and smooth.
5. 5. Dip each cooled marshmallow sandwich into the melted chocolate, ensuring it's fully coated. Allow excess chocolate to drip off.
6. 6. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Refrigerate for 15-30 minutes, or until chocolate is set.

name: Cookie, sugar wafer, chocolate-covered
description:
A delightful confection where crisp, airy sugar wafers, known for their delicate layers, are generously coated in a smooth, sweet layer of chocolate. This treat offers a satisfying crunch followed by a melt-in-your-mouth chocolate finish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: Varies by package size, approx. 15-20
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 1 package (about 8 oz) sugar wafers
- 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips (milk or semi-sweet)
- 1 tbsp coconut oil or shortening (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a microwave-safe bowl, combine chocolate chips and coconut oil (if using). Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring after each, until chocolate is melted and smooth.
3. 3. Dip each sugar wafer into the melted chocolate, using a fork to help submerge and lift, allowing excess chocolate to drip off.
4. 4. Place the chocolate-covered wafer on the prepared baking sheet.
5. 5. Repeat with remaining wafers. Refrigerate for 15-30 minutes, or until chocolate is set.

name: Cookie, chocolate sandwich
description:
A classic and beloved cookie, featuring two rich, dark chocolate wafers embracing a sweet, creamy white filling. This iconic sandwich cookie offers a satisfying crunch followed by a smooth, delightful center.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 sandwich cookies
Prep Time: 45 minutes (plus chilling, baking, and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 3 cups powdered sugar
- 3 tbsp milk
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Cookies: In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
2. 2. In a separate bowl, whisk together cocoa powder, flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet, mixing until just combined. Chill dough for 30 minutes.
3. 3. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper. Roll out dough to 1/8-inch thickness and cut with a 2-inch round cutter. Bake for 8-10 minutes. Let cool completely.
4. 4. For the Filling: In a medium bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract, beating until smooth and fluffy.
5. 5. To assemble: Spread a generous amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, chocolate sandwich, reduced fat
description:
A lighter version of the iconic chocolate sandwich cookie, offering the same satisfying crunch of dark chocolate wafers and a sweet, creamy filling, but with reduced fat content. It's a classic treat with a mindful twist.

5. 5. To assemble: Spread a generous amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, chocolate, sandwich, with extra filling
description:
An indulgent take on the classic chocolate sandwich cookie, featuring two rich, dark chocolate wafers generously filled with an abundance of sweet, creamy white filling. This version offers an extra-satisfying burst of creamy sweetness.

- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 2 cups all-purpose flour

- 1/2 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 3/4 cup (1 1/2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 4 cups powdered sugar
