5. 5. To assemble: Spread a very generous amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, chocolate and vanilla sandwich
description:
A delightful contrast of flavors and colors, this sandwich cookie features one rich chocolate wafer and one sweet vanilla wafer, embracing a creamy filling. It offers a harmonious blend of classic tastes in every bite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 sandwich cookies
Prep Time: 60 minutes (plus chilling, baking, and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Chocolate Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Vanilla Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 3 cups powdered sugar
- 3 tbsp milk
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. Prepare Chocolate Dough: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla. Whisk cocoa, flour, baking soda, salt; add to wet. Mix until combined. Chill 30 min.
2. 2. Prepare Vanilla Dough: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla. Whisk flour, baking soda, salt; add to wet. Mix until combined. Chill 30 min.
3. 3. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets. Roll out each dough separately to 1/8-inch thickness. Cut with 2-inch round cutter. Bake for 8-10 minutes. Cool completely.
4. 4. Prepare Filling: Beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla, beating until smooth and fluffy.
5. 5. Assemble: Spread filling on flat side of a chocolate cookie. Top with a vanilla cookie (flat side down) to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, chocolate wafer
description:
A thin, crisp, and intensely chocolatey cookie, known for its deep cocoa flavor and delicate snap. These wafers are often used as a base for pies and cheesecakes, but are equally delicious enjoyed on their own.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 48-60 wafers
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together cocoa powder, flour, baking soda, and salt.
4. 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined and a stiff dough forms.
5. 5. Divide dough in half. Roll each half into a log about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 hour (or up to overnight).
6. 6. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
7. 7. Slice chilled dough logs into 1/8-inch thick rounds. Place on prepared baking sheets, about 1 inch apart.
8. 8. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until edges are set and cookies are crisp. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, graham cracker with chocolate and marshmallow
description:
The classic campfire treat, S'mores, in cookie form! This delightful combination features crisp graham crackers, gooey melted marshmallow, and rich chocolate, all coming together for a comforting and nostalgic experience.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12 cookies
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 12 graham cracker squares
- 12 large marshmallows
- 6 (1.55 oz) Hershey's milk chocolate bars, broken into halves

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil.
2. 2. Place 12 graham cracker halves on the prepared baking sheet. Top each with a marshmallow.
3. 3. Broil for 30-60 seconds, watching carefully, until marshmallows are golden brown and puffed. (Alternatively, use a kitchen torch to toast marshmallows).
4. 4. Immediately place a chocolate bar half on top of each toasted marshmallow, allowing it to melt slightly.
5. 5. Top with the remaining graham cracker halves to create sandwiches. Serve warm.

name: Cookie bar, with chocolate, nuts, and graham crackers
description:
A delightful and easy-to-make bar cookie, often known as 'Magic Bars' or 'Seven Layer Bars'. It features a buttery graham cracker crust topped with layers of chocolate chips, nuts, and a sweet condensed milk drizzle, baking into a gooey, irresistible treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 bars
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted
- 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs
- 1 (14 oz) can sweetened condensed milk
- 1 cup chocolate chips
- 1 cup shredded coconut
- 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9x13 inch baking pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang on the sides.
2. 2. In a medium bowl, combine melted butter and graham cracker crumbs. Press evenly into the bottom of the prepared pan.
3. 3. Pour the sweetened condensed milk evenly over the crust.
4. 4. Layer evenly with chocolate chips, then shredded coconut, and finally chopped nuts.
5. 5. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set. Do not overbake.
6. 6. Let cool completely in the pan on a wire rack before lifting out by the parchment paper and cutting into bars.

name: Cookie, coconut
description:
A sweet and chewy cookie bursting with the tropical flavor and unique texture of shredded coconut. These can range from crisp and delicate to soft and dense, often with a golden-brown, slightly toasted exterior.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups shredded sweetened coconut

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the shredded coconut.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are golden brown. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, fruit-filled bar
description:
A delightful bar cookie featuring a tender, buttery crust and a sweet, often tangy fruit filling, typically made from pureed or diced fruit. These portable treats offer a comforting blend of pastry and fruity goodness.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 16 bars
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Crust: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 1 (12 oz) jar fruit preserves or jam (e.g., raspberry, apricot)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line an 8x8 inch baking pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang on the sides.
2. 2. For the Crust: In a large bowl, cream softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing until a crumbly dough forms.
3. 3. Press two-thirds of the dough evenly into the bottom of the prepared pan.
4. 4. Spread the fruit preserves evenly over the crust.
5. 5. Crumble the remaining dough over the fruit filling.
6. 6. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown. Let cool completely in the pan before lifting out by the parchment paper and cutting into bars.

name: Cookie, fig bar
description:
A classic and wholesome bar cookie, featuring a soft, chewy, and slightly sweet fig paste encased in a tender, cake-like pastry. These iconic bars offer a unique fruity flavor and satisfying texture, perfect for a snack.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 bars
Prep Time: 45 minutes (plus chilling, baking, and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Dough: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 1 1/2 cups dried figs, stems removed, chopped
- 1/2 cup water
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp lemon juice

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Filling: In a small saucepan, combine chopped figs, water, sugar, and lemon juice. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until figs are very soft and mixture is thick. Mash with a fork or potato masher. Let cool completely.
2. 2. For the Dough: In a large bowl, cream softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. In a separate bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet, mixing until a soft dough forms. Divide dough in half, wrap, and chill for 30 minutes.
3. 3. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a 9x13 inch baking pan with parchment paper.
4. 4. Roll out one half of the dough into a 9x13 inch rectangle. Carefully transfer to the prepared pan. Spread the cooled fig filling evenly over the dough.
5. 5. Roll out the second half of the dough into a 9x13 inch rectangle and place it over the fig filling. Gently press down.
6. 6. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool completely in the pan before cutting into bars.

name: Cookie, fortune
description:
A crisp, hollow, and subtly sweet wafer cookie, traditionally served at Chinese restaurants. Each cookie contains a small paper slip with a 'fortune' or wise saying inside, adding an element of surprise and fun to the dessert.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-15 cookies
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 2 large egg whites
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1/4 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 tsp almond extract (optional)
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tbsp water

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Prepare your fortunes on small strips of paper (approx. 3.5 x 0.5 inches).
2. 2. In a medium bowl, whisk egg whites until foamy. Gradually whisk in sugar until smooth. Stir in melted butter, vanilla, almond extract (if using), and water.
3. 3. Gradually add flour, mixing until a smooth, thin batter forms. It should be like crepe batter.
4. 4. Drop 1 tablespoon of batter onto the prepared baking sheet, spreading it into a thin 3-4 inch circle. Do not bake more than 2-3 at a time, as they harden quickly.
5. 5. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is pale. The edges will be crisp, the center pliable.
6. 6. Working quickly: Remove one cookie with a thin spatula. Place a fortune in the center. Fold the cookie in half, then gently bend the folded edge over the rim of a glass to create the classic fortune cookie shape. Place in a muffin tin to hold shape while cooling.
7. 7. Repeat with remaining cookies, baking in small batches.

name: Cookie, cone shell, ice cream type, wafer or cake
description:
A crisp, edible cone or shell, typically made from a thin wafer or light cake batter, designed to hold scoops of ice cream. It provides a delightful crunch and a subtle sweetness that perfectly complements frozen treats.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-12 cones/wafers
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus cooking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large egg whites
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat a pizzelle iron or a non-stick pan (for flat wafers). If using an iron, follow manufacturer's instructions. If using a pan, heat over medium-low.
2. 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together melted butter and sugar until smooth. Whisk in egg whites and vanilla extract until well combined.
3. 3. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing until a smooth, thin batter forms.
4. 4. For cones: Drop 1-2 tablespoons of batter onto the hot pizzelle iron or pan. Cook until golden brown and crisp (about 30-60 seconds per side on a pan).
5. 5. Working quickly, while the wafer is still hot and pliable, roll it around a cone mold or a wooden spoon handle to form a cone shape. Hold for a few seconds until it sets. If making flat wafers, simply let them cool flat.
6. 6. Let cool completely on a wire rack before serving.

name: Cookie, gingersnaps
description:
A classic spiced cookie known for its crisp texture, bold ginger flavor, and signature crackled top. These aromatic treats are often made with molasses, ginger, cinnamon, and cloves, delivering a warm and zesty bite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 36 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- 3/4 cup (1 1/2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar (plus extra for rolling)
- 1 large egg
- 1/4 cup molasses
- 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 tsp ground ginger
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground cloves
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and 1 cup granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in the egg, then stir in the molasses.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda, and salt.
4. 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined and a stiff dough forms.
5. 5. Cover the dough and chill for at least 30 minutes.
6. 6. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Place extra granulated sugar in a shallow dish.
7. 7. Roll dough into 1-inch balls, then roll each ball in the granulated sugar to coat.
8. 8. Place cookies on ungreased baking sheets, about 2 inches apart. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are slightly soft. They will flatten and crackle. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, granola
description:
A wholesome and hearty cookie, packed with oats, nuts, seeds, and dried fruit, often sweetened with honey or maple syrup. These chewy treats offer a satisfying texture and a boost of energy, perfect for a snack.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1/4 cup honey or maple syrup
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
- 1/2 cup chopped nuts (e.g., almonds, walnuts)
- 1/2 cup dried cranberries or raisins

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, brown sugar, and honey/maple syrup until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in rolled oats, chopped nuts, and dried fruit.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until edges are golden brown. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, ladyfinger
description:
A delicate, elongated sponge cake cookie, known for its light, airy texture and subtle sweetness. Ladyfingers are a key ingredient in desserts like tiramisu and trifles, absorbing liquids beautifully while maintaining their soft structure.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 ladyfingers
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 3 large eggs, separated
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar (for yolks)
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar (for whites)
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 3/4 cup all-purpose flour
- Powdered sugar for dusting

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Fit a piping bag with a large round tip (or use a Ziploc bag with a corner snipped).
2. 2. In a large bowl, beat egg yolks with 1/4 cup granulated sugar until pale and thick. Stir in vanilla extract.
3. 3. In a separate clean bowl, beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually add the remaining 1/4 cup granulated sugar and continue beating until stiff, glossy peaks form.
4. 4. Gently fold one-third of the egg whites into the yolk mixture. Then, gently fold in the remaining egg whites until just combined.
5. 5. Sift flour over the mixture and gently fold until no streaks of flour remain, being careful not to deflate the batter.
6. 6. Transfer batter to the piping bag. Pipe 3-4 inch long 'fingers' onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving space between them. Dust generously with powdered sugar.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly golden and firm to the touch. Let cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, lemon bar
description:
A bright and tangy dessert bar, featuring a buttery shortbread crust topped with a smooth, zesty lemon custard. Dusted with powdered sugar, these bars offer a refreshing burst of citrus flavor with every bite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 16-24 bars
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Crust: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 4 large eggs
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice
- 1 tbsp lemon zest
- Powdered sugar for dusting

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9x13 inch baking pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang on the sides.
2. 2. For the Crust: In a large bowl, cream softened butter and powdered sugar until light. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing until a crumbly dough forms. Press evenly into the bottom of the prepared pan. Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until lightly golden. Remove from oven.
3. 3. For the Filling: While the crust bakes, whisk together eggs, granulated sugar, and 1/4 cup flour in a medium bowl until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and lemon zest.
4. 4. Pour the lemon filling over the hot, partially baked crust.
5. 5. Return to oven and bake for another 20-25 minutes, or until the filling is set and edges are lightly golden. The center may still jiggle slightly.
6. 6. Let cool completely in the pan on a wire rack before lifting out by the parchment paper and cutting into bars. Dust generously with powdered sugar before serving.

name: Cookie, macaroon
description:
A delightful, chewy cookie made primarily from shredded coconut, egg whites, and sugar. Often golden-brown and slightly crisp on the outside with a moist, tender interior, macaroons offer a rich, tropical sweetness.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 macaroons
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 4 large egg whites
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 tsp almond extract (optional)
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 4 cups shredded sweetened coconut

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large heatproof bowl, combine egg whites, granulated sugar, vanilla extract, almond extract (if using), and salt. Place the bowl over a saucepan of simmering water (double boiler), ensuring the bottom of the bowl does not touch the water.
3. 3. Whisk constantly for 3-5 minutes, until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture is warm to the touch (about 160°F/70°C).
4. 4. Remove from heat. Stir in the shredded coconut until well combined.
5. 5. Drop rounded tablespoons of the mixture onto prepared baking sheets, forming small mounds. You can gently press them into shape.
6. 6. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown on the edges and lightly golden on top. Let cool completely on the baking sheets before carefully removing.

name: Cookie, marshmallow, with coconut
description:
A sweet and chewy no-bake cookie, combining soft marshmallows with the tropical texture and flavor of shredded coconut, often bound by a sweet, buttery base. It's a delightful, easy-to-make treat with a satisfying chew.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1/2 cup milk
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 5 cups mini marshmallows
- 3 cups shredded sweetened coconut

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large saucepan, combine butter, milk, and sugar. Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute.
2. 2. Remove from heat and immediately stir in vanilla extract.
3. 3. Add the mini marshmallows and stir until completely melted and smooth.
4. 4. Quickly stir in the shredded coconut until well coated.
5. 5. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto parchment-lined baking sheets. Work quickly as the mixture sets fast.
6. 6. Let cool completely at room temperature or refrigerate for faster setting, until firm.

name: Cookie, marshmallow, with rice cereal, no bake
description:
The classic crispy treat! This beloved no-bake cookie combines gooey melted marshmallows with crunchy rice cereal, creating a delightfully chewy and crispy square. It's a simple, nostalgic, and universally loved dessert.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 squares
Prep Time: 10 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 3 tbsp unsalted butter
- 1 (10 oz) bag mini marshmallows
- 6 cups crispy rice cereal
- 1 tsp vanilla extract (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan with butter or cooking spray.
2. 2. In a large saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Add mini marshmallows and stir constantly until completely melted and smooth.
3. 3. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla extract (if using).
4. 4. Add the crispy rice cereal and mix quickly until all cereal is well coated with the marshmallow mixture.
5. 5. Press the mixture evenly into the prepared baking pan using a buttered spatula or wax paper. Press firmly.
6. 6. Let cool completely at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before cutting into squares.

name: Cookie, marshmallow, with rice cereal and chocolate chips
description:
A delightful twist on the classic crispy treat, combining gooey marshmallows and crunchy rice cereal with the added indulgence of melty chocolate chips. This no-bake cookie offers a satisfying blend of sweet, chewy, and crispy textures.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 squares
Prep Time: 10 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 3 tbsp unsalted butter
- 1 (10 oz) bag mini marshmallows
- 6 cups crispy rice cereal
- 1 cup chocolate chips (milk or semi-sweet)
- 1 tsp vanilla extract (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan with butter or cooking spray.
2. 2. In a large saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Add mini marshmallows and stir constantly until completely melted and smooth.
3. 3. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla extract (if using).
4. 4. Add the crispy rice cereal and chocolate chips. Mix quickly until all cereal is well coated and chocolate chips are mostly melted and distributed.
5. 5. Press the mixture evenly into the prepared baking pan using a buttered spatula or wax paper. Press firmly.
6. 6. Let cool completely at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before cutting into squares.

name: Cookie, marshmallow and peanut butter, with oat cereal, no bake
description:
A quick and easy no-bake cookie, featuring a delightful combination of creamy peanut butter, sweet marshmallows, and crunchy oat cereal. This treat offers a satisfying chew and a comforting blend of flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 4 cups toasted oat cereal (e.g., Cheerios)
- 2 cups mini marshmallows

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large saucepan, combine granulated sugar, brown sugar, milk, and butter. Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute.
2. 2. Remove from heat. Immediately stir in peanut butter and vanilla extract until smooth.
3. 3. Add the oat cereal and mini marshmallows. Stir quickly until cereal is coated and marshmallows are mostly melted and distributed.
4. 4. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto parchment-lined baking sheets. Work quickly as the mixture sets fast.
5. 5. Let cool completely at room temperature or refrigerate for faster setting, until firm.

name: Cookie, meringue
description:
A delicate and airy cookie, made from whipped egg whites and sugar, baked until crisp and melt-in-your-mouth light. These ethereal treats are often flavored with vanilla or almond and can be piped into various elegant shapes.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 3 large egg whites, at room temperature
- 1/4 tsp cream of tartar (optional, helps stabilize)
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 225°F (105°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a very clean, dry bowl (preferably metal or glass), beat egg whites with an electric mixer on medium speed until foamy. Add cream of tartar (if using) and continue beating until soft peaks form.
3. 3. Gradually add granulated sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, while continuing to beat on high speed. Beat until stiff, glossy peaks form and the sugar is fully dissolved (rub a small amount between your fingers; it should feel smooth).
4. 4. Fold in vanilla extract.
5. 5. Spoon or pipe the meringue onto the prepared baking sheet in desired shapes (e.g., small dollops).
6. 6. Bake for 60-90 minutes, or until meringues are firm, dry, and easily lift off the parchment paper. Turn off the oven and leave meringues inside with the door slightly ajar for another 30 minutes to cool slowly and prevent cracking. Let cool completely before storing.

name: Cookie, molasses
description:
A deeply flavorful and chewy cookie, rich with the distinct, robust sweetness of molasses and warm spices like ginger, cinnamon, and cloves. These dark, aromatic treats are a comforting classic, especially during colder months.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 36 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- 3/4 cup (1 1/2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1/4 cup molasses
- 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 tsp ground ginger
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground cloves
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- Granulated sugar for rolling

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in the egg, then stir in the molasses.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, baking soda, and salt.
4. 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined and a stiff dough forms.
5. 5. Cover the dough and chill for at least 30 minutes.
6. 6. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Place granulated sugar in a shallow dish.
7. 7. Roll dough into 1-inch balls, then roll each ball in the granulated sugar to coat.
8. 8. Place cookies on ungreased baking sheets, about 2 inches apart. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are slightly soft. They will flatten and crackle. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, Lebkuchen
description:
A traditional German gingerbread-like cookie, often soft and chewy, heavily spiced with cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, and ginger, and sweetened with honey or molasses. These festive cookies are typically glazed and enjoyed during the holiday season.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 30-40 cookies
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus chilling, baking, and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1/2 cup honey or molasses
- 1 large egg
- 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground cloves
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/4 tsp ground ginger
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/4 cup finely chopped candied orange peel (optional)
- 1/4 cup finely chopped almonds (optional)
- For Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2-3 tbsp lemon juice or milk

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream butter and brown sugar until light. Beat in honey/molasses and egg.
2. 2. In a separate bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, spices, and salt. Gradually add to wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in candied orange peel and almonds if using. Dough will be sticky. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours (or overnight).
3. 3. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
4. 4. On a lightly floured surface, roll out chilled dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes (e.g., rounds, squares). Place on prepared baking sheets.
5. 5. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and lightly golden. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
6. 6. For Glaze: Whisk powdered sugar with lemon juice/milk until smooth. Spread over cooled cookies. Let glaze set before storing.

name: Cookie, multigrain, high fiber
description:
A wholesome and hearty cookie, crafted with a blend of various grains and often enriched with ingredients like oats, flaxseed, or whole wheat flour to boost fiber content. These cookies offer a satisfying chew and a nutritious bite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1/4 cup honey or maple syrup
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup whole wheat flour
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup rolled oats
- 1/4 cup ground flaxseed
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup raisins or dried cranberries (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, brown sugar, and honey/maple syrup until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, rolled oats, ground flaxseed, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in dried fruit if using.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until edges are golden brown. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, oatmeal
description:
A comforting and classic cookie, known for its chewy texture and hearty flavor from rolled oats. Often spiced with cinnamon, these cookies offer a wholesome sweetness and a satisfying bite, perfect with a glass of milk.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups rolled oats

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the rolled oats.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are golden brown and centers are set. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, oatmeal, with raisins
description:
A beloved classic, this chewy oatmeal cookie is studded with plump, sweet raisins, offering a delightful burst of fruitiness with every bite. Spiced with cinnamon, it's a comforting and wholesome treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
- 1 cup raisins

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the rolled oats and raisins.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are golden brown and centers are set. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, oatmeal, reduced fat, NS as to raisins
description:
A lighter version of the comforting oatmeal cookie, offering a chewy texture and wholesome flavor with reduced fat content. This satisfying treat is perfect for those seeking a classic taste with a healthier twist, with or without raisins.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
- 1/2 cup raisins (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, applesauce, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the rolled oats and raisins (if using).
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are golden brown and centers are set. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, oatmeal sandwich, with creme filling
description:
A delightful sandwich cookie featuring two soft, chewy oatmeal cookies embracing a sweet, creamy creme filling. The hearty texture of the oats perfectly complements the smooth, rich center, creating a comforting and satisfying treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 sandwich cookies
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 2 tbsp milk
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Cookies: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, cream butter, sugars. Beat in egg, vanilla. Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt; add to wet. Fold in oats. Drop small teaspoons of dough onto sheets. Bake 8-10 min. Cool completely.
2. 2. For the Filling: In a medium bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract, beating until smooth and fluffy.
3. 3. To assemble: Spread a generous amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, oatmeal, with chocolate chips
description:
A delightful fusion of two classic cookies, combining the hearty, chewy texture of oatmeal with the sweet, melty indulgence of chocolate chips. This cookie offers a comforting and satisfying blend of flavors and textures.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
- 1 cup chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the rolled oats and chocolate chips.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are golden brown and centers are set. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, oatmeal sandwich, with peanut butter and jelly filling
description:
A fun and nostalgic sandwich cookie, featuring two soft, chewy oatmeal cookies embracing a classic peanut butter and jelly filling. It's a delightful twist on a childhood favorite, offering a comforting blend of sweet and savory.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 sandwich cookies
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1/4 cup jelly or jam (e.g., grape, strawberry)

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Cookies: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, cream butter, sugars. Beat in egg, vanilla. Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt; add to wet. Fold in oats. Drop small teaspoons of dough onto sheets. Bake 8-10 min. Cool completely.
2. 2. For the Filling: In a small bowl, stir together peanut butter and jelly until well combined.
3. 3. To assemble: Spread a generous amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, oatmeal, with chocolate and peanut butter, no bake
description:
A quick and easy no-bake cookie, combining the hearty texture of oatmeal with the irresistible duo of rich chocolate and creamy peanut butter. These treats offer a satisfying chew and a comforting blend of sweet and savory flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 3 cups quick-cooking oats

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large saucepan, combine butter, milk, cocoa powder, and sugar. Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute.
2. 2. Remove from heat and immediately stir in peanut butter and vanilla extract until smooth.
3. 3. Add the quick-cooking oats and mix quickly until all oats are well coated.
4. 4. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto parchment-lined baking sheets. Work quickly as the mixture sets fast.
5. 5. Let cool completely at room temperature or refrigerate for faster setting, until firm.

name: Cookie, peanut butter
description:
A classic American cookie, instantly recognizable by its signature fork crosshatch pattern and rich, nutty flavor. These chewy, tender cookies are packed with creamy peanut butter, offering a comforting and satisfying taste.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract, then stir in the peanut butter until well combined.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined and a soft dough forms.
6. 6. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place on prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart. Flatten each ball with a fork, creating a crosshatch pattern.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, peanut butter, with chocolate
description:
A heavenly combination of two beloved flavors, this cookie features the rich, nutty taste of peanut butter perfectly complemented by sweet, melty chocolate. Whether in chips, chunks, or a drizzle, it's an irresistible treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 cup chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract, then stir in the peanut butter until well combined.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.
6. 6. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place on prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart. Flatten each ball with a fork, creating a crosshatch pattern.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, peanut butter with rice cereal, no bake
description:
A quick and easy no-bake cookie, combining creamy peanut butter with crunchy rice cereal for a delightful texture and satisfying nutty flavor. These simple treats are a nostalgic favorite, perfect for a quick snack.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 squares
Prep Time: 10 minutes (plus setting time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 cup light corn syrup
- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 6 cups crispy rice cereal

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large saucepan, combine granulated sugar and light corn syrup. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved.
2. 2. Remove from heat. Immediately stir in peanut butter until smooth and well combined.
3. 3. Add the crispy rice cereal and mix quickly until all cereal is coated.
4. 4. Press the mixture evenly into a greased 9x13 inch baking pan using a buttered spatula or wax paper. Press firmly.
5. 5. Let cool completely at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before cutting into squares.

name: Cookie, peanut butter sandwich
description:
A classic sandwich cookie featuring two tender, nutty peanut butter cookies embracing a sweet, creamy peanut butter filling. It's a double dose of comforting peanut butter flavor in every bite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 sandwich cookies
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1/4 cup (1/2 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 2-3 tbsp milk

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Cookies: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, cream butter, sugars. Beat in egg, vanilla, then 1 cup peanut butter. Whisk flour, baking soda, salt; add to wet. Roll into 1-inch balls, flatten with fork. Bake 10-12 min. Cool completely.
2. 2. For the Filling: In a medium bowl, beat 1/2 cup peanut butter and 1/4 cup softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar and milk, beating until smooth and fluffy.
3. 3. To assemble: Spread a generous amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, Pfeffernusse
description:
A traditional German spice cookie, small and round, known for its strong, peppery flavor and a coating of powdered sugar. These dense, chewy cookies are typically made with a blend of warm spices like cinnamon, cloves, and cardamom.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 48-60 cookies
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus chilling, baking, and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup molasses
- 1 large egg
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground cloves
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/4 tsp ground ginger
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1/4 tsp salt
- Powdered sugar for coating

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in molasses and egg.
2. 2. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, ginger, black pepper, and salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet, mixing until a stiff dough forms. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour (or overnight).
3. 3. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
4. 4. Roll dough into small 1/2-inch balls. Place on prepared baking sheets, about 1 inch apart.
5. 5. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are set and cookies are firm. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
6. 6. While still warm, toss cookies in powdered sugar to coat completely. Re-roll in powdered sugar once cooled if desired for a thicker coating.

name: Cookie, Pizzelle
description:
A traditional Italian waffle cookie, known for its delicate, crisp texture and intricate snowflake-like pattern. These thin, subtly sweet cookies are often flavored with vanilla, anise, or lemon, and are perfect for special occasions.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 pizzelles
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus cooking time)

Ingredients:
- 3 large eggs
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted and cooled
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 tsp anise extract (optional, or lemon zest)
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 tsp baking powder

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, beat eggs and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in melted butter, vanilla extract, and anise extract (if using).
2. 2. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and baking powder. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until a smooth batter forms.
3. 3. Preheat a pizzelle iron according to manufacturer's instructions.
4. 4. Drop 1 tablespoon of batter onto the center of each grid on the hot pizzelle iron. Close the iron and cook for 30-60 seconds, or until golden brown and crisp.
5. 5. Carefully remove pizzelles from the iron and place on a wire rack to cool completely. They will crisp up as they cool. Repeat with remaining batter.

name: Cookie, pumpkin
description:
A soft, cake-like cookie bursting with the warm, earthy flavor of pumpkin and aromatic spices like cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger. These moist, comforting treats are a seasonal favorite, often topped with a sweet cream cheese frosting.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 cup canned pumpkin puree
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- 1/4 tsp ground ginger
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg, then stir in the pumpkin puree and vanilla extract until well combined.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. The dough will be soft.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until edges are set and centers are still soft. Do not overbake. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Frost with cream cheese frosting if desired.

name: Cookie, raisin
description:
A soft and chewy cookie, often spiced with cinnamon, featuring plump, sweet raisins that add a delightful burst of fruitiness and texture. These comforting treats are a classic, wholesome indulgence.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 cup raisins

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
4. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
5. 5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in the raisins.
6. 6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart.
7. 7. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are golden brown and centers are set. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, raisin sandwich, cream-filled
description:
A delightful sandwich cookie featuring two soft, chewy raisin cookies, often spiced with cinnamon, embracing a sweet, creamy filling. The plump raisins and smooth cream create a comforting and satisfying treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 sandwich cookies
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 cup raisins
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 2 tbsp milk
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Cookies: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, cream butter, sugars. Beat in egg, vanilla. Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt; add to wet. Fold in raisins. Drop small teaspoons of dough onto sheets. Bake 8-10 min. Cool completely.
2. 2. For the Filling: In a medium bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract, beating until smooth and fluffy.
3. 3. To assemble: Spread a generous amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, rum ball, no bake
description:
A festive and indulgent no-bake cookie, featuring a rich, dense mixture of crushed cookies, cocoa, and nuts, infused with a generous hint of rum. Rolled in powdered sugar, these boozy bites are a popular holiday treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 36-40 rum balls
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling time)

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 cups crushed vanilla wafers (about 1 box)
- 1 cup finely chopped pecans or walnuts
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar (plus extra for rolling)
- 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup dark rum
- 2 tbsp light corn syrup
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, combine crushed vanilla wafers, chopped nuts, 1/2 cup powdered sugar, cocoa powder, and salt. Mix well.
2. 2. In a separate small bowl, whisk together rum, corn syrup, and vanilla extract.
3. 3. Pour the liquid mixture over the dry ingredients and mix until thoroughly combined and a moist dough forms.
4. 4. Roll the mixture into 1-inch balls. Place extra powdered sugar in a shallow dish and roll each ball to coat completely.
5. 5. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours to allow flavors to meld. They can be stored for up to 2 weeks.

name: Cookie, sandwich-type, not chocolate or vanilla
description:
A versatile sandwich cookie featuring two tender cookies of a non-chocolate or vanilla flavor (e.g., lemon, peanut butter, oatmeal) embracing a sweet, creamy filling. These offer a delightful variety of tastes and textures.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 sandwich cookies
Prep Time: 45 minutes (plus chilling, baking, and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp lemon extract (or other flavor)
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 2 tbsp milk
- 1 tsp lemon extract (or other flavor)

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Cookies: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg and lemon extract. Whisk flour, baking powder, salt; add to wet. Mix until combined. Chill dough for 30 minutes.
2. 2. Roll out dough to 1/8-inch thickness and cut with a 2-inch round cutter. Bake for 8-10 minutes. Let cool completely.
3. 3. For the Filling: In a medium bowl, beat softened butter until creamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, milk, and lemon extract, beating until smooth and fluffy.
4. 4. To assemble: Spread a generous amount of filling onto the flat side of one cookie. Top with another cookie, flat side down, to create a sandwich.

name: Cookie, shortbread
description:
A classic Scottish biscuit, renowned for its rich, buttery flavor and tender, crumbly texture. Made with a simple combination of butter, sugar, and flour, shortbread melts in your mouth, offering a pure, comforting taste.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 16-20 pieces
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking pan or line with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing on low speed until a soft dough forms. Do not overmix.
4. 4. Press the dough evenly into the prepared baking pan. Prick the surface all over with a fork.
5. 5. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden. The center should still be pale.
6. 6. While still warm, cut into squares or fingers. Let cool completely in the pan before removing.

name: Cookie, shortbread, reduced fat
description:
A lighter version of the beloved shortbread cookie, offering a tender, buttery texture and classic flavor with reduced fat content. It's a mindful indulgence that still delivers on the comforting, melt-in-your-mouth experience.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 16-20 pieces
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking pan or line with parchment paper.
2. 2. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter, applesauce, and powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
3. 3. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing on low speed until a soft dough forms. Do not overmix.
4. 4. Press the dough evenly into the prepared baking pan. Prick the surface all over with a fork.
5. 5. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden. The center should still be pale.
6. 6. While still warm, cut into squares or fingers. Let cool completely in the pan before removing.

name: Cookie, shortbread, with icing or filling
description:
A delightful variation of the classic shortbread, featuring its signature rich, buttery, and crumbly texture, enhanced with a sweet layer of icing or a creamy filling. This adds an extra dimension of flavor and elegance to the beloved biscuit.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 16-20 pieces
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Shortbread: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Icing: 1 cup powdered sugar
- 2-3 tbsp milk
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Shortbread: Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking pan or line with parchment paper. In a large bowl, cream butter and 1/2 cup powdered sugar. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing until a soft dough forms. Press evenly into the pan. Prick with a fork. Bake 30-35 minutes, until edges are lightly golden. Cut into shapes while warm. Cool completely.
2. 2. For the Icing: In a small bowl, whisk 1 cup powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Adjust milk for desired consistency.
3. 3. Once shortbread is completely cool, spread or drizzle icing over the top. Let icing set before serving.

name: Cookie, animal
description:
Small, crunchy, and subtly sweet cookies shaped like various animals. These playful biscuits are a nostalgic treat, often enjoyed by children, offering a simple, comforting flavor and a fun, edible menagerie.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-36 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
4. 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined and a soft dough forms.
5. 5. Cover the dough and chill for at least 30 minutes.
6. 6. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
7. 7. Roll out the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into animal shapes using cookie cutters.
8. 8. Place cookies on prepared baking sheets. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, animal, with frosting or icing
description:
Playful animal-shaped cookies, enhanced with a sweet layer of frosting or icing. These crunchy, subtly sweet biscuits become even more delightful with the added sweetness and decorative touch, making them a fun treat for all ages.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-36 cookies
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus chilling, baking, and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Cookies: 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Icing: 1 cup powdered sugar
- 2-3 tbsp milk
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
- Food coloring (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Cookies: In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla. Whisk flour, baking powder, salt; add to wet. Mix until combined. Chill dough for 30 minutes. Roll out dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into animal shapes. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 8-10 minutes. Cool completely.
2. 2. For the Icing: In a small bowl, whisk powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add food coloring if desired. Adjust milk for desired consistency.
3. 3. Once cookies are completely cool, spread or pipe icing onto the animal cookies. Let icing set before serving.

name: Cookie, butter or sugar
description:
A simple yet elegant cookie, celebrated for its rich, buttery flavor and tender, melt-in-your-mouth texture. These versatile biscuits are often crisp and can be plain, decorated, or used as a base for other desserts.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-36 cookies
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
4. 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined and a soft dough forms.
5. 5. Cover the dough and chill for at least 30 minutes (or up to 2 hours).
6. 6. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
7. 7. Roll out the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes using cookie cutters.
8. 8. Place cookies on prepared baking sheets. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Marie biscuit
description:
A classic, round, slightly sweet biscuit, known for its crisp texture and simple, delicate flavor. Often embossed with its name, the Marie biscuit is popular worldwide, perfect for dipping in tea or coffee.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 30-40 biscuits
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 2-3 tbsp milk (if needed)

Instructions:

4. 4. Cover the dough and chill for at least 30 minutes.
5. 5. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
6. 6. Roll out the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/8-inch thickness. Cut into 2-inch rounds using a cookie cutter. Prick each biscuit a few times with a fork.
7. 7. Place cookies on prepared baking sheets. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, butter or sugar, with fruit and/or nuts
description:
A delightful variation of the classic butter or sugar cookie, enriched with the added sweetness of dried fruit (like raisins or cranberries) and/or the satisfying crunch of chopped nuts. These additions bring extra texture and flavor to the tender, buttery base.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-36 cookies
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:

- 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup dried cranberries or raisins
- 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or pecans

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
4. 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Fold in dried fruit and nuts.
5. 5. Cover the dough and chill for at least 30 minutes.
6. 6. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
7. 7. Roll out the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes using cookie cutters.
8. 8. Place cookies on prepared baking sheets. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Cookie, sugar wafer
description:
A light, crisp, and airy cookie composed of multiple thin, delicate wafer layers separated by sweet, creamy filling. These rectangular treats offer a satisfying crunch and a subtle sweetness, often flavored with vanilla or chocolate.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 10-15 multi-layered wafers
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus cooking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 cup milk
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- Pinch of salt
- For the Filling: 1/4 cup (1/2 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup powdered sugar
- 1 tbsp milk
- 1/2 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Wafers: In a bowl, cream butter and 1/2 cup powdered sugar until light. Beat in 1/2 tsp vanilla and 1/4 cup milk. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing until smooth batter forms. (This recipe makes a soft batter for a wafer iron, not a stiff dough).
2. 2. Preheat a wafer iron (like a pizzelle iron or specific wafer maker). Drop 1-2 tbsp of batter onto the iron, close, and cook until golden and crisp. Immediately trim edges if desired. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
3. 3. For the Filling: Beat 1/4 cup softened butter until creamy. Gradually add 1 cup powdered sugar, 1 tbsp milk, and 1/2 tsp vanilla, beating until smooth and fluffy.
4. 4. To assemble: Spread a thin layer of filling on one wafer. Top with another wafer. Repeat to create stacks of 3-4 wafers. Gently press. Trim edges if needed. Chill briefly to set filling.

name: Cookie, toffee bar
description:
A rich and buttery bar cookie, featuring a tender shortbread-like base generously topped with a crunchy, caramelized toffee layer, often studded with chocolate chips or nuts. It's an irresistible blend of sweet, buttery, and crunchy textures.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 bars
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus baking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- For the Base: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Topping: 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter
- 1 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup chocolate chips (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9x13 inch baking pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang on the sides.
2. 2. For the Base: In a large bowl, cream softened butter and granulated sugar until light. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing until a crumbly dough forms. Press evenly into the bottom of the prepared pan. Bake for 15 minutes.
3. 3. For the Topping: While the base bakes, in a medium saucepan, melt 1 cup butter and brown sugar over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil. Boil for 1 minute, stirring. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract.
4. 4. Pour the hot toffee mixture evenly over the partially baked base. Return to oven and bake for another 15-20 minutes, or until the toffee is bubbly and golden brown.
5. 5. If using, immediately sprinkle chocolate chips over the hot toffee. Let sit for 5 minutes, then spread melted chocolate evenly. Let cool completely in the pan before lifting out by the parchment paper and cutting into bars.

name: Cookie, vanilla sandwich
description:
A classic and comforting cookie, featuring two tender, sweet vanilla wafers embracing a creamy, smooth vanilla filling. This iconic sandwich cookie offers a delightful balance of crispness and creamy sweetness.

description:

2. 2. For the Icing: In a small bowl, whisk powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add food coloring if desired. Adjust milk for desired consistency.
3. 3. Once cookies are completely cool, spread or pipe icing onto the cookies. Let icing set before serving.

name: Cookie, tea, Japanese
description:
A delicate and often subtly flavored cookie, characteristic of Japanese confectionery. These cookies are typically light, crisp, and less sweet than Western counterparts, often incorporating ingredients like matcha, sesame, or kinako for unique, refined tastes.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24-30 cookies

- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened
- 1/4 cup powdered sugar
- 1 large egg yolk
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tbsp matcha powder (optional, for matcha flavor)
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, cream together softened butter and powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
2. 2. Beat in the egg yolk and vanilla extract until well combined.
3. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, matcha powder (if using), and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until a soft dough forms.

description:
A thin, crisp, and subtly sweet cookie, known for its delicate vanilla flavor and light, airy texture. These versatile wafers are often used in desserts like banana pudding or enjoyed simply on their own.

Ingredients:

name: Cookie, rugelach
description:
A traditional Jewish pastry, featuring a tender, cream cheese-based dough rolled around a sweet filling of nuts, raisins, cinnamon, and sometimes fruit preserves. These crescent-shaped cookies are flaky, rich, and utterly delicious.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 48-64 cookies
Prep Time: 45 minutes (plus chilling and baking time)

Ingredients:
- For the Dough: 8 oz cream cheese, softened
- 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/4 tsp salt
- For the Filling: 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts or pecans
- 1/2 cup raisins or dried cranberries
- 1/4 cup apricot or raspberry jam (optional)
- 1 large egg, beaten (for egg wash)
- 1 tbsp granulated sugar (for sprinkling)

Instructions:
1. 1. For the Dough: In a large bowl, beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Gradually add flour and salt, mixing until a soft dough forms. Divide dough into 4 equal balls, flatten slightly, wrap in plastic, and chill for at least 1 hour (or overnight).
2. 2. For the Filling: In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon, chopped nuts, and raisins/cranberries.
3. 3. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
4. 4. On a lightly floured surface, roll out one dough ball into a 10-inch circle. If using, spread 1 tablespoon of jam over the dough, leaving a small border. Sprinkle one-quarter of the nut/fruit mixture evenly over the dough.
5. 5. Cut the circle into 12-16 wedges (like a pizza). Starting from the wide end, roll each wedge tightly towards the point to form a crescent. Place on prepared baking sheets.
6. 6. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool on baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Repeat with remaining dough.
