Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups masa harina
- 1 1/2 cups warm water
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup cooked seasoned shredded pork (or beef)
- 1/2 cup refried beans, warmed
- Vegetable oil for cooking
- Curtido (pickled cabbage slaw) and salsa for serving

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine masa harina and salt. Gradually add warm water, mixing until a soft, pliable dough forms.
2. Take a small ball of masa dough (about 2 inches). Flatten it slightly in your palm.
3. Make an indentation in the center and place about 1 tbsp of meat and 1 tbsp of beans.
4. Carefully fold the masa around the filling to seal it, then flatten it back into a disc (about 1/2 inch thick).
5. Heat a lightly oiled comal or non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook pupusas for 5-7 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through.
6. Serve warm, traditionally with curtido and salsa.

An indulgent and flavorful twist, this pepperoni pizza features a crust generously filled with melted cheese, adding an extra layer of gooey deliciousness to complement the spicy pepperoni.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 pre-made pizza dough (for 12-inch pizza)
- 4-6 mozzarella string cheese sticks
- 1/2 cup pizza sauce
- 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
- 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni
- 1 tbsp olive oil (for brushing crust edge)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425F (220C).
2. Roll out pizza dough into a 14-inch circle. Place string cheese sticks around the edge of the dough, about 1 inch from the edge.
3. Fold the dough edge over the string cheese and pinch to seal, forming the stuffed crust. Transfer dough to a baking sheet or pizza stone.
4. Spread pizza sauce over the main dough area. Brush the stuffed crust with olive oil.
5. Sprinkle remaining shredded mozzarella cheese, then arrange pepperoni slices over the cheese.
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
7. Let cool slightly before slicing and serving.

name: Crepe, with meat
description:
A delicate, thin pancake wrapped around a savory meat filling, offering a delightful blend of textures and flavors, perfect for a light meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 2 large eggs
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/2 cup water
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 2 tbsp melted butter (for crepes)
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb ground beef or chicken
- 1/2 onion, diced
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1/2 cup tomato sauce
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Whisk together flour, eggs, milk, water, salt, and melted butter until smooth. Let batter rest for 15-30 minutes.
2. Heat a lightly oiled non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour a small amount of batter (about 1/4 cup) and swirl to coat the bottom thinly. Cook for 1-2 minutes per side until golden. Repeat for remaining batter.
3. For the filling, heat olive oil in a skillet. Add ground meat and cook until browned. Drain excess fat. Add onion and garlic, cook until softened. Stir in tomato sauce, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes.
4. Spoon meat filling onto each crepe, roll or fold, and serve warm.

name: Pierogi
description:
These beloved Eastern European dumplings feature a tender dough wrapper encasing a savory or sweet filling, often boiled and then pan-fried to golden perfection.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 60 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Dough: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 large egg, 1/2 cup warm water, 1/2 tsp salt
- For Filling: 3 large potatoes (boiled and mashed), 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese, 1/4 cup finely chopped onion (sautéed), salt and pepper to taste
- For Serving: 2 tbsp butter, 1/2 onion (sliced), sour cream

Instructions:
1. For the dough, combine flour and salt in a bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk egg and warm water. Gradually add wet ingredients to dry, mixing until a shaggy dough forms. Knead on a floured surface for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rest for 30 minutes.
2. For the filling, combine mashed potatoes, cheddar cheese, sautéed onion, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
3. Roll out dough on a floured surface to about 1/8-inch thickness. Cut into 2-3 inch circles using a cookie cutter or glass rim.
4. Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each circle. Fold dough over and pinch edges to seal, forming a half-moon shape.
5. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Drop pierogi in batches and cook for 3-5 minutes after they float to the surface. Remove with a slotted spoon.
6. In a separate pan, melt butter and sauté sliced onion until caramelized. Add boiled pierogi and pan-fry until lightly golden. Serve with sour cream.

name: Gnocchi, cheese
description:
Soft, pillowy Italian dumplings made with cheese, offering a delicate texture and rich flavor, often served with a light sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup ricotta cheese
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 1 large egg
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1/8 tsp black pepper
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
- Sauce of choice (e.g., marinara or butter sage sauce)

Instructions:
1. In a medium bowl, combine ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
2. Gradually add flour, mixing until a soft dough forms. Do not overmix.
3. Lightly flour a clean surface. Divide the dough into several portions. Roll each portion into a long rope, about 1/2 inch thick.
4. Cut the ropes into 3/4-inch pieces. You can gently roll each piece over the tines of a fork for traditional ridges, or leave them plain.
5. Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil. Drop gnocchi in batches and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they float to the surface. Remove with a slotted spoon.
6. Serve immediately with your favorite sauce.

name: Gnocchi, potato
description:
Tender, light potato dumplings, a beloved Italian staple, perfect for soaking up rich sauces and delivering comforting flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb russet potatoes (about 2 medium), baked or boiled until tender
- 1 large egg yolk
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1 cup all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
- Sauce of choice (e.g., pesto or marinara)

Instructions:
1. Peel the cooked potatoes while still warm and pass them through a potato ricer or mash thoroughly until no lumps remain. Spread on a clean surface to cool slightly.
2. Once cooled, create a well in the center of the mashed potatoes. Add the egg yolk, salt, and pepper.
3. Gradually add the flour, gently incorporating it with your hands until a soft, cohesive dough forms. Do not overmix or knead excessively, as this can make the gnocchi tough.
4. Divide the dough into several portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll each portion into a long rope, about 3/4 inch thick.
5. Cut the ropes into 1-inch pieces. You can gently roll each piece over the tines of a fork or a gnocchi board for traditional ridges, or leave them plain.
6. Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil. Drop gnocchi in batches and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they float to the surface. Remove with a slotted spoon.
7. Serve immediately with your favorite sauce.

name: Knish
description:
A savory Eastern European pastry, typically baked or fried, with a delicious filling (often potato or kasha) encased in a soft or flaky dough.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 60 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Dough: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup warm water, 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- For Filling: 2 large russet potatoes (boiled and mashed), 1/2 onion (finely diced and sautéed until golden), 2 tbsp vegetable oil, salt and pepper to taste
- 1 egg, beaten (for egg wash)

Instructions:
1. For the dough, combine flour and salt in a bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk warm water and oil. Gradually add wet ingredients to dry, mixing until a soft dough forms. Knead for 5 minutes until smooth. Cover and let rest for 30 minutes.
2. For the filling, combine mashed potatoes, sautéed onion, 2 tbsp vegetable oil, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
3. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
4. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough into a large rectangle, about 1/8-inch thick. Spread the potato filling evenly over the dough, leaving a small border.
5. Starting from one long edge, carefully roll the dough into a tight log. Pinch the seam to seal. Gently coil the log into a spiral shape or cut into individual portions (about 2 inches thick).
6. Place knishes on the prepared baking sheet. Brush with beaten egg wash.
7. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm.

name: Bao bun
description:
Soft, fluffy, and slightly sweet steamed buns, often filled with savory ingredients, offering a delightful texture and burst of flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 buns
Prep Time: 90 minutes (includes rising time)

Ingredients:
- For Dough: 1 cup warm water (105-115°F), 1 tbsp active dry yeast, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- For Filling (example: Char Siu Pork): 1 lb pork belly or shoulder, 1/4 cup hoisin sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tsp grated fresh ginger

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine warm water, yeast, and 1 tbsp sugar. Let sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy.
2. Add remaining sugar, flour, baking powder, and vegetable oil to the yeast mixture. Mix until a shaggy dough forms. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours, or until doubled.
3. While dough rises, prepare filling: Cut pork into small cubes. In a bowl, combine hoisin, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger. Add pork and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Cook pork filling: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add marinated pork and cook until browned and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes. Set aside.
5. Punch down the risen dough. Divide into 12-16 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball, then flatten into an oval shape (about 4 inches long).
6. Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each oval. Fold the dough over the filling and pinch the edges to seal, forming a crescent or pleated bun.
7. Place buns on small squares of parchment paper. Arrange in a steamer basket, ensuring space between them. Cover and let rise for another 20-30 minutes.
8. Steam buns over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through and fluffy. Serve warm.

name: Bao bun, no meat
description:
These soft, pillowy steamed buns are a delightful canvas for a variety of savory or sweet vegetarian fillings, offering a light and flavorful experience.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 12-16 buns
Prep Time: 90 minutes (includes rising time)

Ingredients:
- For Dough: 1 cup warm water (105-115°F), 1 tbsp active dry yeast, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- For Filling (example: Mushroom & Cabbage): 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 cup chopped mushrooms, 1 cup shredded cabbage, 1/4 cup shredded carrots, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp grated fresh ginger, salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine warm water, yeast, and 1 tbsp sugar. Let sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy.
2. Add remaining sugar, flour, baking powder, and vegetable oil to the yeast mixture. Mix until a shaggy dough forms. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours, or until doubled.
3. While dough rises, prepare filling: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms, cabbage, and carrots. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until softened. Stir in soy sauce, ginger, salt, and pepper. Cook for another 2 minutes. Set aside to cool.
4. Punch down the risen dough. Divide into 12-16 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball, then flatten into an oval shape (about 4 inches long).
5. Place a spoonful of cooled filling in the center of each oval. Fold the dough over the filling and pinch the edges to seal, forming a crescent or pleated bun.
6. Place buns on small squares of parchment paper. Arrange in a steamer basket, ensuring space between them. Cover and let rise for another 20-30 minutes.
7. Steam buns over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through and fluffy. Serve warm.

name: Spanakopita
description:
A classic Greek savory pastry, featuring layers of crispy, buttery phyllo dough wrapped around a rich and flavorful filling of spinach and feta cheese.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
- 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 2 large eggs, lightly beaten
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
- 1/4 cup finely chopped onion, sautéed
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1 (16 oz) package phyllo dough, thawed
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. In a large bowl, combine the squeezed spinach, feta cheese, Parmesan cheese, eggs, dill, parsley, sautéed onion, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
3. Unroll the phyllo dough. Keep the unused sheets covered with a damp cloth to prevent drying.
4. Place one sheet of phyllo dough in the prepared baking dish. Brush lightly with melted butter. Repeat with 7 more sheets, layering them and brushing each with butter.
5. Spread the spinach mixture evenly over the phyllo layers.
6. Top the spinach mixture with another 8 sheets of phyllo dough, brushing each sheet with melted butter as you layer them.
7. Score the top layers of phyllo into serving-sized squares or diamonds (do not cut all the way through).
8. Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy. Let cool slightly before cutting and serving.

name: Samosa
description:
A popular South Asian snack, these crispy, triangular pastries are typically filled with a savory mixture of spiced potatoes, peas, and sometimes meat, then fried to golden perfection.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10
Prep Time: 60 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Dough: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 cup vegetable oil, 1/2 cup cold water (approx.)
- For Filling: 2 large potatoes (boiled, peeled, and diced), 1/2 cup green peas (fresh or frozen), 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, 1/2 tsp garam masala, 1/2 tsp red chili powder (optional), 1 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro, salt to taste
- Oil for deep frying

Instructions:
1. For the dough, combine flour and salt in a large bowl. Add oil and rub into the flour until crumbly. Gradually add cold water, kneading until a firm, smooth dough forms. Cover and let rest for 30 minutes.
2. For the filling, heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add diced potatoes, green peas, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder (if using), and salt. Sauté for 5-7 minutes, mashing some of the potatoes lightly. Stir in fresh cilantro. Let cool completely.
3. Divide the dough into 8-10 equal portions. Roll each portion into an oval shape (about 6-7 inches long). Cut each oval in half to create two semi-circles.
4. Take one semi-circle, moisten the straight edge with water. Bring the two ends of the straight edge together to form a cone. Press firmly to seal.
5. Fill the cone with the potato mixture. Moisten the top edges of the cone and press firmly to seal, creating a triangular shape.
6. Heat oil for deep frying in a deep pan or wok over medium heat. Fry samosas in batches for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy. Drain on paper towels.
7. Serve hot with chutney.

name: Quiche with meat, poultry or fish
description:
A savory French tart featuring a flaky pastry crust filled with a rich custard of eggs, cream, cheese, and a delicious combination of meat, poultry, or fish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 pre-made pie crust (9-inch)
- 1 cup cooked and chopped meat (e.g., ham, bacon, cooked chicken, or flaked salmon)
- 1/2 cup shredded Gruyere or Swiss cheese
- 1/4 cup chopped onion (optional)
- 3 large eggs
- 1 1/2 cups heavy cream or half-and-half
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- Pinch of nutmeg

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Place pie crust in a 9-inch pie plate. Prick the bottom with a fork.
2. Sprinkle the cooked meat, cheese, and onion (if using) evenly over the bottom of the pie crust.
3. In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, heavy cream, salt, pepper, and nutmeg until well combined.
4. Carefully pour the egg mixture over the fillings in the pie crust.
5. Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the center is set and a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. The top should be golden brown.
6. Let cool for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Biscuit with gravy
description:
A quintessential Southern comfort food, featuring fluffy, tender biscuits smothered in a rich, creamy sausage gravy, perfect for a hearty breakfast.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- For Biscuits: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter (cut into cubes), 3/4 cup cold buttermilk
- For Gravy: 1 lb breakfast sausage, 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, 3 cups milk, 1/2 tsp black pepper, salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
2. For biscuits: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt. Cut in cold butter with a pastry blender or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually add buttermilk, mixing until just combined (do not overmix).
3. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Gently knead 3-4 times. Roll or pat dough to about 1/2-inch thickness. Cut out biscuits with a 2-inch round cutter. Place on a baking sheet.
4. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
5. For gravy: While biscuits bake, cook sausage in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Drain most of the grease, leaving about 2 tbsp.
6. Sprinkle flour over the cooked sausage and stir for 1-2 minutes until a paste forms. Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly to prevent lumps. Bring to a simmer, stirring, until gravy thickens. Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
7. Serve hot biscuits smothered with warm gravy.

name: Chicken cornbread
description:
A comforting Southern dish, combining savory chicken with a moist, flavorful cornbread, often baked as a casserole for a hearty meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced
- 1/2 onion, chopped
- 1 bell pepper, chopped
- 1 (15 oz) can corn, drained
- 1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 (8.5 oz) package cornbread mix
- 1 large egg
- 1/3 cup milk (for cornbread mix)
- 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and cook until browned and cooked through. Remove chicken from skillet.
3. Add onion and bell pepper to the same skillet and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
4. In a large bowl, combine cooked chicken, sautéed vegetables, drained corn, cream of chicken soup, and 1/2 cup milk. Mix well. Spread this mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish.
5. In a separate bowl, prepare the cornbread mix according to package directions, using 1 large egg and 1/3 cup milk. Stir in 1/2 cup of the shredded cheddar cheese.
6. Pour the cornbread batter evenly over the chicken mixture in the baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup cheddar cheese on top.
7. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the cornbread is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the cornbread comes out clean. Let stand for a few minutes before serving.

name: Cornmeal dressing with chicken or turkey and vegetables
description:
A savory and moist Southern-style dressing, made with cornmeal and packed with tender chicken or turkey and a medley of flavorful vegetables, perfect for holiday meals.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10
Prep Time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup yellow cornmeal
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted
- 1 1/2 cups buttermilk
- 2 large eggs, beaten
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 cup chopped cooked chicken or turkey
- 1/2 cup chopped celery
- 1/2 cup chopped onion
- 1/2 cup chopped bell pepper
- 2 cups chicken or turkey broth
- 1/2 tsp dried sage

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper. Stir in melted butter, buttermilk, and beaten eggs until just combined. Pour into a greased 8x8 inch baking pan and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown. Let cool, then crumble into large pieces.
3. In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add celery, onion, and bell pepper; cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
4. In the 9x13 inch baking dish, combine the crumbled cornbread, cooked chicken/turkey, sautéed vegetables, chicken/turkey broth, and dried sage. Mix well.
5. Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until heated through and the top is lightly golden. If you prefer a crispier top, you can broil for the last few minutes, watching carefully.

name: Dressing with oysters
description:
A classic and elegant holiday dressing, featuring plump, briny oysters baked into a savory bread or cornbread mixture, offering a unique taste of the sea.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-10
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 8 cups stale bread cubes (or crumbled cornbread)
- 1 pint shucked oysters, undrained
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter
- 1 cup chopped celery
- 1 cup chopped onion
- 1/2 cup chopped fresh parsley
- 1 tsp dried sage
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1/4 tsp salt (or to taste, depending on oyster brine)
- 2 large eggs, lightly beaten
- 1-2 cups chicken or oyster broth

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. In a large bowl, combine bread cubes and undrained oysters.
3. In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add celery and onion; cook until softened, about 8-10 minutes.
4. Add the sautéed vegetables to the bread and oyster mixture. Stir in parsley, sage, thyme, pepper, and salt. Mix well.
5. Add the beaten eggs and 1 cup of broth. Mix thoroughly. If the mixture seems too dry, add more broth, a little at a time, until it's moist but not soggy.
6. Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and heated through.
7. Serve hot.

name: Lasagna with meat
description:
A classic Italian-American comfort food featuring layers of rich meat sauce, tender pasta, and creamy cheeses, baked until bubbly and golden.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8
Prep Time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
- 2 (6 oz) cans tomato paste
- 1/2 cup water
- 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped
- 1 tsp dried basil
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 12 lasagna noodles
- 16 oz ricotta cheese
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 1 lb shredded mozzarella cheese

Instructions:
1. In a large pot, brown ground beef over medium heat. Drain fat. Add onion and garlic, cook until softened.
2. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, water, parsley, basil, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook for at least 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water to prevent sticking.
4. In a medium bowl, mix ricotta cheese, egg, and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
5. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Spread a thin layer of meat sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
6. Arrange 3-4 lasagna noodles over the sauce. Spread half of the ricotta mixture over the noodles. Top with a layer of mozzarella cheese, then another layer of meat sauce.
7. Repeat layers: noodles, remaining ricotta, mozzarella, meat sauce. Finish with a final layer of noodles, remaining meat sauce, and a generous sprinkle of mozzarella and the remaining Parmesan cheese.
8. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 20-25 minutes, or until bubbly and cheese is golden. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Lasagna with meat and spinach
description:
A beloved Italian classic, this hearty lasagna layers tender pasta with rich meat sauce, creamy ricotta, and vibrant spinach, all baked to golden perfection.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8
Prep Time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
- 12 lasagna noodles
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 28 oz crushed tomatoes
- 6 oz tomato paste
- 1 tsp dried basil
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- 15 oz ricotta cheese
- 1 egg
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 10 oz frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
- 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Olive oil

Instructions:
1. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions; drain and set aside.
2. In a large skillet, brown ground beef with onion and garlic. Drain fat. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 15-20 minutes.
3. In a bowl, mix ricotta cheese, egg, Parmesan, spinach, salt, and pepper.

- 1 tsp cornstarch
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 onion, sliced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 bell pepper, sliced
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 2 tbsp oyster sauce
- 1 tbsp dark soy sauce
- 1 tsp sugar
- White pepper to taste

Instructions:

name: Pad Thai, NFS
description:

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 8 oz flat rice noodles
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 shallot, minced
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1 cup bean sprouts
- 1/2 cup chopped firm tofu (optional)
- 1/4 cup chopped peanuts
- 2 tbsp fish sauce
- 2 tbsp tamarind paste
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tbsp lime juice
- Chili flakes to taste
- Fresh cilantro and lime wedges for garnish

Instructions:
1. Soak rice noodles in hot water for 15-20 minutes until pliable but still firm. Drain.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together fish sauce, tamarind paste, brown sugar, lime juice, and chili flakes for the sauce.
3. Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and shallot; stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
4. Push aromatics to one side, pour in beaten egg and scramble. Add tofu (if using) and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
5. Add soaked noodles to the wok. Pour the sauce over the noodles and toss vigorously to coat. Cook for 3-5 minutes until noodles are tender.
6. Add bean sprouts and half of the chopped peanuts. Toss for 1 minute.
7. Serve hot, garnished with remaining peanuts, fresh cilantro, and lime wedges.

description:

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 35 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb pasta (e.g., linguine, spaghetti)
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb mixed seafood (shrimp, scallops, mussels)
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 zucchini, diced
- 1 bell pepper, diced
- 28 oz crushed tomatoes
- 1/2 cup white wine (optional)
- 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
- Red pepper flakes (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.

4. Add seafood to the sauce. Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until seafood is cooked through (shrimp pink, mussels open). Discard any unopened mussels.
5. Add cooked pasta to the sauce and toss to coat evenly.
6. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Macaroni or noodles, creamed, with cheese
description:
A classic comfort food, featuring tender macaroni or noodles baked in a rich, creamy cheese sauce until bubbly and golden.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 8 oz elbow macaroni or small pasta
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups milk
- 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese (or a blend)
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper

Instructions:
1. 1. Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente. Drain well.
2. 2. In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute to create a roux.
3. 3. Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly to prevent lumps, until the sauce thickens and comes to a simmer.
4. 4. Remove from heat and stir in shredded cheese until melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
5. 5. Add the cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce, stirring to combine. Serve immediately, or transfer to a baking dish and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned.

- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups milk
- 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese
- 1 (5 oz) can tuna (drained and flaked)
- 1/2 cup frozen peas (optional)
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- Breadcrumbs (for topping, optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente. Drain well.
2. 2. In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute.
3. 3. Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and comes to a simmer.
4. 4. Remove from heat and stir in 1.5 cups cheese until melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
5. 5. Stir in the cooked macaroni, drained tuna, and peas (if using).
6. 6. Transfer the mixture to a greased 8x8 inch baking dish. Top with breadcrumbs if desired.
7. 7. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until bubbly and the topping is golden brown.

name: Noodle pudding
description:
A sweet or savory baked dish, often called Kugel, made with wide egg noodles, eggs, and dairy, sometimes incorporating fruit (like apples or raisins) for a sweet version, or cheese and spices for a savory one.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 8 oz wide egg noodles
- 4 large eggs
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar (for sweet) or 1/2 tsp salt (for savory)
- 1 cup cottage cheese
- 1/2 cup sour cream
- 1/4 cup milk
- 1/4 cup melted butter
- 1 tsp vanilla extract (for sweet) or 1/4 tsp black pepper (for savory)
- 1/2 cup raisins or diced apples (for sweet, optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish.
2. 2. Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain well.
3. 3. In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, sugar/salt, cottage cheese, sour cream, milk, melted butter, and vanilla/pepper. If making sweet, stir in raisins/apples.
4. 4. Add the cooked noodles to the egg mixture and toss to coat evenly.
5. 5. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
6. 6. Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until set and golden brown on top. Let cool slightly before serving.

name: Bibimbap, Korean
description:

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 40 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup cooked short-grain white rice
- 1/2 cup beef (thinly sliced, marinated in soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic)
- 1/2 cup spinach (blanched and seasoned)
- 1/2 cup bean sprouts (blanched and seasoned)
- 1/4 cup shredded carrots (sautéed)
- 1/4 cup sliced zucchini (sautéed)
- 1 fried egg
- Gochujang (Korean chili paste) to taste
- Sesame oil for drizzling
- Sesame seeds for garnish

Instructions:
1. 1. Prepare all toppings: Cook rice. Marinate and cook beef. Blanch and season spinach and bean sprouts (with sesame oil, garlic, salt). Sauté carrots and zucchini. Fry an egg.
2. 2. To assemble: Place a serving of warm rice in a bowl. Arrange the prepared vegetables, beef, and fried egg decoratively on top of the rice.
3. 3. Add a dollop of gochujang in the center. Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
4. 4. Serve immediately, instructing to mix all ingredients thoroughly before eating.

name: Rice, fried, meatless
description:
A flavorful and versatile dish of stir-fried rice, typically cooked with soy sauce, vegetables like peas and carrots, and often egg, without any added meat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 3 cups cooked day-old white rice
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1/2 cup frozen peas and carrots (thawed)
- 1/4 cup diced onion
- 2 cloves garlic (minced)
- 2 large eggs (beaten)
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Green onions (sliced, for garnish)

Instructions:
1. 1. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes. Add garlic, peas, and carrots, cooking for 2-3 minutes more. Remove vegetables from the skillet and set aside.
2. 2. Add the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the skillet. Pour in beaten eggs and scramble until just set. Break into small pieces.
3. 3. Add the cooked day-old rice to the skillet. Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes, breaking up any clumps, until heated through and slightly crispy.
4. 4. Return the cooked vegetables and scrambled egg to the skillet. Pour in soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss everything together until well combined and heated through. Season with salt and pepper.
5. 5. Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.

description:
A popular and spicy Korean street food, consisting of chewy cylindrical rice cakes (tteok) and often fish cakes (eomuk) stir-fried in a rich, sweet, and spicy gochujang-based sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb Korean rice cakes (tteokbokki tteok)
- 2 cups water or anchovy broth
- 1/4 cup gochujang (Korean chili paste)
- 1 tbsp gochugaru (Korean chili powder, optional for extra spice)
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 cloves garlic (minced)
- 1/2 onion (sliced)
- 2-3 sheets fish cakes (eomuk, optional, sliced)
- 1 green onion (chopped, for garnish)
- 1 hard-boiled egg (optional, for garnish)

Instructions:
1. 1. If using frozen rice cakes, soak them in warm water for 10-15 minutes to soften.
2. 2. In a large pot or deep skillet, combine water/broth, gochujang, gochugaru (if using), sugar, soy sauce, and minced garlic. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium.
3. 3. Add the softened rice cakes and sliced onion to the sauce. Simmer for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice cakes are tender and the sauce has thickened.
4. 4. Add the sliced fish cakes (if using) and cook for another 2-3 minutes until they are heated through and soft.
5. 5. Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onion and a hard-boiled egg if desired.

name: Adobo, with rice
description:
A beloved Filipino classic, Adobo features tender meat (often chicken or pork) braised in a savory, tangy sauce of soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and peppercorns, typically served alongside fluffy white rice.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus optional marinating time)

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs chicken or pork, cut into serving pieces
- 0.5 cup soy sauce
- 0.5 cup white vinegar
- 1 head garlic, minced
- 1 tsp black peppercorns
- 2 bay leaves
- 1 cup water (optional)
- 2 cups cooked white rice, for serving

Instructions:
1. Combine chicken/pork, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, peppercorns, and bay leaves in a pot. Marinate for 30 minutes (optional).
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 30-40 minutes, or until meat is tender and sauce has reduced.
3. If desired, add water and continue to simmer until meat is very tender and sauce is to your liking.
4. Serve hot with steamed white rice.

name: Sushi, NFS
description: A traditional Japanese delicacy, sushi encompasses a variety of dishes featuring vinegared rice combined with other ingredients, most commonly seafood (raw or cooked) and vegetables. It's an artful balance of flavors and textures.

name: Sushi roll, avocado
description:
A simple yet satisfying sushi roll, featuring creamy slices of fresh avocado nestled within seasoned rice and nori, offering a delightful vegetarian option.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1-2
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 sheet nori (seaweed)
- 1 cup sushi rice, cooked and seasoned
- 0.5 ripe avocado, sliced thinly
- Soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for serving

Instructions:
1. Place a sheet of nori on a bamboo rolling mat.
2. Spread an even layer of seasoned sushi rice over the nori, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
3. Arrange avocado slices in a line across the center of the rice.
4. Using the mat, carefully roll the nori tightly from the bottom up.
5. Moisten the top edge of the nori with a little water to seal the roll.
6. Slice the roll into 6-8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife.
7. Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

name: Sushi roll, California
description:
A popular Westernized sushi creation, the California roll typically combines imitation crab meat, creamy avocado, and crisp cucumber, all rolled with seasoned rice and nori, often with rice on the outside.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1-2
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 sheet nori (seaweed)
- 1 cup sushi rice, cooked and seasoned
- 3 oz imitation crab meat, shredded
- 0.5 ripe avocado, sliced thinly
- 0.25 cucumber, julienned
- Sesame seeds (optional)
- Soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for serving

Instructions:
1. Place a sheet of nori on a bamboo rolling mat. If making an inside-out roll, cover the mat with plastic wrap, then place nori shiny side down.
2. Spread an even layer of seasoned sushi rice over the nori. If making inside-out, sprinkle with sesame seeds, then flip so rice is on the mat.
3. Arrange crab, avocado, and cucumber in a line across the center of the nori (or nori side if inside-out).
4. Using the mat, carefully roll the nori tightly from the bottom up.
5. Moisten the top edge of the nori with a little water to seal the roll.
6. Slice the roll into 6-8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife.
7. Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:

- 3 oz cooked unagi (eel), sliced into strips
- Unagi sauce (eel sauce)
- Sesame seeds (optional)
- Soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger for serving

Instructions:
1. Place a sheet of nori on a bamboo rolling mat.
2. Spread an even layer of seasoned sushi rice over the nori, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
3. Arrange unagi strips in a line across the center of the rice. Drizzle lightly with unagi sauce.
4. Using the mat, carefully roll the nori tightly from the bottom up.
5. Moisten the top edge of the nori with a little water to seal the roll.
6. Slice the roll into 6-8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife.
7. Serve with additional unagi sauce, soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

description:

Ingredients:

5. Moisten the top edge of the nori with a little water to seal the roll.
6. Slice the roll into 6-8 pieces with a sharp, wet knife.

name: Sushi, topped with crab
description:
Nigiri-style sushi featuring a mound of seasoned rice topped with sweet, delicate crab meat, often imitation crab, offering a simple yet satisfying bite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup sushi rice, cooked and seasoned
- 4 oz imitation crab meat, shredded or formed into pieces
- Wasabi (optional)
- Soy sauce, pickled ginger for serving

3. Place a piece of crab meat on top of the rice, gently pressing to secure.
4. Repeat for desired number of pieces.
5. Serve immediately with soy sauce and pickled ginger.

name: Sushi, topped with eel
description:
Nigiri-style sushi featuring a tender slice of grilled freshwater eel (unagi) glazed with a sweet and savory sauce, perched atop a bed of seasoned sushi rice.

Nigiri-style sushi showcasing a delicate, buttery slice of fresh, sushi-grade salmon draped over a perfectly formed mound of seasoned sushi rice.

name: Sushi, topped with egg
description:
Nigiri-style sushi featuring a sweet and savory slice of tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelet) placed atop a bed of seasoned sushi rice, offering a unique and comforting flavor.

name: Seafood paella, Puerto Rican style
description:
A vibrant and flavorful Puerto Rican take on paella, this dish features a medley of fresh seafood (like shrimp, mussels, and squid) cooked with seasoned rice, sofrito, and often annatto oil for its distinctive color and flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 0.5 lb shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 0.5 lb calamari, cut into rings
- 0.5 lb mussels, scrubbed
- 0.5 cup sofrito
- 1 cup medium-grain rice
- 2 cups seafood broth
- 0.25 cup tomato sauce
- 1 packet Sazón with Achiote
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Chopped cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large paella pan or wide skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add shrimp and calamari; cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly seared. Remove from pan and set aside.
3. Add sofrito to the pan and cook for 3-5 minutes until fragrant.
4. Stir in rice, coating it with the sofrito and oil. Cook for 2 minutes.
5. Add seafood broth, tomato sauce, Sazón, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
6. Nestle the mussels, shrimp, and calamari into the rice. Cover and cook for another 5-10 minutes, or until rice is tender and mussels have opened.
7. Remove from heat, let stand for 5 minutes, then garnish with cilantro and serve.

name: Soupy rice with chicken, Puerto Rican style
description:
Arroz Caldoso con Pollo, a comforting Puerto Rican dish, is a flavorful, brothy rice stew brimming with tender chicken pieces, sofrito, and often vegetables, perfect for a hearty meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1.5 lbs chicken thighs or drumsticks, cut into pieces
- 0.5 cup sofrito
- 0.25 cup tomato sauce
- 1 packet Sazón with Achiote
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 3 cups chicken broth
- 1.5 cups medium-grain rice
- 0.5 cup diced potatoes (optional)
- 0.25 cup green olives (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Chopped cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown chicken pieces on all sides; remove and set aside.
2. Add sofrito to the pot and cook for 3-5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, Sazón, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Return chicken to the pot. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
5. Stir in rice and potatoes (if using). Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through.
6. Stir in green olives (if using) during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
7. Adjust seasoning, garnish with cilantro, and serve hot.

name: Soupy rice mixture with chicken and potatoes, Puerto Rican style
description:
A hearty and warming Puerto Rican 'arroz caldoso' featuring tender chicken pieces and chunks of potato simmered in a rich, flavorful, and brothy rice stew, seasoned with traditional sofrito.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1.5 lbs chicken thighs or drumsticks, cut into pieces
- 0.5 cup sofrito
- 0.25 cup tomato sauce
- 1 packet Sazón with Achiote
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 3 cups chicken broth
- 1.5 cups medium-grain rice
- 1 cup diced potatoes
- 0.25 cup green olives (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Chopped cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown chicken pieces on all sides; remove and set aside.
2. Add sofrito to the pot and cook for 3-5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, Sazón, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Return chicken to the pot. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
5. Stir in rice and diced potatoes. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through.
6. Stir in green olives (if using) during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
7. Adjust seasoning, garnish with cilantro, and serve hot.

name: Stewed rice, Puerto Rican style
description:
A staple in Puerto Rican cuisine, stewed rice (Arroz Guisado) is a flavorful, often reddish-orange rice dish cooked with sofrito, tomato sauce, and various additions like olives or small pieces of meat, resulting in a moist and savory side or main.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 0.5 cup sofrito
- 0.25 cup tomato sauce
- 1 packet Sazón with Achiote
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 2 cups medium-grain rice
- 3 cups water or chicken broth
- 0.25 cup green olives (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a medium pot or caldero over medium heat.
2. Add sofrito and cook for 3-5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, Sazón, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Add rice and stir to coat thoroughly with the sofrito mixture. Cook for 2 minutes.
5. Pour in water or broth, add green olives (if using), salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
6. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
7. Fluff with a fork before serving.

name: Rice with squid, Puerto Rican style
description:
Arroz con Calamares, a delicious Puerto Rican dish, features tender squid simmered in a rich, savory tomato-based sauce with sofrito, then cooked with rice until all the flavors meld beautifully.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb squid, cleaned and cut into rings
- 0.5 cup sofrito
- 0.25 cup tomato sauce
- 1 packet Sazón with Achiote
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 2 cups medium-grain rice
- 3 cups fish or chicken broth
- 0.25 cup green olives (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Chopped cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or caldero over medium-high heat. Add squid and cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly seared; remove and set aside.
2. Add sofrito to the pot and cook for 3-5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, Sazón, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Add rice and stir to coat thoroughly. Cook for 2 minutes.
5. Pour in broth, add green olives (if using), salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
6. Return squid to the pot. Reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
7. Fluff with a fork, garnish with cilantro, and serve.

name: Rice with vienna sausage, Puerto Rican style
description:
A comforting and economical Puerto Rican dish, Arroz con Salchichas features white rice cooked with sliced Vienna sausages, sofrito, and tomato sauce, creating a flavorful and satisfying meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 0.5 cup sofrito
- 0.25 cup tomato sauce
- 1 packet Sazón with Achiote
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 2 cans (4.6 oz each) Vienna sausages, drained and sliced
- 2 cups medium-grain rice
- 3 cups water or chicken broth
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Chopped cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a medium pot or caldero over medium heat.
2. Add sofrito and cook for 3-5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, Sazón, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Add sliced Vienna sausages and cook for 2-3 minutes.
5. Add rice and stir to coat thoroughly. Cook for 2 minutes.
6. Pour in water or broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
7. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
8. Fluff with a fork, garnish with cilantro, and serve.

name: Rice with Spanish sausage, Puerto Rican style
description:
Arroz con Salchichón, a hearty Puerto Rican dish, combines savory Spanish sausage (like chorizo or salchichón) with rice, sofrito, and tomato sauce, creating a deeply flavorful and satisfying one-pot meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 0.5 lb Spanish sausage (e.g., chorizo or salchichón), diced
- 0.5 cup sofrito
- 0.25 cup tomato sauce
- 1 packet Sazón with Achiote
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 2 cups medium-grain rice
- 3 cups water or chicken broth
- 0.25 cup green olives (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Chopped cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a medium pot or caldero over medium-high heat. Add diced Spanish sausage and cook until browned and some fat is rendered; remove and set aside.
2. Add sofrito to the pot and cook for 3-5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, Sazón, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Add rice and stir to coat thoroughly. Cook for 2 minutes.
5. Pour in water or broth, add green olives (if using), salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
6. Return cooked sausage to the pot. Reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
7. Fluff with a fork, garnish with cilantro, and serve.

name: Rice with stewed beans, Puerto Rican style
description:
A quintessential Puerto Rican comfort food, Arroz con Habichuelas features fluffy white rice served alongside a rich, savory stew of beans (often pink or red beans) simmered with sofrito, tomato sauce, and aromatic spices.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- For the Rice:
- 2 cups medium-grain white rice
- 3 cups water
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp salt
- For the Beans:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 0.25 cup sofrito
- 0.25 cup tomato sauce
- 1 packet Sazón with Achiote
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1 can (15 oz) pink or red beans, undrained
- 0.5 cup water or broth
- Salt and pepper to taste
- Chopped cilantro for garnish

Instructions:
1. Cook the rice: Rinse rice until water runs clear. In a pot, combine rice, water, olive oil, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until water is absorbed and rice is tender. Fluff with a fork.
2. Cook the beans: In a separate pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add sofrito and cook for 3-5 minutes until fragrant.
3. Stir in tomato sauce, Sazón, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Add undrained beans and 0.5 cup water or broth. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook for 10-15 minutes, allowing flavors to meld and sauce to thicken slightly.
5. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Garnish with cilantro.
6. Serve the stewed beans over or alongside the cooked white rice.

name: Congee, with meat, poultry, and/or seafood
description:
A comforting Asian rice porridge, this congee is slow-cooked to a creamy consistency and enriched with savory additions like shredded chicken, pork, or shrimp, offering a deeply satisfying and nourishing meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed
- 8-10 cups chicken or vegetable broth
- 0.5 lb cooked chicken (shredded), pork (sliced), or shrimp
- 1 inch ginger, sliced
- Salt to taste
- Optional garnishes: chopped scallions, fried shallots, soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper

Instructions:
1. In a large pot, combine rinsed rice and broth. Add ginger slices.
2. Bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, until rice grains have broken down and the congee is thick and creamy.
3. Stir in your choice of cooked meat, poultry, or seafood during the last 10-15 minutes of cooking to heat through.
4. Season with salt to taste.
5. Serve hot, garnished with scallions, fried shallots, a drizzle of soy sauce and sesame oil, and a dash of white pepper.

name: Congee, with meat, poultry, and/or seafood, and vegetables
description:
A wholesome and hearty Asian rice porridge, this congee is slow-cooked to a creamy texture, featuring tender meat (chicken, pork, or seafood) and a colorful array of vegetables, making it a complete and nourishing meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed
- 8-10 cups chicken or vegetable broth
- 0.5 lb cooked chicken (shredded), pork (sliced), or shrimp
- 1 inch ginger, sliced
- 0.5 cup mixed vegetables (e.g., diced carrots, peas, mushrooms)
- Salt to taste
- Optional garnishes: chopped scallions, fried shallots, soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper

Instructions:
1. In a large pot, combine rinsed rice and broth. Add ginger slices.
2. Bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, until rice grains have broken down and the congee is thick and creamy.
3. Stir in your choice of cooked meat, poultry, or seafood and mixed vegetables during the last 15-20 minutes of cooking to heat through and tenderize vegetables.
4. Season with salt to taste.
5. Serve hot, garnished with scallions, fried shallots, a drizzle of soy sauce and sesame oil, and a dash of white pepper.

name: Congee, with vegetables
description:
A light yet satisfying Asian rice porridge, this vegetarian congee is slow-cooked to a creamy consistency and infused with the subtle flavors of various vegetables, offering a comforting and healthy meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed
- 8-10 cups vegetable broth or water
- 1 inch ginger, sliced
- 1 cup mixed vegetables (e.g., diced carrots, peas, corn, mushrooms, spinach)
- Salt to taste
- Optional garnishes: chopped scallions, fried shallots, soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper

Instructions:
1. In a large pot, combine rinsed rice and broth/water. Add ginger slices.
2. Bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, until rice grains have broken down and the congee is thick and creamy.
3. Stir in mixed vegetables during the last 15-20 minutes of cooking to ensure they are tender but not overcooked.
4. Season with salt to taste.
5. Serve hot, garnished with scallions, fried shallots, a drizzle of soy sauce and sesame oil, and a dash of white pepper.

name: Congee, with egg
description:
A classic and comforting Asian rice porridge, this congee is slow-cooked to a creamy texture and often served with a soft-boiled, poached, or century egg, adding a rich, savory depth to the simple rice base.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed
- 8-10 cups chicken or vegetable broth or water
- 1 inch ginger, sliced
- 2-4 eggs (soft-boiled, poached, or century egg)
- Salt to taste
- Optional garnishes: chopped scallions, fried shallots, soy sauce, sesame oil, white pepper

Instructions:
1. In a large pot, combine rinsed rice and broth/water. Add ginger slices.
2. Bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, until rice grains have broken down and the congee is thick and creamy.
3. While congee cooks, prepare your eggs (e.g., soft-boil for 6-7 minutes, then peel).
4. Season congee with salt to taste.
5. Serve hot, topped with a prepared egg, and garnished with scallions, fried shallots, a drizzle of soy sauce and sesame oil, and a dash of white pepper.

name: Biryani with vegetables
description:
A fragrant and flavorful Indian rice dish, vegetable biryani features basmati rice cooked with a vibrant medley of mixed vegetables, aromatic spices, herbs, and sometimes yogurt, creating a rich and satisfying one-pot meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus soaking time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed and soaked for 30 minutes
- 2 tbsp ghee or oil
- 1 large onion, thinly sliced
- 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
- 1 green chili, slit
- 0.5 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, peas, beans, potatoes), diced
- 0.25 cup plain yogurt (optional)
- 1 tsp biryani masala
- 0.5 tsp turmeric powder
- 0.5 tsp red chili powder
- Salt to taste
- 2 cups water or vegetable broth
- Fresh mint and cilantro leaves, chopped, for garnish

Instructions:
1. Heat ghee/oil in a heavy-bottomed pot. Sauté sliced onion until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chili, cook for 1 minute.
2. Add mixed vegetables and cook for 5-7 minutes until slightly tender. If using, stir in yogurt.
3. Add biryani masala, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
4. Drain the soaked rice and add to the pot, stirring gently to combine with vegetables and spices.
5. Pour in water or broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is cooked.
6. Let stand for 5 minutes, then gently fluff with a fork. Garnish with fresh mint and cilantro before serving.

name: Beans and rice, from fast food / restaurant
description:
A common and satisfying side dish or meal from fast food or restaurants, typically featuring seasoned rice served alongside cooked beans, often black, pinto, or kidney beans, prepared with various spices and flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp oil
- 0.5 onion, diced
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 can (15 oz) black or pinto beans, drained and rinsed
- 0.5 cup chicken or vegetable broth
- 0.5 tsp cumin
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 2 cups cooked white rice, for serving
- Optional: chopped cilantro, hot sauce

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
2. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Stir in drained beans, broth, and cumin. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook for 5-7 minutes, allowing flavors to meld and sauce to thicken slightly.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Serve the beans over or alongside cooked white rice. Garnish with cilantro or hot sauce if desired.

name: Kidney beans and rice, from fast food / restaurant
description:
A hearty and flavorful dish often found in fast food or casual dining, featuring tender kidney beans simmered in a savory sauce, served alongside fluffy rice, offering a comforting and protein-rich meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp oil
- 0.5 onion, diced
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 can (15 oz) kidney beans, drained and rinsed
- 0.5 cup chicken or vegetable broth
- 0.5 tsp smoked paprika
- 0.25 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 2 cups cooked white rice, for serving
- Optional: chopped parsley

Instructions:
1. Heat oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
2. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Stir in drained kidney beans, broth, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper (if using). Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook for 5-7 minutes, allowing flavors to meld and sauce to thicken slightly.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Serve the kidney beans over or alongside cooked white rice. Garnish with parsley if desired.

name: Black beans and rice, from fast food / restaurant
description:
A popular and satisfying dish, particularly in Latin American cuisine, this features tender black beans simmered in a seasoned broth, served with fluffy rice, often found as a staple in fast food or restaurant settings.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp oil
- 0.5 onion, diced

A light and wholesome side, fluffy white rice is simply combined with nutritious dark green vegetables and tangy tomatoes or a tomato-based sauce, prepared without any added fats for a fresh and clean taste.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup white rice, uncooked
- 2 cups water
- 0.5 tsp salt
- 0.25 cup chopped dark green vegetables (e.g., spinach, broccoli florets)
- 0.25 cup diced tomatoes (canned, undrained) or tomato sauce
- 0.25 tsp dried basil (optional)

Instructions:
1. Combine white rice, water, salt, dark green vegetables, diced tomatoes/tomato sauce, and basil (if using) in a pot. Stir well.
2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until water is absorbed and rice is tender.
3. Let stand for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve.

name: Rice, cooked with coconut milk
description:
A fragrant and creamy side dish, white rice is cooked in rich coconut milk, often with a hint of salt, resulting in a subtly sweet, aromatic, and incredibly tender grain.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed
- 1 can (13.5 oz) full-fat coconut milk
- 0.5 cup water
- 0.5 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. Combine rinsed jasmine rice, coconut milk, water, and salt in a medium pot.
2. Bring to a gentle boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
3. Once boiling, reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.

5. Fluff with a fork and serve.

name: Beans and brown rice
description:
A wholesome and hearty combination, this dish pairs nutty brown rice with tender, seasoned beans, offering a fiber-rich and satisfying meal or side.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup brown rice, uncooked
- 2.5 cups water
- 0.5 tsp salt
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 0.5 onion, diced
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 can (15 oz) beans (e.g., black, pinto, kidney), drained and rinsed
- 0.5 cup vegetable broth
- 0.5 tsp cumin
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Cook the brown rice: Combine brown rice, water, and 0.5 tsp salt in a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 40-45 minutes until water is absorbed and rice is tender. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
2. Prepare the beans: While rice cooks, heat olive oil in a separate saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
4. Stir in drained beans, broth, and cumin. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook for 5-7 minutes, allowing flavors to meld and sauce to thicken slightly.
5. Season beans with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Serve the seasoned beans over or alongside the cooked brown rice.

name: Grape leaves stuffed with rice
description:
Tender grape leaves meticulously rolled and filled with a savory mixture of rice, herbs, and sometimes ground meat, slow-cooked to perfection for a classic Mediterranean delight.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
- 50-60 fresh or jarred grape leaves
- 1 cup short-grain rice, rinsed
- 1 lb ground beef or lamb (optional, for meat version)
- 1 large onion, finely chopped
- 2 tomatoes, grated or finely diced
- 1/2 cup fresh parsley, chopped
- 1/4 cup fresh mint, chopped
- 1/4 cup olive oil, plus more for cooking
- Juice of 2 lemons
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1/2 tsp allspice
- Water or broth for cooking

Instructions:
1. If using fresh grape leaves, blanch them in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until pliable. If using jarred, rinse thoroughly.
2. Prepare the filling: In a large bowl, combine rinsed rice, chopped onion, grated tomatoes, parsley, mint, 1/4 cup olive oil, salt, pepper, and allspice. If using meat, add ground beef/lamb and mix well.
3. Lay a grape leaf flat, shiny side down. Place a small spoonful of filling near the stem end. Fold the bottom edge over the filling, then fold in the sides, and roll tightly upwards to form a small cylinder.
4. Line the bottom of a large pot with a few extra grape leaves or sliced potatoes/tomatoes to prevent sticking.
5. Arrange the stuffed grape leaves snugly in layers in the pot. Drizzle with extra olive oil and pour in lemon juice.
6. Add enough water or broth to just cover the top layer of grape leaves. Place a heatproof plate on top to keep them submerged.
7. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1-1.5 hours, or until rice is cooked and leaves are tender. Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Rice croquette
description:
Crispy on the outside and creamy on the inside, these delightful fried or baked balls of seasoned rice are a comforting and versatile snack or appetizer.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups cooked short-grain rice, cooled
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
- 1 large egg, beaten
- 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
- 1/4 tsp salt
- Pinch of black pepper
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup breadcrumbs (panko recommended)
- Oil for frying

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine the cooled cooked rice, Parmesan cheese, beaten egg, parsley, salt, and pepper. Mix well until everything is thoroughly combined.
2. Form the rice mixture into small, uniform balls or cylindrical shapes, about 1.5 inches in diameter.
3. Set up a dredging station: one shallow dish with flour, one with the beaten egg, and one with breadcrumbs.
4. Roll each rice croquette first in flour, then dip in the beaten egg, and finally coat generously with breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
5. Heat about 2-3 inches of oil in a deep pot or skillet to 350°F (175°C).
6. Carefully fry the croquettes in batches for 3-5 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy. Do not overcrowd the pan.
7. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a wire rack lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Serve warm.

name: Stuffed pepper, with meat
description:
Bell peppers generously filled with a savory mixture of seasoned ground meat and rice, then baked until tender and bubbling in a rich tomato sauce, a classic comfort food.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 large bell peppers (any color)
- 1 lb ground beef or turkey
- 1 cup cooked rice
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 (15 oz) can tomato sauce, divided
- 1/2 cup water or beef broth
- 1 tsp Italian seasoning
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1/2 cup shredded cheese (optional, for topping)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut bell peppers in half lengthwise and remove seeds and membranes. Place cut-side up in a baking dish.
2. In a large bowl, combine ground meat, cooked rice, chopped onion, minced garlic, 1/2 cup tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
3. Spoon the meat mixture evenly into each pepper half.
4. In a separate bowl, mix the remaining tomato sauce with water or broth. Pour this sauce around the stuffed peppers in the baking dish.
5. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Uncover, and if desired, sprinkle with shredded cheese.
6. Bake uncovered for another 15-20 minutes, or until peppers are tender and the filling is cooked through and heated.
7. Serve hot, spooning extra sauce from the dish over the peppers.

description:

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil or butter
- 1 small onion, finely chopped
- 1 clove garlic, minced (optional)
- 1 cup long-grain white rice
- 2 cups chicken or vegetable broth
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish)

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil or butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add chopped onion and sauté for 3-5 minutes until softened and translucent. Add minced garlic (if using) and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant.

4. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff the rice gently with a fork. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

description:

- 1 green bell pepper, chopped
- 2 celery stalks, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced

- 2 cups chicken broth
- 1 tsp Cajun seasoning
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme
- 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
- 2 tbsp green onions, sliced

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add ground pork/beef and chicken livers (if using). Cook, breaking up the meat, until browned. Drain excess fat.
2. Add onion, bell pepper, and celery to the skillet. Cook for 5-7 minutes until vegetables soften. Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant.
3. Add the rinsed rice, Cajun seasoning, thyme, and cayenne pepper (if using). Stir well to coat the rice.
4. Pour in the chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover tightly and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
5. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Stir in fresh parsley and green onions. Season with salt and black pepper to taste before serving.

2. Add chopped onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened. Stir in minced garlic, cumin, and chili powder, cooking for 1 minute more until fragrant.
3. Pour in the tomato sauce and broth. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
4. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.

name: Spanish rice with ground beef
description:
A hearty and flavorful one-pan meal combining savory ground beef with vibrant Spanish rice, cooked with tomatoes, onions, garlic, and a blend of spices for a satisfying dish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 cup long-grain white rice, rinsed
- 1 small onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 (15 oz) can diced tomatoes, undrained
- 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce
- 2 cups beef broth
- 1 tsp chili powder
- 1 tsp cumin
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro (for garnish)

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Drain excess fat.
2. Add chopped onion to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in minced garlic, chili powder, cumin, and oregano, cooking for 1 minute more until fragrant.
3. Add the rinsed rice to the skillet and stir for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
4. Pour in the diced tomatoes (with juice), tomato sauce, and beef broth. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until rice is tender and most liquid is absorbed.
5. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.

name: Rice dressing
description:
A savory and comforting Southern side dish, often served during holidays, featuring seasoned rice mixed with ground meat (like sausage or giblets), vegetables, and aromatic spices.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 lb ground pork sausage or ground beef
- 1 cup cooked rice
- 1 large onion, chopped
- 1 green bell pepper, chopped
- 2 celery stalks, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 1 tsp Cajun seasoning
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped
- 2 tbsp green onions, sliced

Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground sausage/beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Drain excess fat.
2. Add onion, bell pepper, and celery to the skillet. Cook for 5-7 minutes until vegetables soften. Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant.
3. Stir in the cooked rice, chicken broth, Cajun seasoning, and thyme. Mix well and cook for 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the liquid to absorb.
4. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Stir in fresh parsley and green onions just before serving. Serve warm.

name: Rice with raisins
description:
A simple yet delightful dish where fluffy rice is gently cooked with sweet, plump raisins, often enhanced with a touch of cinnamon or other warm spices for a comforting side or light dessert.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup long-grain white rice
- 2 cups water or milk
- 1/2 cup raisins
- 2 tbsp sugar (adjust to taste)
- 1/2 tsp cinnamon (optional)
- Pinch of salt
- 1 tbsp butter (optional)

Instructions:
1. Rinse the rice thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear. This helps prevent stickiness.
2. In a medium saucepan, combine the rinsed rice, water (or milk), raisins, sugar, cinnamon (if using), and salt. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat.
3. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan tightly, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until all the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
4. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes. If using, stir in the butter. Fluff gently with a fork before serving warm or at room temperature.

name: Upma
description:
A popular South Indian breakfast dish, Upma is a savory porridge made from dry-roasted semolina (rava) cooked with vegetables, spices, and sometimes nuts, offering a comforting and wholesome start to the day.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup coarse semolina (rava)
- 1 tbsp oil or ghee
- 1/2 tsp mustard seeds
- 1/2 tsp cumin seeds
- 1/2 inch ginger, grated or finely chopped
- 1 green chili, slit (adjust to taste)
- 1 small onion, finely chopped
- 1/4 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, peas, beans), finely chopped
- 8-10 curry leaves
- 2.5 cups water
- 1/2 tsp salt (or to taste)
- 1 tbsp lemon juice
- 2 tbsp roasted peanuts or cashews (optional, for garnish)
- Fresh cilantro, chopped (for garnish)

Instructions:
1. Dry roast the semolina in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium-low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring continuously, until it turns aromatic and lightly golden. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
2. In the same pan, heat oil or ghee. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Then add cumin seeds, grated ginger, green chili, and curry leaves. Sauté for a few seconds.
3. Add chopped onion and mixed vegetables. Sauté for 5-7 minutes until onions are translucent and vegetables are slightly tender.
4. Pour in the water and add salt. Bring the mixture to a rolling boil.
5. Reduce the heat to low. Gradually add the roasted semolina in a thin stream, stirring continuously with one hand to prevent lumps. Stir until all the semolina is incorporated.
6. Cover the pan and cook on low heat for 5-7 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the upma is fluffy. Stir once or twice during cooking.
7. Remove from heat, fluff with a fork, and stir in lemon juice. Garnish with roasted nuts and fresh cilantro. Serve hot.

name: Dosa, with filling
description:
A popular South Indian savory crepe, thin and crispy, made from a fermented batter of rice and lentils, typically served with a flavorful potato or vegetable filling and chutneys.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus 12-18 hours for batter fermentation)

Ingredients:
- For Dosa Batter (requires overnight fermentation):
- 1.5 cups raw rice (idli rice or parboiled rice)
- 1/2 cup urad dal (split black lentils, skinned)
- 1/4 tsp fenugreek seeds
- Water for soaking and grinding
- Salt to taste
- For Potato Filling:
- 1 tbsp oil
- 1/2 tsp mustard seeds
- 1/2 tsp urad dal (optional)
- 1/2 tsp chana dal (optional)
- Pinch of asafoetida (hing)
- 8-10 curry leaves
- 1 green chili, slit
- 1 large onion, sliced
- 2 medium potatoes, boiled, peeled, and mashed
- 1/4 tsp turmeric powder
- Salt to taste
- 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro

Instructions:
1. Prepare Dosa Batter (start 12-18 hours ahead): Soak rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds separately for 4-6 hours. Grind them separately or together (urad dal first) into a smooth batter using minimal water. Combine, add salt, and ferment overnight in a warm place until doubled in volume.
2. Prepare Potato Filling: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal, asafoetida, curry leaves, and green chili. Let mustard seeds splutter.
3. Add sliced onion and sauté until translucent. Add turmeric powder and mashed potatoes. Mix well, season with salt, and cook for 2-3 minutes. Stir in fresh cilantro. Set aside.
4. Make Dosa: Heat a non-stick tawa (griddle) over medium-high heat. Lightly grease with oil. Pour a ladleful of dosa batter in the center and spread it outwards in a spiral motion to form a thin circle.
5. Drizzle a little oil around the edges. Cook until the bottom turns golden brown and crispy. Place a spoonful of potato filling in the center.
6. Fold the dosa in half or roll it up. Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.

name: Vada
description:
A savory South Indian fritter, typically made from ground lentils or potatoes, seasoned with spices and herbs, then deep-fried until golden and crispy, often served with chutney or sambar.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus 3-4 hours soaking time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup urad dal (split black lentils, skinned)
- 1/4 inch ginger, grated
- 1 green chili, finely chopped (adjust to taste)
- 1 small onion, finely chopped (optional)
- 8-10 curry leaves, chopped
- 2 tbsp fresh cilantro, chopped
- 1/2 tsp black peppercorns, crushed
- Salt to taste
- Oil for deep frying

Instructions:
1. Wash and soak urad dal in water for 3-4 hours. Drain the water completely.
2. Grind the soaked urad dal with grated ginger, green chili, and a minimal amount of water (just enough to make a thick, coarse batter). The batter should be thick and fluffy, not watery.
3. Transfer the batter to a bowl. Add chopped onion (if using), curry leaves, cilantro, crushed peppercorns, and salt. Mix well.
4. Heat oil for deep frying in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
5. Wet your hands, take a small portion of the batter, flatten it slightly, and make a hole in the center (like a donut). Carefully slide it into the hot oil.
6. Fry the vadas in batches until golden brown and crispy on both sides. Turn them occasionally to ensure even cooking.
7. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain excess oil on paper towels. Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.

name: Tabbouleh
description:
A refreshing and vibrant Middle Eastern salad, Tabbouleh is made with finely chopped parsley, mint, tomatoes, onion, and bulgur wheat, dressed simply with olive oil and lemon juice.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes (plus 30 minutes chilling)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup fine bulgur wheat
- 1 cup boiling water
- 2 large bunches fresh parsley, finely chopped
- 1/2 cup fresh mint, finely chopped
- 3-4 ripe Roma tomatoes, finely diced
- 1/2 small red onion, very finely minced
- 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice (about 1-2 lemons)
- 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
- 1/2 tsp salt (or to taste)
- Pinch of black pepper

Instructions:
1. Place bulgur wheat in a heatproof bowl. Pour boiling water over it, cover, and let sit for 15-20 minutes until the bulgur is tender and has absorbed the water. Drain any excess water and fluff with a fork. Let it cool.
2. While bulgur cools, prepare the vegetables: finely chop parsley, mint, tomatoes, and mince the red onion. Ensure all ingredients are very finely chopped for the authentic tabbouleh texture.
3. In a large bowl, combine the cooled bulgur, chopped parsley, mint, tomatoes, and red onion.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
5. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine all ingredients. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
6. For best flavor, let the tabbouleh sit in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving. Serve chilled.

name: Vegetable sandwich on white

6. Cut in half diagonally or straight across and serve immediately.

name: Soup, chicken noodle
description:
