description: Dried Wocas seeds, from the Oregon yellow pond lily, are a traditional and significant food source for the Klamath people, often ground into flour.

name: Hazelnuts, beaked (Northern Plains Indians)
description: Small and flavorful, beaked hazelnuts are a traditional wild nut for Northern Plains Indians, gathered and enjoyed for their rich, buttery taste.

name: Tea, herbal, brewed, Hohoysi (Hopi)
description:
Hohoysi, a traditional Hopi herbal tea, is brewed for its soothing qualities and cultural significance, offering a warm and comforting beverage.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1-2 tsp dried Hohoysi herb (or other traditional herbal tea blend)
- 1 cup hot water

Instructions:
1. Place the dried Hohoysi herb in a mug. Pour hot (not boiling) water over the herbs.
2. Steep for 5-10 minutes, or to desired strength. Strain the herbs and enjoy the warm tea. Sweeten with honey if desired.

name: Tortilla, blue corn, Sakwavikaviki (Hopi)
description:
Sakwavikaviki, a traditional Hopi blue corn tortilla, is a staple food, celebrated for its distinctive color, earthy flavor, and cultural importance.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup blue corn masa harina
- 3/4 cup warm water (approx.)
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine masa harina and salt. Gradually add warm water, mixing until a soft, pliable dough forms. Knead for a few minutes.
2. Divide dough into small balls. Using a tortilla press or rolling pin, flatten each ball between two pieces of plastic wrap into a thin tortilla.
3. Cook each tortilla on a hot, ungreased comal or skillet for 1-2 minutes per side, until lightly browned and cooked through. Keep warm in a tortilla warmer or wrapped in a clean towel.

name: Bread, blue corn, somiviki (Hopi)
description:
Somiviki, a traditional Hopi blue corn bread, is a culturally significant food, often steamed in corn husks, offering a unique texture and earthy, sweet flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup blue cornmeal
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 tbsp sugar (optional)
- 1 cup milk
- 1/4 cup melted butter or vegetable oil
- Corn husks for wrapping

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine blue cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar (if using).
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together milk and melted butter/oil. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
3. Prepare corn husks by soaking them in warm water until pliable. Place a spoonful of batter onto each husk, fold the husk to enclose the batter, and tie with a strip of husk or string.
4. Steam the wrapped somiviki in a steamer basket over boiling water for 30-40 minutes, or until firm. Serve warm.

name: Restaurant, family style, french fries
description:
Crispy, golden french fries, a classic side dish at family-style restaurants, perfectly seasoned and ideal for dipping.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-4
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 large russet potatoes
- 4 cups vegetable oil for frying
- Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into 1/4-inch thick sticks. Rinse cut potatoes in cold water to remove excess starch, then pat thoroughly dry with paper towels.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large pot or deep fryer to 325°F (160°C). Fry potatoes in batches for 5-7 minutes, until soft but not browned. Remove and drain on paper towels.
3. Increase oil temperature to 375°F (190°C). Fry potatoes again in batches for 2-4 minutes, until golden brown and crispy. Remove, drain, and immediately season with salt. Serve hot.

name: Restaurant, family style, chicken fingers, from kid's menu
description:
Tender strips of chicken, breaded and fried to a golden crisp, a popular and kid-friendly choice at family-style restaurants, often served with dipping sauces.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 large egg, beaten
- 1 cup breadcrumbs (plain or seasoned)
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- Vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. Season chicken strips with salt and pepper. Set up a breading station: one shallow dish with flour, one with beaten egg, and one with breadcrumbs.
2. Dredge each chicken strip first in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, and finally coat thoroughly in breadcrumbs.
3. Heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350°F (175°C). Fry chicken fingers in batches for 3-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F/74°C). Drain on paper towels and serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.

name: Restaurant, family style, shrimp, breaded and fried
description:
Succulent shrimp, coated in a crispy breading and fried to a golden perfection, a popular appetizer or main course at family-style restaurants.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails on or off
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 large egg, beaten
- 1 cup breadcrumbs (plain or panko)
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- Vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. Pat shrimp dry with paper towels. Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Set up a breading station: one shallow dish with flour, one with beaten egg, and one with breadcrumbs.
2. Dredge each shrimp first in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, and finally coat thoroughly in breadcrumbs.
3. Heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet or deep pot over medium-high heat to 350°F (175°C). Fry shrimp in batches for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Do not overcrowd the pan. Drain on paper towels and serve hot with cocktail sauce or lemon wedges.

name: Restaurant, family style, macaroni & cheese, from kids' menu
description:
A creamy and comforting classic, this macaroni & cheese from a family-style restaurant's kids' menu features tender pasta in a rich, cheesy sauce, a perennial favorite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup elbow macaroni
- 2 tbsp butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 1 1/2 cups milk
- 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
- 1/4 tsp salt
- Pinch of black pepper

Instructions:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
2. In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, to form a roux.
3. Gradually whisk in milk until smooth. Bring to a simmer, stirring, until sauce thickens slightly. Remove from heat.
4. Stir in shredded cheddar cheese, salt, and pepper until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth. Add the cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce and stir to combine. Serve warm.

name: Restaurant, family style, fish fillet, battered or breaded, fried
description:
A classic comfort food, this fish fillet is coated in a crispy batter or breading and fried to a golden perfection, offering a tender, flaky interior.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 white fish fillets (e.g., cod, tilapia), about 6 oz each
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1 large egg, beaten
- 1 cup breadcrumbs or panko
- Vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper. Set up a breading station: one shallow dish with flour, one with beaten egg, and one with breadcrumbs/panko.
2. Dredge each fillet first in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, and finally coat thoroughly in breadcrumbs/panko.
3. Heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350°F (175°C). Carefully place fillets in the hot oil. Fry for 3-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fish flakes easily with a fork. Drain on paper towels and serve hot with lemon wedges or tartar sauce.

name: Restaurant, family style, chicken tenders
description:
Juicy strips of chicken, often lightly breaded and fried or baked, offering a versatile and popular choice for a meal or appetizer at family-style restaurants.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken tenders
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 large egg, beaten
- 1 cup breadcrumbs (plain or seasoned)
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- Vegetable oil for frying (or cooking spray for baking)

Instructions:
1. Season chicken tenders with salt and pepper. Set up a breading station: one shallow dish with flour, one with beaten egg, and one with breadcrumbs.
2. Dredge each chicken tender first in flour, shaking off excess, then dip in egg, and finally coat thoroughly in breadcrumbs.
3. For frying: Heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350°F (175°C). Fry tenders in batches for 3-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F/74°C).
4. For baking: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place breaded tenders on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray. Bake for 15-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through. Drain fried tenders on paper towels. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.

name: Restaurant, family style, hash browns
description:
Crispy, golden-brown shredded potatoes, pan-fried to perfection, a classic breakfast or side dish at family-style restaurants.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 large russet potatoes
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil or butter
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper

Instructions:
1. Peel and grate potatoes using a box grater or food processor. Place grated potatoes in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much excess moisture as possible. This is crucial for crispiness.
2. Season the dried shredded potatoes with salt and pepper. Heat oil or butter in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shredded potatoes to the hot skillet, pressing them down into an even layer.
3. Cook for 5-7 minutes without disturbing, until a golden-brown crust forms on the bottom. Flip the hash browns and cook for another 5-7 minutes, or until the other side is also golden and crispy. Serve hot.

name: Restaurant, Mexican, cheese enchilada
description:
A classic Mexican dish, cheese enchiladas feature soft corn tortillas rolled around a generous filling of melted cheese, smothered in a rich, savory red or green sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 35 minutes

Ingredients:
- 8 corn tortillas
- 2 cups shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1 can (10 oz) red or green enchilada sauce
- Optional toppings: sour cream, chopped onions, cilantro

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. In a small skillet, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Quickly dip each tortilla in the hot oil for a few seconds per side to soften (do not fry until crispy).
3. Place a spoonful of shredded cheese down the center of each softened tortilla, then roll it up. Arrange the rolled enchiladas seam-side down in the prepared baking dish.
4. Pour the enchilada sauce evenly over the enchiladas, ensuring they are well covered. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the sauce is heated through. Serve hot, garnished with optional toppings.

name: Restaurant, Mexican, cheese tamales
description:
Steamed masa dough, traditionally wrapped in corn husks, filled with a savory cheese mixture, offering a comforting and authentic taste of Mexican cuisine.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6
Prep Time: 1 hour 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup masa harina for tamales
- 1/2 cup warm chicken broth or water
- 1/4 cup lard or vegetable shortening, softened
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/4 tsp salt
- 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack or Oaxaca cheese
- 12-15 dried corn husks, soaked and drained

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, beat softened lard/shortening until fluffy. In a separate bowl, combine masa harina, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the masa mixture to the lard, alternating with warm broth, mixing until a soft, spreadable dough forms. The dough should float a small piece in a glass of water.
2. Spread a thin layer of masa dough onto the wider end of a soaked corn husk. Place a spoonful of shredded cheese in the center. Fold the sides of the husk over the filling, then fold up the bottom.
3. Arrange tamales upright in a steamer basket. Steam for 45-60 minutes, or until the masa pulls away easily from the husk. Serve hot.

name: Snacks, popcorn, home-prepared, oil-popped, unsalted
description:
Light and airy popcorn, freshly popped in oil at home, offering a simple, unsalted snack that's perfect for customizing with your favorite seasonings.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup unpopped popcorn kernels
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil (e.g., canola, coconut)
- Large pot with a lid

Instructions:
1. Pour oil into a large, heavy-bottomed pot with a lid. Add 2-3 popcorn kernels to the pot. Cover and heat over medium-high heat.
2. Once those test kernels pop, remove them and add the remaining 1/2 cup of kernels in an even layer. Cover the pot and remove it from the heat for 30 seconds (this helps all kernels heat evenly).
3. Return the pot to medium-high heat. Shake the pot occasionally to prevent burning. Once popping slows to several seconds between pops, remove from heat. Let sit for a minute to allow any remaining kernels to pop. Pour into a large bowl. Serve unsalted, or add salt and other seasonings to taste.

name: Salad dressing, sweet and sour
description:
A zesty and balanced dressing, combining sweet and tangy notes, perfect for enlivening salads or as a dipping sauce.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup rice vinegar
- 1/4 cup sugar
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp ketchup
- 1 tsp cornstarch (mixed with 1 tbsp cold water)
- 1/4 tsp garlic powder
- Pinch of red pepper flakes (optional)

Instructions:
1. In a small saucepan, combine rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, ketchup, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes (if using). Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves.
2. Whisk in the cornstarch slurry and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens to your desired consistency. Remove from heat and let cool. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator. Shake well before serving.

name: Salad dressing, blue or roquefort cheese, low calorie
description:
A lighter version of the classic, this low-calorie blue or Roquefort cheese dressing offers the pungent, creamy flavor of aged cheese without the extra calories, perfect for salads.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup plain non-fat Greek yogurt
- 1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese or Roquefort
- 2 tbsp skim milk
- 1 tbsp white wine vinegar
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, combine Greek yogurt, crumbled blue cheese, skim milk, white wine vinegar, and garlic powder. Whisk until well combined.
2. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. For a smoother dressing, you can blend it briefly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld. Serve chilled over your favorite salad.

name: Salad dressing, caesar, low calorie
description:
A lighter take on the beloved Caesar dressing, offering all the garlicky, tangy, and savory notes with fewer calories, perfect for a guilt-free salad.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1/2 cup plain non-fat Greek yogurt
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 tbsp Dijon mustard
- 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- Salt to taste
- 2 tbsp grated Parmesan cheese (optional)

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, combine Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, minced garlic, and black pepper. Whisk until smooth.
2. Stir in Parmesan cheese if desired. Season with salt to taste. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld. Serve chilled over your favorite Caesar salad.

name: Vegetarian meatloaf or patties
description:
Hearty and flavorful, vegetarian meatloaf or patties are plant-based alternatives to traditional meat dishes, offering a satisfying and nutritious meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
- 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
- 1/4 cup finely chopped onion
- 1 clove garlic, minced
- 1 tbsp soy sauce or tamari
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1/2 tsp cumin
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1 tbsp olive oil for cooking

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, mash the black beans with a fork until mostly smooth but still a bit chunky. Add breadcrumbs, chopped onion, minced garlic, soy sauce, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper. Mix well until everything is combined and the mixture holds together.
2. Form the mixture into 4-6 patties. Heat olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook patties for 4-6 minutes per side, or until golden brown and heated through. Serve on buns or with a side salad.

name: Radishes, hawaiian style, pickled
description:
Crisp and tangy radishes, pickled in a Hawaiian style, offering a refreshing and zesty condiment with a hint of sweetness.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus chilling time)

Ingredients:
- 1 bunch radishes, thinly sliced
- 1/2 cup rice vinegar
- 1/4 cup water
- 2 tbsp sugar
- 1/2 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. Wash and thinly slice the radishes. Place them in a clean jar or heatproof bowl.
2. In a small saucepan, combine rice vinegar, water, sugar, and salt. Heat over medium heat, stirring until sugar and salt are fully dissolved. Bring to a gentle simmer, then remove from heat.
3. Pour the hot pickling liquid over the sliced radishes, ensuring they are fully submerged. Let cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving. Best if marinated overnight.

name: Cabbage, japanese style, fresh, pickled
description:
Crunchy and refreshing, Japanese-style pickled fresh cabbage offers a tangy and slightly sweet condiment, perfect for complementing various dishes.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 30 minutes (plus chilling time)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 head green cabbage, thinly sliced
- 1 tbsp salt
- 1/4 cup rice vinegar
- 2 tbsp sugar
- 1/2 tsp dashi powder (optional)

Instructions:
1. Thinly slice the cabbage and place it in a large bowl. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp salt and massage the cabbage for 2-3 minutes until it starts to soften and release liquid. Let sit for 15-20 minutes.
2. Squeeze out as much excess water from the cabbage as possible. In a separate bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, sugar, and dashi powder (if using) until sugar dissolves. Add the squeezed cabbage to the dressing and mix well. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving. Best if marinated for a few hours or overnight.

name: Eggplant, pickled
description:
Tender and tangy, pickled eggplant offers a unique flavor profile, often infused with herbs and spices, making it a versatile condiment or appetizer.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus salting and chilling time)

Ingredients:
- 1 medium eggplant, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
- 1 tbsp salt
- 1 cup white vinegar
- 1 cup water
- 2 cloves garlic, sliced
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes (optional)
- 2 tbsp olive oil

Instructions:
1. Place eggplant cubes in a colander, sprinkle with 1 tbsp salt, and let sit for 30 minutes to draw out moisture. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry.
2. In a large pot, bring vinegar and water to a boil. Add eggplant and simmer for 5-7 minutes, until tender but still firm. Drain the eggplant well.
3. In a clean jar, layer eggplant with sliced garlic, oregano, and red pepper flakes. Pour olive oil over the eggplant. Ensure eggplant is submerged in liquid (add more olive oil or a mix of vinegar/water if needed). Seal and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving. Will keep for several weeks.

name: Eggs, scrambled, frozen mixture
description:
A convenient, pre-mixed and frozen blend of eggs, ready to be quickly cooked into fluffy scrambled eggs, perfect for a fast breakfast.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1-2
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 large eggs
- 1 tablespoon milk or cream (optional)
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- Pinch of black pepper
- 1 teaspoon butter or oil

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, whisk together eggs, milk (if using), salt, and pepper until well combined.
2. Heat butter or oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat until melted and shimmering.
3. Pour the egg mixture into the hot skillet.
4. Let the eggs set for about 30 seconds without stirring.
5. Gently push the cooked edges towards the center with a spatula, tilting the pan to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath.
6. Continue cooking and gently folding until the eggs are mostly set but still slightly moist.
7. Remove from heat and serve immediately.

name: Pork, cured, ham, boneless, low sodium, extra lean and regular, roasted
description:
A savory, boneless ham, cured and roasted to perfection, offering a delicious balance of extra lean and regular cuts with reduced sodium for a healthier option.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 8-12
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 (3-5 lb) boneless, fully cooked ham, low sodium
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard
- 1/4 cup pineapple juice (optional)
- Whole cloves (optional)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Place ham in a roasting pan.
2. Score the surface of the ham in a diamond pattern, about 1/4 inch deep. If desired, insert a whole clove into the center of each diamond.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together brown sugar, Dijon mustard, and pineapple juice (if using) to create a glaze.
4. Brush about half of the glaze over the ham.
5. Roast for 15-20 minutes per pound, or according to package directions, until heated through (internal temperature of 140°F/60°C).
6. During the last 20-30 minutes of roasting, brush the remaining glaze over the ham every 10 minutes.
7. Remove from oven, let rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Peaches, dehydrated (low-moisture), sulfured, stewed
description:
Tender and sweet stewed dehydrated peaches, rehydrated and gently cooked to create a comforting and flavorful fruit dish.

Prep Time: 5 minutes (plus soaking time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup dehydrated peach slices
- 2 cups water
- 1-2 tablespoons sugar (optional, to taste)
- Pinch of cinnamon (optional)

Instructions:
1. Rinse the dehydrated peach slices under cold water.
2. Place peaches and water in a saucepan. Let soak for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours, to soften.
3. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat.
4. Add sugar and cinnamon, if desired.
5. Cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the peaches are tender and plump, and the liquid has slightly thickened.

name: Potatoes, hash brown, home-prepared
description:
Golden brown and crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, classic homemade hash browns are the ultimate breakfast side, perfect for soaking up runny egg yolks.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 large russet potatoes
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- Salt to taste
- Black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Peel and grate the potatoes using a box grater or food processor.
2. Rinse the grated potatoes under cold water until the water runs clear. This removes excess starch.
3. Squeeze out as much moisture as possible from the grated potatoes using a clean kitchen towel or paper towels. This is crucial for crispiness.
4. Heat vegetable oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add the grated potatoes to the hot skillet, spreading them into an even layer. Do not overcrowd the pan; cook in batches if necessary.
6. Cook undisturbed for 5-7 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown and crispy.
7. Season generously with salt and pepper.
8. Flip the hash browns and cook for another 5-7 minutes, or until the other side is also golden and crispy.
9. Serve immediately.

name: Potatoes, mashed, home-prepared, whole milk and margarine added
description:
Creamy, fluffy, and comforting, homemade mashed potatoes with whole milk and margarine are a timeless side dish, perfect for any meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and quartered
- 1/2 cup whole milk, warmed
- 4 tbsp margarine
- Salt to taste
- Black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Place peeled and quartered potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold water. Add a pinch of salt.
2. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until potatoes are fork-tender.
3. Drain the potatoes thoroughly in a colander.
4. Return the drained potatoes to the empty hot pot over low heat for 1-2 minutes to dry them out slightly, shaking the pot occasionally.
5. Remove from heat. Add the warmed milk and margarine to the pot.
6. Mash the potatoes with a potato masher or fork until smooth and creamy. Do not over-mash, or they will become gummy.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve hot.

name: Potatoes, scalloped, home-prepared with butter
description:
Layers of thinly sliced potatoes baked in a rich, creamy, buttery sauce until golden and bubbly, scalloped potatoes are a decadent and comforting classic.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 large russet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced (about 1/8 inch thick)
- 4 tbsp unsalted butter
- 4 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 3 cups whole milk, warmed
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1/4 tsp nutmeg (optional)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, to create a roux.
3. Gradually whisk in the warm milk until smooth. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens (about 3-5 minutes).
4. Remove from heat and stir in salt, pepper, and nutmeg (if using).
5. Arrange one-third of the potato slices in an even layer in the prepared baking dish.
6. Pour one-third of the cream sauce evenly over the potatoes.
7. Repeat layers two more times, ending with a layer of sauce.
8. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
9. Remove foil and bake for another 20-30 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown and bubbly.
10. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Sweet potato, cooked, candied, home-prepared
description:
A beloved holiday classic, home-prepared candied sweet potatoes are tender, sweet, and glazed to perfection, offering a comforting and indulgent side dish.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch rounds
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1/4 cup water or orange juice
- 1 tsp ground cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg
- Pinch of salt

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. Arrange the sweet potato slices in an even layer in the prepared baking dish.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together brown sugar, melted butter, water (or orange juice), cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt until well combined.
4. Pour the mixture evenly over the sweet potatoes.
5. Cover the baking dish tightly with aluminum foil.
6. Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 20-30 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and the sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
7. Baste the potatoes with the sauce occasionally during the uncovered baking time.
8. Serve warm.

name: Potato pancakes
description:
Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, potato pancakes (latkes) are a savory delight, traditionally fried to a golden brown and often served with applesauce or sour cream.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 large russet potatoes, peeled
- 1/2 small onion, grated
- 1 large egg, beaten
- 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- Vegetable oil, for frying

Instructions:
1. Grate the peeled potatoes using the large holes of a box grater or a food processor. Immediately place grated potatoes in a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
2. In a large bowl, combine the squeezed grated potatoes, grated onion, beaten egg, flour, salt, and pepper. Mix well until just combined.
3. Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Once the oil is hot, drop spoonfuls of the potato mixture into the skillet, flattening them slightly with the back of a spoon to form pancakes (about 3-4 inches in diameter). Do not overcrowd the pan.
5. Fry for 3-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.
6. Transfer cooked potato pancakes to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil.
7. Serve hot with applesauce or sour cream, if desired.

name: Fast foods, nachos, with cheese
description:
A classic snack or appetizer featuring crispy tortilla chips generously topped with melted cheese, a simple yet satisfying indulgence.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-4
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 bag tortilla chips
- 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
- 1/4 cup pickled jalapeños (optional)

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. 2. Spread tortilla chips in a single layer on a baking sheet.
3. 3. Sprinkle shredded cheese evenly over the chips.
4. 4. Bake for 5-7 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
5. 5. Top with jalapeños if desired. Serve immediately.

name: Fast foods, nachos, with cheese, beans, ground beef, and tomatoes
description:
A hearty and flavorful plate of nachos, loaded with crispy tortilla chips, melted cheese, seasoned ground beef, savory beans, and fresh diced tomatoes.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 bag tortilla chips
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 packet taco seasoning
- 1 can (15 oz) refried beans
- 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
- 1 large tomato diced
- 1/2 cup pickled jalapeños (optional)
- sour cream and salsa for serving

Instructions:
1. 1. Brown ground beef in a skillet, drain fat. Stir in taco seasoning according to package directions.
2. 2. Warm refried beans in a separate saucepan.
3. 3. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
4. 4. Spread half the tortilla chips on a large baking sheet. Layer with half the ground beef, half the beans, and half the cheese. Repeat with remaining chips, beef, beans, and cheese.
5. 5. Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
6. 6. Remove from oven, top with diced tomatoes and jalapeños. Serve with sour cream and salsa.

name: Fast foods, cheeseburger, double, regular patty and bun, with condiments
description:
A classic double cheeseburger featuring two juicy beef patties, melted cheese, and fresh condiments, all nestled in a soft bun for a satisfying meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground beef (80/20)
- 4 slices American cheese
- 2 hamburger buns
- 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
- 4 slices tomato
- 2 tbsp ketchup
- 2 tbsp mustard
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise
- salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. 1. Divide ground beef into 4 equal patties, season with salt and pepper.
2. 2. Heat a skillet or grill to medium-high. Cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Place a slice of cheese on each patty during the last minute of cooking to melt.
3. 3. Lightly toast buns.
4. 4. Assemble burgers: bottom bun, two cheeseburger patties, lettuce, tomato, ketchup, mustard, mayonnaise, top bun.

name: Fast foods, cheeseburger; single, large patty; plain
description:
A simple yet satisfying cheeseburger with a single, large, juicy beef patty and melted cheese, served plain on a soft bun.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1/2 lb ground beef (80/20)
- 1 slice American cheese
- 1 hamburger bun
- salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. 1. Form ground beef into a large patty, season with salt and pepper.
2. 2. Heat a skillet or grill to medium-high. Cook patty for 4-5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Place cheese on top during the last minute of cooking to melt.
3. 3. Lightly toast bun.
4. 4. Assemble burger: bottom bun, cheeseburger patty, top bun.

name: Fast foods, chicken fillet sandwich, plain with pickles
description:
A crispy or grilled chicken fillet, served simply on a bun with tangy pickles, offering a straightforward and delicious sandwich experience.

--- RECIPE ---

Ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (4-6 oz each)
- 2 hamburger buns
- 1/4 cup dill pickle slices
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. 1. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
2. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet or preheat grill to medium-high. Cook chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
3. 3. Lightly toast buns.
4. 4. Assemble: bottom bun, chicken fillet, pickles, top bun.

name: Fast foods, fish sandwich, with tartar sauce
description:

Ingredients:
- 2 frozen breaded fish fillets
- 2 hamburger buns
- 1/4 cup tartar sauce
- 2 lettuce leaves

Instructions:
1. 1. Cook fish fillets according to package directions (bake or fry).
2. 2. Lightly toast buns.
3. 3. Assemble: bottom bun, lettuce leaf, cooked fish fillet, generous dollop of tartar sauce, top bun.

name: Fast foods, fish sandwich, with tartar sauce and cheese
description:
An enhanced fish sandwich, combining a crispy fish fillet, creamy tartar sauce, and a slice of melted cheese, all on a soft bun for extra richness.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 frozen breaded fish fillets
- 2 slices American cheese
- 2 hamburger buns

Instructions:

2. 2. Lightly toast buns.
3. 3. Assemble: bottom bun, lettuce leaf, cheesy fish fillet, generous dollop of tartar sauce, top bun.

name: Fast foods, submarine sandwich, roast beef on white bread with lettuce and tomato
description:
A classic submarine sandwich filled with tender slices of roast beef, crisp lettuce, and juicy tomatoes, served on fresh white bread.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 long white submarine roll
- 4 oz thinly sliced roast beef
- 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
- 2-3 slices tomato
- 1 tbsp mayonnaise
- salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. 1. Slice the submarine roll lengthwise, but not all the way through.
2. 2. Spread mayonnaise on both sides of the bread.
3. 3. Layer roast beef, then lettuce, then tomato slices. Season with salt and pepper.
4. 4. Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Fast foods, submarine sandwich, tuna on white bread with lettuce and tomato
description:
A refreshing submarine sandwich featuring creamy tuna salad, crisp lettuce, and fresh tomatoes, all served on soft white bread.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 long white submarine roll
- 1 can (5 oz) tuna in water (drained)
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise
- 1/4 cup chopped celery (optional)
- 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
- 2-3 slices tomato
- salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. 1. In a bowl, mix drained tuna with mayonnaise and chopped celery (if using). Season with salt and pepper.
2. 2. Slice the submarine roll lengthwise, but not all the way through.
3. 3. Spread tuna salad evenly inside the roll.
4. 4. Layer with shredded lettuce and tomato slices.
5. 5. Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Fast foods, coleslaw
description:
A classic side dish of shredded cabbage and carrots tossed in a creamy, tangy dressing, offering a refreshing crunch.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 15 minutes (plus 30 min chilling)

Ingredients:
- 1/2 head green cabbage (shredded)
- 1 large carrot (shredded)
- 1/2 cup mayonnaise
- 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, combine shredded cabbage and carrot.
2. 2. In a separate small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper until smooth.
3. 3. Pour dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss until well coated.
4. 4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.

name: Fast foods, hush puppies
description:
Golden-fried, savory cornmeal fritters, often seasoned with onion, offering a crispy exterior and a soft, flavorful interior, a perfect accompaniment to seafood.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup cornmeal
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 large egg
- 1/4 cup finely chopped onion
- vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. 1. In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and cayenne pepper.
2. 2. In a separate bowl, whisk milk and egg. Stir in chopped onion.
3. 3. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix until just combined (do not overmix).
4. 4. Heat 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep pot or Dutch oven to 350°F (175°C).
5. 5. Drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil, frying in batches, until golden brown and cooked through (about 2-3 minutes per side).
6. 6. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve warm.

name: Fast food, biscuit
description:
A warm, flaky, and buttery biscuit, perfect for breakfast with jam, gravy, or as a side to any meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1 tsp sugar
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup (1 stick) cold unsalted butter (cut into small pieces)
- 3/4 cup cold milk

Instructions:
1. 1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
2. 2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
3. 3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. 4. Gradually add cold milk, mixing until just combined and a shaggy dough forms. Do not overmix.
5. 5. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Gently pat or roll to about 3/4-inch thickness.
6. 6. Cut out biscuits using a round cutter. Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
7. 7. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown on top.

name: Fast foods, submarine sandwich, sweet onion chicken teriyaki on white bread with lettuce, tomato and sweet onion sauce
description:
A flavorful submarine sandwich featuring tender chicken teriyaki, crisp lettuce, juicy tomatoes, and a sweet onion sauce, all on fresh white bread.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 long white submarine roll
- 4 oz cooked chicken breast (sliced or shredded)
- 2 tbsp teriyaki sauce
- 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
- 2-3 slices tomato
- 2 tbsp sweet onion sauce (or a mix of mayo, honey, and finely diced onion)

Instructions:
1. 1. If chicken is not already teriyaki flavored, toss cooked chicken with teriyaki sauce.
2. 2. Slice the submarine roll lengthwise, but not all the way through.
3. 3. Layer chicken, then lettuce, then tomato slices.
4. 4. Drizzle with sweet onion sauce.
5. 5. Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Fast foods, submarine sandwich, turkey, roast beef and ham on white bread with lettuce and tomato
description:
A robust "club-style" submarine sandwich, packed with slices of turkey, roast beef, and ham, along with crisp lettuce and fresh tomatoes, on white bread.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 long white submarine roll
- 2 oz sliced turkey breast
- 2 oz sliced roast beef
- 2 oz sliced ham
- 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
- 2-3 slices tomato
- 1 tbsp mayonnaise or mustard
- salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. 1. Slice the submarine roll lengthwise, but not all the way through.
2. 2. Spread mayonnaise or mustard on both sides of the bread.
3. 3. Layer turkey, then roast beef, then ham.
4. 4. Top with shredded lettuce and tomato slices. Season with salt and pepper.
5. 5. Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Fast foods, submarine sandwich, oven roasted chicken on white bread with lettuce and tomato
description:
A simple and satisfying submarine sandwich filled with tender oven-roasted chicken, crisp lettuce, and juicy tomatoes, served on fresh white bread.

2. 2. Spread mayonnaise on both sides of the bread.
3. 3. Layer sliced chicken, then lettuce, then tomato slices. Season with salt and pepper.
4. 4. Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Fast foods, submarine sandwich, steak and cheese on white bread with cheese, lettuce and tomato
description:
A savory submarine sandwich featuring thinly sliced steak, melted cheese, crisp lettuce, and fresh tomatoes, all on white bread.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 long white submarine roll
- 4 oz thinly sliced steak (e.g., ribeye or sirloin)
- 2 slices provolone or American cheese
- 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
- 2-3 slices tomato
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add sliced steak and cook until browned and cooked through, seasoning with salt and pepper.
2. 2. During the last minute of cooking, place cheese slices over the steak to melt.
3. 3. Slice the submarine roll lengthwise, but not all the way through.
4. 4. Fill the roll with the cheesy steak mixture.
5. 5. Top with shredded lettuce and tomato slices.
6. 6. Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Fast foods, submarine sandwich, bacon, lettuce, and tomato on white bread
description:
A classic BLT in submarine form, featuring crispy bacon, fresh lettuce, and juicy tomatoes, served on soft white bread.

--- RECIPE ---

Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 long white submarine roll
- 4-6 slices cooked bacon
- 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
- 2-3 slices tomato
- 1 tbsp mayonnaise
- salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. 1. Cook bacon until crispy. Drain on paper towels.
2. 2. Slice the submarine roll lengthwise, but not all the way through.
3. 3. Spread mayonnaise on both sides of the bread.
4. 4. Layer bacon, then lettuce, then tomato slices. Season with salt and pepper.
5. 5. Close the sandwich and serve.

name: Pizza, cheese topping, regular crust, frozen, cooked
description: A convenient frozen cheese pizza with a regular crust, cooked to a golden crisp, offering a quick and satisfying meal.

name: Fast Foods, crispy chicken filet sandwich, with lettuce and mayonnaise
description:
A popular fast-food sandwich featuring a golden, crispy chicken fillet, fresh lettuce, and creamy mayonnaise, all on a soft bun.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (4-6 oz each)
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp paprika
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1 large egg
- 1/4 cup milk
- 2 hamburger buns
- 1/4 cup shredded lettuce
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise
- vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. 1. Pound chicken breasts to an even thickness.
2. 2. In one shallow dish, mix flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. In another, whisk egg and milk.
3. 3. Dredge each chicken breast in flour mixture, then egg mixture, then flour mixture again, pressing to coat.
4. 4. Heat 1-2 inches of oil in a large skillet to 350°F (175°C). Fry chicken for 4-6 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on paper towels.
5. 5. Lightly toast buns.
6. 6. Assemble: bottom bun, mayonnaise, lettuce, crispy chicken fillet, top bun.

name: Yogurt parfait, lowfat, with fruit and granola
description:
A delightful layered treat combining creamy low-fat yogurt, fresh fruit, and crunchy granola, offering a healthy and satisfying breakfast or snack.

Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup low-fat vanilla yogurt
- 1/2 cup mixed berries (fresh or frozen)
- 1/4 cup granola

Instructions:
1. 1. In a glass or bowl, layer half the yogurt.
2. 2. Top with half the fruit and half the granola.
3. 3. Repeat layers with remaining yogurt, fruit, and granola.
4. 4. Serve immediately or chill for later.

description:

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 boneless, skinless chicken breast filet
- 1 hamburger bun
- 1 lettuce leaf
- 2 slices ripe tomato
- 1 tbsp mayonnaise or preferred spread
- 1 tsp olive oil
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Season chicken filet with salt and pepper.
2. Heat olive oil in a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Grill chicken for 4-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through and no longer pink.
4. Lightly toast the hamburger bun.
5. Spread mayonnaise on both halves of the bun.
6. Place the grilled chicken filet on the bottom bun.
7. Top with lettuce leaf and tomato slices.
8. Cover with the top bun and serve immediately.

name: Potatoes, au gratin, home-prepared from recipe using butter
description:
Rich and creamy potatoes au gratin, lovingly prepared at home with layers of thinly sliced potatoes baked in a savory, buttery cream sauce, often topped with cheese.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 large russet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
- 2 tbsp unsalted butter
- 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
- 2 cups whole milk
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1/4 tsp nutmeg (optional)
- 1 cup shredded Gruyere or cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute.
3. Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly until sauce thickens. Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
4. Arrange one-third of the potato slices in the prepared baking dish. Pour one-third of the sauce over the potatoes and sprinkle with one-third of the cheese.
5. Repeat layers twice more, ending with cheese on top.
6. Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown and bubbly. If browning too quickly, cover loosely with foil.
7. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Beets, harvard, canned, solids and liquids
description:
A classic side dish, Harvard beets feature tender beet slices bathed in a sweet and tangy glaze, offering a vibrant color and delightful flavor straight from the can.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 (15 ounce) can sliced beets, undrained
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon cornstarch
- 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar
- 1 tablespoon butter

Instructions:
1. Drain the liquid from the canned beets into a small saucepan; set beets aside.
2. In the saucepan, whisk together the sugar and cornstarch until smooth.
3. Stir in the apple cider vinegar and the reserved beet liquid.
4. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens.
5. Remove from heat and stir in the butter until melted.
6. Add the drained beet slices to the sauce and gently stir to coat.
7. Heat through over low heat until the beets are warm, about 2-3 minutes.
8. Serve warm.

name: Beets, pickled, canned, solids and liquids
description:
Tangy and sweet, these pickled beets offer a delightful crunch and a vibrant burst of flavor, preserved in a savory brine for a refreshing side dish or salad topping.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 20 minutes (plus cooking and cooling time)

Ingredients:
- 2 pounds fresh beets, trimmed
- 1 cup apple cider vinegar
- 1/2 cup water
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon whole pickling spices (optional)

Instructions:
1. Wash beets thoroughly. Place them in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, about 30-45 minutes depending on size.
2. Drain the beets and let them cool slightly. Once cool enough to handle, peel the skins (they should slip off easily) and slice or cube the beets.
3. In a saucepan, combine the apple cider vinegar, water, sugar, salt, and pickling spices (if using). Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar and salt dissolve.
4. Pack the sliced/cubed beets into clean jars.
5. Pour the hot pickling brine over the beets, ensuring they are fully submerged.
6. Seal the jars and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving to allow flavors to meld. For longer storage, process in a boiling water bath according to canning guidelines.

name: Corn pudding, home prepared
description:
A comforting classic, home-prepared corn pudding is a creamy, slightly sweet dish with tender corn kernels baked into a custardy base, perfect as a side or light meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 (15 ounce) can creamed corn
- 1 (15 ounce) can whole kernel corn, drained
- 2 large eggs
- 1/2 cup whole milk
- 2 tablespoons granulated sugar
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted
- 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking dish.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, sugar, melted butter, flour, salt, and pepper until well combined.
3. Stir in the creamed corn and drained whole kernel corn.
4. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
5. Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until the pudding is set in the center and lightly golden brown on top.

name: Potatoes, mashed, home-prepared, whole milk added
description:

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 pounds russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and quartered
- 1/2 cup whole milk, warmed
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1 teaspoon salt, or to taste
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, or to taste

Instructions:
1. Place peeled and quartered potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold water. Add a pinch of salt to the water.
2. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until potatoes are very tender when pierced with a fork, about 15-20 minutes.
3. Drain the potatoes thoroughly in a colander.
4. Return the drained potatoes to the empty hot pot. Mash the potatoes using a potato masher or a fork until mostly smooth.
5. Add the warmed whole milk, softened butter, salt, and pepper to the mashed potatoes.
6. Continue mashing or stir vigorously until the potatoes are creamy and smooth. Do not overmix, or they can become gummy.
7. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve hot.

name: Spinach souffle
description:
An elegant and airy dish, spinach soufflé is a light, savory custard infused with vibrant spinach and baked to a golden, puffed perfection, offering a delightful texture and rich flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 1 cup whole milk, warmed
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
- 3 large eggs, separated
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese (optional)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Butter a 1.5-quart soufflé dish and dust lightly with flour or Parmesan cheese.
2. In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, to form a roux.
3. Gradually whisk in the warm milk until the mixture is smooth and thickened, forming a béchamel sauce.
4. Remove from heat. Stir in the squeezed dry spinach, nutmeg, salt, pepper, and Parmesan cheese (if using).
5. Whisk in the egg yolks one at a time until well combined.
6. In a separate clean bowl, beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form.
7. Gently fold one-third of the egg whites into the spinach mixture to lighten it, then carefully fold in the remaining egg whites until just combined, being careful not to deflate them.
8. Pour the mixture into the prepared soufflé dish.
9. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the soufflé is puffed and golden brown. Serve immediately.

name: Potatoes, au gratin, home-prepared from recipe using margarine
description:
A comforting classic, home-prepared potatoes au gratin feature thinly sliced potatoes baked in a creamy, savory sauce until tender and golden, made with margarine for a rich flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 medium potatoes (e.g., Russet or Yukon Gold), peeled and thinly sliced
- 2 tablespoons margarine
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 2 cups milk (dairy or non-dairy)
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese (optional, for topping)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
2. In a medium saucepan, melt the margarine over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, to form a roux.
3. Gradually whisk in the milk until the sauce is smooth and thickened. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Arrange half of the sliced potatoes in an even layer in the prepared baking dish.
5. Pour half of the cream sauce over the potatoes.
6. Repeat with the remaining potatoes and sauce.
7. If desired, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
8. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 45 minutes.
9. Remove foil and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown and bubbly.

description:

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 packet taco seasoning
- 1/2 cup water
- 12 hard taco shells
- 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
- 1 cup shredded lettuce
- Optional: diced tomatoes, sour cream, salsa

Instructions:
1. Brown ground beef in a skillet, drain fat.
2. Stir in taco seasoning and water, simmer for 5-7 minutes until thickened.
3. Warm taco shells according to package directions.
4. Fill each warm taco shell with seasoned beef, shredded lettuce, and shredded cheese.
5. Add optional toppings as desired and serve immediately.

name: Fast foods, cheeseburger; single, regular patty; plain
description:

Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:

- 1 slice American cheese
- 1 hamburger bun

Instructions:

2. Cook patty on a grill or skillet over medium-high heat for 3-5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.
3. Place cheese slice on the patty during the last minute of cooking to melt.
4. Lightly toast the hamburger bun.
5. Assemble the cheeseburger by placing the cheesy patty on the bun and serve.

description:

name: Fast foods, onion rings, breaded and fried
description:
Crispy, golden-brown rings of sweet onion, coated in a seasoned breading and deep-fried to perfection, offering a delightful crunch and savory flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 large onion, sliced into 1/2-inch rings
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp black pepper
- 1 cup milk
- 1 large egg
- Vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. Separate onion slices into rings.
2. In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper.
3. In another bowl, whisk milk and egg.
4. Dip each onion ring into the milk mixture, then dredge in the flour mixture, ensuring it's fully coated. Repeat for a thicker coating if desired.
5. Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot or fryer to 350°F (175°C).
6. Carefully fry onion rings in batches for 2-4 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy. Do not overcrowd the pot.
7. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Season with additional salt if desired.
8. Serve hot.

name: Fast foods, potato, french fried in vegetable oil
description:
Irresistibly crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, these golden french fries are deep-fried to perfection, offering a universally loved savory side or snack.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 large russet potatoes
- 4 cups vegetable oil (for frying)
- Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Peel potatoes and cut them into 1/4-inch thick sticks. Rinse thoroughly in cold water to remove excess starch, then pat very dry with paper towels.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot or deep fryer to 325°F (160°C).
3. Fry potatoes in small batches for 5-7 minutes, until soft but not browned (this is the first fry). Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Let cool for at least 10 minutes.
4. Increase oil temperature to 375°F (190°C).
5. Fry potatoes again in small batches for 2-4 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
6. Remove with a slotted spoon, drain on paper towels, and immediately season generously with salt.
7. Serve hot.

name: Fast foods, potato, mashed
description:
Creamy, smooth, and utterly comforting, fast-food mashed potatoes are a simple yet satisfying side dish, often seasoned lightly and served warm.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 2-3
Prep Time: 25 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 large russet potatoes, peeled and quartered
- 1/4 cup milk (or half-and-half)
- 2 tbsp butter
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Place peeled and quartered potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold water. Add a pinch of salt.
2. Bring to a boil and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until fork-tender.
3. Drain the potatoes thoroughly.
4. Return potatoes to the hot pot over low heat for 1-2 minutes to dry them out slightly.
5. Add milk and butter to the pot. Mash with a potato masher until smooth and creamy. Do not overmix.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve hot.

description:
A convenient and comforting classic, this frozen rising crust pizza bakes up with a fluffy, airy crust, generously topped with melted cheese for a simple yet satisfying meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 pre-made pizza crust (rising crust type)
- 1/2 cup pizza sauce
- 1.5 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
- Optional: 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Place pizza crust on a baking sheet or pizza stone.
3. Spread pizza sauce evenly over the crust, leaving a small border for the crust.
4. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese generously over the sauce. Add Parmesan cheese if desired.
5. Bake for 12-18 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
6. Remove from oven, let cool for a few minutes, then slice and serve.

name: Fast foods, chicken, breaded and fried, boneless pieces, plain
description:
Tender, juicy boneless chicken pieces, coated in a seasoned, crispy breading and fried to golden perfection, offering a simple yet satisfying fast-food favorite.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast or thigh, cut into 1-inch pieces
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1/2 tsp paprika
- 1/4 tsp garlic powder
- 1 large egg, beaten
- 1/4 cup milk
- Vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. In a shallow dish, whisk together flour, salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
2. In another shallow dish, whisk the egg and milk.
3. Dip each chicken piece into the egg mixture, then dredge thoroughly in the flour mixture, ensuring it's fully coated.
4. Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot or fryer to 350°F (175°C).
5. Carefully fry chicken pieces in batches for 5-7 minutes, or until golden brown, crispy, and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F/74°C). Do not overcrowd the pot.
6. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
7. Serve hot.

name: Fast foods, grilled chicken, bacon and tomato club sandwich, with cheese, lettuce, and mayonnaise
description:
A hearty and flavorful club sandwich featuring tender grilled chicken, crispy bacon, fresh lettuce, ripe tomato, and melted cheese, all brought together with creamy mayonnaise between slices of toasted bread.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 3 slices bread, toasted
- 4 oz grilled chicken breast, sliced
- 2-3 slices cooked bacon
- 1 slice cheese (e.g., cheddar, provolone)
- 2-3 lettuce leaves
- 2 tomato slices
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise

Instructions:
1. Spread mayonnaise on one side of each toasted bread slice.
2. On the first slice of bread, layer lettuce, tomato, and grilled chicken.
3. Place the second slice of bread on top, then layer with cheese, bacon, and more lettuce.
4. Top with the third slice of bread.
5. Secure with toothpicks if desired, then slice diagonally and serve.

name: Fast Foods, Fried Chicken, Breast, meat and skin and breading
description:
A classic fried chicken breast, featuring juicy white meat encased in a perfectly seasoned, golden-brown crispy skin and breading, a true comfort food staple.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 large bone-in, skin-on chicken breast
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 tbsp paprika
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)
- 1 large egg, beaten
- 1/2 cup milk
- Vegetable oil for frying

Instructions:
1. In a shallow dish, whisk together flour and all dry seasonings.
2. In another shallow dish, whisk the egg and milk.
3. Pat chicken breast dry. Dip into the egg mixture, then dredge thoroughly in the flour mixture, ensuring it's fully coated. Press breading onto chicken.
4. Heat vegetable oil in a deep pot or fryer to 325-350°F (160-175°C).
5. Carefully place chicken breast into the hot oil. Fry for 12-18 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F/74°C). Adjust heat to prevent burning.
6. Remove with tongs and drain on a wire rack over paper towels.
7. Serve hot.

- 1 tbsp paprika
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)

Instructions:

2. In another shallow dish, whisk the egg and milk.

5. Carefully place drumsticks into the hot oil. Fry for 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F/74°C). Adjust heat to prevent burning.

name: Fast Food, Pizza Chain, 14" pizza, pepperoni topping, thin crust
description:
A classic thin-crust pizza from a fast-food chain, featuring a crispy base generously topped with savory pepperoni slices and melted cheese, offering a satisfying and familiar flavor.

Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 (14-inch) thin pizza crust
- 1/2 cup pizza sauce
- 1.5 cups shredded mozzarella cheese
- 1/2 cup pepperoni slices

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) or according to crust package directions.
2. Place pizza crust on a baking sheet or pizza stone.
3. Spread pizza sauce evenly over the crust, leaving a small border.
4. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the sauce.
5. Arrange pepperoni slices evenly over the cheese.
6. Bake for 8-12 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: Fast foods, taco with beef, cheese and lettuce, soft
description:
A delightful soft-shell taco, featuring seasoned ground beef, crisp shredded lettuce, and melty cheese, all wrapped in a warm, pliable flour tortilla for a comforting and easy-to-eat meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 packet taco seasoning
- 1/2 cup water
- 12 soft flour tortillas
- 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
- 1 cup shredded lettuce
- Optional: diced tomatoes, sour cream, salsa

Instructions:
1. Brown ground beef in a skillet, drain fat.
2. Stir in taco seasoning and water, simmer for 5-7 minutes until thickened.
3. Warm tortillas according to package directions.
4. Fill each warm tortilla with seasoned beef, shredded lettuce, and shredded cheese.
5. Add optional toppings as desired and serve immediately.

name: Fast foods, taco with chicken, lettuce and cheese, soft
description:
A delicious soft-shell taco, filled with tender seasoned chicken, crisp shredded lettuce, and melty cheese, all wrapped in a warm, pliable flour tortilla for a flavorful and satisfying meal.

Ingredients:

- 1 cup shredded lettuce

name: Fast foods, quesadilla, with chicken
description:
A warm and cheesy quesadilla, featuring tender seasoned chicken and melted cheese sandwiched between two toasted flour tortillas, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 10 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 (8-inch) flour tortillas
- 1/2 cup cooked chicken, shredded or diced
- 1/2 cup shredded Monterey Jack or cheddar cheese
- 1 tbsp vegetable oil or butter
- Optional: salsa, sour cream, guacamole for serving

Instructions:
1. Heat oil or butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
2. Place one tortilla in the skillet. Sprinkle half of the cheese over the tortilla, then add the chicken, and top with the remaining cheese.
3. Place the second tortilla on top.
4. Cook for 3-5 minutes per side, or until tortillas are golden brown and crispy, and cheese is melted and bubbly.
5. Remove from skillet, slice into wedges, and serve immediately with optional toppings.

name: Fast Food, Pizza Chain, 14" pizza, cheese topping, stuffed crust
description:
A decadent fast-food pizza featuring a rich, cheesy stuffed crust, generously topped with a classic layer of melted cheese for an extra indulgent experience.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4-6
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 (14-inch) pre-made pizza dough
- 4-6 mozzarella string cheese sticks
- 1/2 cup pizza sauce
- 1.5 cups shredded mozzarella cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
2. Roll out pizza dough into a 16-inch circle. Place on a greased pizza pan or parchment-lined baking sheet.
3. Arrange string cheese sticks around the edge of the dough, about 1 inch from the edge. Fold the dough over the string cheese and pinch to seal, forming the stuffed crust.
4. Spread pizza sauce evenly over the inner crust.
5. Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese over the sauce.
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
7. Remove from oven, let cool for a few minutes, then slice and serve.

name: Fast foods, strawberry banana smoothie made with ice and low-fat yogurt
description:
A refreshing and creamy smoothie, blending sweet strawberries, ripe bananas, ice, and low-fat yogurt into a delightful and healthy beverage.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup frozen strawberries
- 1 ripe banana, peeled
- 1/2 cup low-fat plain or vanilla yogurt
- 1/2 cup ice cubes
- 1/4 cup milk or water (adjust for desired consistency)

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender.
2. Blend on high speed until smooth and creamy. Add more liquid if needed to reach desired consistency.
3. Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Milk shakes, thick chocolate
description:
A decadent and creamy chocolate milkshake, blended to a thick consistency, offering a rich, sweet, and satisfying treat.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 1
Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 scoops chocolate ice cream
- 1/2 cup whole milk
- 2 tablespoons chocolate syrup

Instructions:
1. Combine chocolate ice cream, whole milk, and chocolate syrup in a blender.
2. Blend on high speed until smooth and thick.
3. Pour into a tall glass and serve immediately.

2. Blend on high speed until smooth and thick.
3. Pour into a tall glass and serve immediately.

name: Sauce, sofrito, prepared from recipe
description:
A vibrant, aromatic base of finely diced or pureed vegetables and herbs, sofrito is the flavorful soul of many Latin American and Spanish dishes, building depth and richness from the ground up.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: Makes about 4 cups
Prep Time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2 large green bell peppers, cored and seeded
- 2 large red bell peppers, cored and seeded
- 2 large yellow onions, peeled
- 1 head garlic, peeled
- 1 bunch fresh cilantro, stems removed
- 1/2 cup olive oil
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
1. Roughly chop the bell peppers, onions, garlic, and cilantro.
2. In a food processor, combine the chopped vegetables and cilantro. Pulse until a coarse, uniform paste forms. Do not over-process into a liquid.
3. Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
4. Add the sofrito mixture to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 20-30 minutes, or until most of the liquid has evaporated and the mixture is fragrant and slightly reduced. The sofrito should be thick and deeply flavored.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Allow to cool completely before storing in an airtight container in the refrigerator or freezing for later use.

- 1 cup milk (whole, reduced-fat, or nonfat)
- 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. In a small saucepan, whisk together the cocoa powder, sugar, and salt.
2. Gradually whisk in about 2 tablespoons of the milk to create a smooth paste, ensuring no lumps remain.
3. Add the remaining milk to the saucepan and place over medium heat.
4. Heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is hot and steaming, but not boiling. Do not let it boil.
5. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract.
6. Pour into a mug and serve immediately. Optional: top with whipped cream or marshmallows.

Prep Time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:

- 1/4 cup red wine vinegar

- 1/2 tsp sugar
- Salt to taste

3. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.

- 1/2 cup mixed seeds (pumpkin, sunflower, chia)
- 1/2 cup maple syrup or honey
- 1/4 cup coconut oil, melted
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup dried fruit (optional, e.g., raisins, cranberries), added after baking

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, combine oats, chopped nuts, seeds, cinnamon, and salt.
3. In a separate small bowl, whisk together maple syrup (or honey), melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract.
4. Pour the wet ingredients over the dry ingredients and stir until everything is evenly coated.
5. Spread the granola mixture in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
6. Bake for 30-40 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, until golden brown and crispy. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning.
7. Remove from oven and let cool completely on the baking sheet. It will crisp up further as it cools.
8. Once cooled, stir in dried fruit if using. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

name: Beef, loin, tenderloin roast, boneless, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 0" fat, choice, cooked, roasted
description:
A perfectly roasted boneless tenderloin, graded Choice and trimmed to 0" fat, offering an incredibly tender and succulent experience with a rich, savory flavor.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 2-3 lb boneless beef tenderloin roast, trimmed to 0" fat, Choice grade
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 tablespoon coarse salt (kosher or sea salt)
- 1 teaspoon black pepper
- 1 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary (optional)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
2. Pat the tenderloin dry with paper towels. This helps create a good crust.
3. In a small bowl, mix together salt, pepper, garlic powder, and rosemary (if using).
4. Rub the tenderloin all over with olive oil, then generously season with the spice mixture.
5. Place the tenderloin on a rack in a roasting pan.
6. Roast for 30-45 minutes, or until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part reads 130-135°F (54-57°C) for medium-rare, or 135-140°F (57-60°C) for medium.
7. Remove from oven, tent loosely with foil, and let rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing. The internal temperature will rise a few degrees during resting.

description:

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 6-8
Prep Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1.5 lbs 90% lean ground beef
- 1 cup breadcrumbs
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1/2 cup finely chopped onion
- 1/4 cup finely chopped green bell pepper (optional)
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
- 1/4 cup ketchup (for topping)
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar (for topping)
- 1 teaspoon mustard (for topping)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, milk, egg, onion, green bell pepper (if using), salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Mix gently until just combined, do not overmix.
3. Shape the mixture into a loaf and place it in a loaf pan or on a baking sheet.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together ketchup, brown sugar, and mustard for the topping.
5. Spread the topping evenly over the meatloaf.
6. Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, or until an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) is reached.
7. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Soup, wonton, Chinese restaurant
description:
A classic Chinese comfort food, this wonton soup features delicate dumplings filled with savory pork and shrimp, floating in a clear, aromatic broth, often garnished with scallions.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 4 cups chicken broth
- 1 tablespoon soy sauce
- 1 teaspoon sesame oil
- 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger
- 1/4 lb ground pork
- 1/4 lb shrimp, finely chopped
- 1 tablespoon chopped scallions (green part)
- 1 teaspoon cornstarch
- 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce (for filling)
- 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
- 24 wonton wrappers
- Extra chopped scallions for garnish

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, combine ground pork, chopped shrimp, 1 tablespoon chopped scallions, cornstarch, 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce, and white pepper. Mix well.
2. Place about 1 teaspoon of filling in the center of each wonton wrapper. Moisten the edges with water, fold into a triangle, and press to seal. Bring the two bottom corners together and overlap, sealing with a dab of water.
3. In a large pot, bring chicken broth to a simmer. Add 1 tablespoon soy sauce, sesame oil, and grated ginger.
4. Carefully drop wontons into the simmering broth. Cook for 3-5 minutes, or until wontons float and are cooked through.
5. Serve hot, garnished with extra chopped scallions.

name: Cookie, vanilla with caramel, coconut, and chocolate coating
description:
A delightful treat featuring a vanilla cookie base, generously topped with chewy caramel, shredded coconut, and a rich chocolate coating, offering a symphony of textures and flavors.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 24 cookies
Prep Time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 (14 oz) can sweetened condensed milk
- 1/2 cup caramel sauce
- 2 cups shredded coconut
- 1 cup chocolate chips
- 1 tablespoon coconut oil (optional, for melting chocolate)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, cream together butter, sugar, and vanilla extract until light and fluffy.
3. Gradually add flour, mixing until a soft dough forms.
4. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place on the prepared baking sheet. Flatten slightly with a fork.
5. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
6. In a small saucepan, combine sweetened condensed milk and caramel sauce. Heat over low heat, stirring constantly, until warmed through and slightly thickened. Stir in shredded coconut.
7. Spread the caramel-coconut mixture over each cooled cookie.
8. In a microwave-safe bowl, melt chocolate chips with coconut oil (if using) in 30-second intervals, stirring until smooth.
9. Drizzle or spread melted chocolate over the caramel-coconut layer. Let set at room temperature or in the refrigerator until chocolate is firm.

name: Cookie, with peanut butter filling, chocolate-coated
description:
A decadent cookie featuring a rich peanut butter filling nestled between two layers, all enrobed in a smooth, sweet chocolate coating, creating an irresistible sweet and salty combination.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 18-24 cookies
Prep Time: 40 minutes

Ingredients:
- 1 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1/2 cup powdered sugar
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened (for filling)
- 2 cups chocolate chips
- 1 tablespoon coconut oil (optional, for melting chocolate)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. For the cookies: In a large bowl, cream together 1 cup butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
4. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place on prepared baking sheets. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until edges are golden. Let cool completely.
5. For the peanut butter filling: In a medium bowl, beat together peanut butter, powdered sugar, and 1/4 cup softened butter until smooth and creamy.
6. Spread a generous amount of peanut butter filling onto the bottom of one cooled cookie, then top with another cookie to create a sandwich.
7. For the chocolate coating: In a microwave-safe bowl, melt chocolate chips with coconut oil (if using) in 30-second intervals, stirring until smooth.
8. Dip each sandwich cookie into the melted chocolate, ensuring it's fully coated. Place on parchment paper to set. Refrigerate briefly to speed setting if desired.

name: Cookies, animal, with frosting or icing
description:
Whimsical animal-shaped cookies, often with a crisp, buttery texture, adorned with a sweet and colorful frosting or icing, making them a delightful treat for all ages.

--- RECIPE ---
Servings: 3-4 dozen cookies
Prep Time: 45 minutes (plus chilling time)

Ingredients:
- 1 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- For Icing:
- 2 cups powdered sugar
- 2-3 tablespoons milk
- 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Food coloring (optional)

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla extract.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add dry ingredients to the wet mixture, mixing until a soft dough forms.
3. Divide dough in half, flatten into discs, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly flour a clean surface.
5. Roll out one disc of dough to about 1/4-inch thickness. Use animal-shaped cookie cutters to cut out shapes. Place on ungreased baking sheets.
6. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden. Let cool completely on a wire rack.
7. For the icing: In a medium bowl, whisk together powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add more milk if needed for desired consistency. Divide and color with food coloring if desired.
8. Once cookies are completely cool, spread or pipe icing onto them. Let icing set before storing.
